After being bitten by a vampire, Ezekiel was saved by Scarla the monster hunter. Ezekiel despaired at the prospect of life as a half-vampire, but Scarla offered him a new path: becoming a vampire slayer and working together to save others. Ezekiel accepted the offer and began training in various martial arts.

Baron Leonardas was a vampire of great strength. He tracked down and brutally murdered Scarla, who hunted his kind. Devastated at the loss and enraged by his failure to prevent it, Ezekiel's desire for vengeance fueled his rapid development from that day forward.
Ezekiel specialized in solving cases involving vampires. He fought and survived many battles over the years, growing stronger all the while. Wherever vampires lurked, Ezekiel would soon be found.

Ezekiel became widely renowned across Solisium as a peerless vampire slayer. Leaving a bloody trail in his wake, he doggedly pursued his mortal enemy, Leonardas, to avenge Scarla. One day, their paths finally crossed. So began their fight to the death.

As Ezekiel continued training, he reached transcendent levels of combat prowess. His muscles became firm and strong and his unique regenerative ability as a half vampire improved significantly, meaning that he suffered less damage even in the face of powerful enemy attacks.

The decline of the Akidu Clan began with the death of the first chieftain and lasted a long time. Then, on a night marked by the rise of a red moon, a hero was born in a place deep within the canyon—that hero would lead the revival of the Akidu Clan. Valkarg was known as the Beast because of the overwhelming strength he possessed since childhood. He was capable of tearing apart enemies in battle with just his bare hands.

The dangerous ritual, passed down through generations of the Akidu Clan, could only be undertaken by the clan's chosen ones. Many orcs had reached the altar before only to perish on its steps, but Valkarg proved strong enough to survive the agonizing infusion of dark magic that followed. Reborn as a Shadow Orc, his skin became like steel, impenetrable by arrows, and he gained such awesome physical might that no battle could exhaust him.

Thus empowered, Valkarg led his forces to one battlefield victory after another as the head of the Akidu orc vanguard. He soon began capturing shamans from other clans and draining them of Mana to create yet more Shadow Orcs. As Valkarg's power grew, Kanyar's position as the second clan leader came into doubt. Rumor spread that a ritual would soon take place in which a new head of the Akidu Clan would be chosen.

One pale dawn, the long-expected ritual began. Gathering at the foot of the canyon wall, the strongest members of the clan disrobed and began to climb, clawing at each other as they ascended. In the end, only Valkarg reached the altar at the top alive. The Mauvessence that once flowed through Kanyar's body transferred to Valkarg, and planting his foot on his slain enemy's corpse, Valkarg announced his victory to the world with a triumphant roar.

Valkarg's victory, however, also foreshadowed defeat. He knew that one day it would be his corpse on the ground, his power flowing into some other victor's body. In his arrogance, he sought to change his fate and avoid death, which he hated and feared above all else. Through means unknown, Valkarg came into contact with a human wizard with whom he entered into a secret pact. When fate finally caught up with Valkarg, an orc named Sonai stood victorious above the old orc's headless body and claimed the title of fourth clan leader. And yet, a strangely contented smile lingered on Valkarg's lifeless lips.

The once untouchable assassin woke to find himself surrounded by corpses. A realization came to him, instinctual and immediate, that he had been utterly transformed. Though he had lost everything dear to him—his comrades, his love, even life itself—he had been granted a second chance, an existence after death. It didn't take him long to decide how to use it.

He wandered the world in search of the one who had remade him into a vampire, but vengeance required survival, and this proved to be a cruel and constant struggle. Only blood could sustain him. Many an innocent animal was sacrificed at the altar of his cause, but it was never enough. Eventually, he succumbed to his needs and preyed upon humans, his heart weeping even as his body fed.

Blood can be addictive, and the lust for it has a way of obscuring the truth. He told himself that some sacrifices were necessary, that vengeance against the vampire who had wronged him was worth any price. Blinded by his obsession, he prowled the dark corners of the world shrouded in a fog of blood—a fog that swallowed entire villages whole.

His quest for revenge slowly consumed him. As his reputation grew, even his fellow vampires came to fear him, though some among them took a different view. To them, his obsession became a source of much-needed amusement in an otherwise long and often boring immortal existence. How, they asked, could one lonely vampire expect to hunt such elusive quarry without support or resources? Whether they cowered or cackled, however, made no difference to him. He cared for nothing but his revenge.

At last, he plunged the dagger of ash into his foe's heart. But the elder vampire laughed. "Blood follows blood. Your path and mine are as one!" His vengeance wreaked at last, the gaping maw of an empty eternity loomed before the vampire hunter. But rather than embrace the void, he turned away and devoted himself to a new purpose. The world didn't need more monsters—it needed someone to defend against them. With the oath he pledged, he began to reclaim the shattered remnants of the man he'd once been, one day at a time.

Gregory, a wizard of Trutizan who was obsessed with Diabolica research, learned to communicate with the demon Dantalux while studying an ancient mask. Dantalux suggested an intriguing game to Gregory... one that ended with the demon claiming control over Gregory's body.

In a human's guise, Dantalux observed the people of the overworld for a time, and soon dismissed them as a feeble and worthless species. He began plotting to use his magic to ignite a war between various leaders and spread a plague that would wipe out all of humanity.

Dantalux visited the various lords of Trutizan and whetted their appetites for conquest by offering them his power. Tempted by the prospect of absolute sovereignty, the lords entered into a fierce internecine war from which none emerged victorious except Dantalux, who absorbed the power of their souls as they perished.

Leaving Trutizan in chaos, Dantalux traveled to Solisium, where he met an ugly old wizard on the street. Dantalux invited the old wizard to play a game of high stakes, and the wizard accepted. The wizard's name was Hale Verpheus.

Hale Verpheus—who had once been a great wizard—proved more than a match for Dantalux and beat the demon at his own game. Bemoaning his foolishness, Dantalux was forced to take the pledge of a Guardian devoted to humans. Using his demon mask's power, Dantalux can greatly reduce damage dealt to himself and those around him.

Another heatwave!

Attention anglers and chefs,
it's time for the Solisium Big Catch Express!

You can now embrace the challenge of catching fish and cooking your hard-won catch in Solisium!

^<c=@Notification_Highlight>1. Gone Fishin'... for Ingredients!^</c>

Period: August 7, 2024 - August 21, 2024 before regular maintenance

You can fish in freshwater, saltwater, anywhere there's fish!
Attach bait to your fishing rod, cast it into the water, and reel in a ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Big Catch Sack^</c> filled with goodies. You'll get one of several items, including Fresh Ingredients.

^<c=@Notification_Highlight>2. Gone Cookin'!^</c>

Period: August 7, 2024 - August 28, 2024 before regular maintenance

Great food starts with great ingredients!
Cook with the ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>freshest ingredients^</c> to create a Kastler Banquet, a rare treat that's as colorful and abundant as it is delicious!

^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Please visit the official announcement on the website for more information.^</c>

Happy Chu-seok, the Korean lunar celebration!

Finally, fall is here!
And that means it's time for some fall festivities, including Chu-seok!

Make the most of autumn in Solisium!

^<c=@Notification_Highlight>1. Capture the beauty of fall!^</c>

Take pictures under the decorated ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>persimmon trees^</c> around the village! How about a selfie with a lovely ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>scarecrow^</c>?

There will be a ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>moon rabbit^</c> working hard to make the Korean traditional rice cake, Tteok, in the night sky as well! Don't miss this chance to see it for yourself!

^<c=@Notification_Highlight>2. Make a delicious Song-pyun, a traditional rice cake treat!^</c>

Collect colorful Song-pyun ingredients to cook some treats and find reward chests!

^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Song-Pyun dough^</c> is found from Co-Op Dungeon Clear Reward Chests, and ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Sesame Fillings^</c>, ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Mung Bean Fillings^</c>, and ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Red Bean Fillings^</c> as rewards from Happy Chu-seok Check-In. Finally, get some ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Hanji Wrapping Papers^</c> as Resistance Contract rewards and you're good to go!

Go find ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Chu-seok Gift Makers^</c> at each village and create various items such as ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Red Leaf Pippin^</c>, ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Red Bean Rice Cake Meal^</c>, and ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Chu-seok Gift Boxes^</c>!

^<c=@Notification_Highlight>For more information, please check the announcement on the official website.^</c>

Let's Celebrate the Season of Abundance!

Adventurers, we've got a great event to help you celebrate a bountiful fall!

1. Double Trouble!

Clear a Co-Op Dungeon and get 2 Reward Chests!
Every Wednesday and Saturday at 10:00 PM, you can fight ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Queen Bellandir^</c>, ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Tevent^</c>, and ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Deluzhnoa^</c>!

2. Abundance Bundle!

Clear a Co-Op Dungeon or defeat Archbosses to receive an ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Abundance Bundle^</c> filled with useful items that will help you to get stronger.

You can also purchase Abundance Bundles from the Contract Coin Merchant, so don't forget to visit when you're in town!

3. Bountiful Check-In!

Earn Dimensional and Abyssal tokens whenever you Check-In. Check-In every day to receive ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Dimensional Contract Token I^</c>, ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Dimensional Contract Token II^</c>, and ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Abyssal Contract Token^</c>!

^<c=@Notification_Highlight>For more information, please check the announcements on the official website.^</c>

An extra special (and spooky) fall festival is coming to Solisium!
Enjoy the Solisium Haunted Harvest! 

Feel that chill in the air? Seems some ghostly guests have already joined the party. Enjoy delicious dishes with friends, visit a truly ghoulish pumpkin patch, check out new seasonal Shapeshifts, and meet spooky new Amitoi!

^<c=@Notification_Highlight>1. Trick or Treat!^</c>

Villagers in scary costumes will pass out buff-granting candy at night! Collect all available candy buffs to enjoy the ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Phantom's Prank^</c> buff, which turns your head into a giant pumpkin! Using a Shapeshift you acquire from the Haunted Harvest will also allow you to receive the candy buff during the day! 

^<c=@Notification_Highlight>2. Haunted Harvest Dungeon - Haunted Labyrinth!^</c> 

Prove yourself at the ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Haunted Labyrinth^</c>, a special limited-time dungeon only available during the festival. Beware, this pumpkin patch will give you the thrill-ride of your life! 
 
Clear the dungeon, and use ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Candy Corn^</c> to open reward chests to receive Dimension Pumpkins, various pumpkin dishes, and Shapeshifts, along with the ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Phantom's Prank^</c> buff, which is also available in town. Candy Corn can be collected from Check-In and the ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Haunted Harvest Peddlers^</c>. Collect enough Candy Corn and challenge the Pumpkin Watchers!


^<c=@Notification_Highlight>3. Redeem your Dimension Pumpkins!^</c> 

Bring your collected Dimension Pumpkins to the ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Dimension Pumpkin Exchange Merchant^</c> at each Waypoint to trade them in for items. Festive prizes like a ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Pumpkin King Headpiece^</c>, ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Jack-o'-Lantern Izzy^</c>, ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Hallow-Knight^</c> Shapeshift, ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Punky Pumpkin^</c> Shapeshift, and more are waiting for you!

^<c=@Notification_Highlight>4. Pumpkin Treats!^</c> 

Everything is better with pumpkins!^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Dimension Pumpkins^</c> can be used in several delicious meals. Other required ingredients can be purchased from ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Haunted Harvest Peddlers^</c> in Laslan and Stonegard. They are wearing some creepy festival costumes, so it will be easy to spot them!

You can also fish for ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Gummy Fish^</c> and ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Pumpkin Taffy^</c>. These unusual fish are spooky and sweet, and only come out during the Haunted Harvest!

And last but not least, don't forget about the new festival Amitoi! Team up with Jack-o'-Lantern Izzy, Hexbound Figment, and Floating Jolt. They can help you make the most of your expedition, regardless of the location!

^<c=@Notification_Highlight>For more information, please check the announcements on the official website!^</c>

Dress up for the party with ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Shadow's Embrace^</c> costumes or vampiric ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Sanguine^</c> weapon skins, and collect ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>Bat Coins^</c> while you mingle with party-goers.

Perhaps these merchants can give you clues to the secretive Count's identity!

Lucien is a warped creation of Syleus, the mad wizard. This twisted entity perverts the noble ideal of the "Savior of Light." Branding all of humanity as sinners requiring purification, he views their wholesale slaughter as his sacred duty—and their sole path to salvation. Many regions in Laslan and Stonegard hold festivals and celebrations tuned for the regional characteristics. Resistance members participate in festivals and celebrations individually or with colleagues and receive rewards according to their contributions.
There are places in Laslan and Stonegard where there are Abyssal beings. The Resistance has to fight against not only the Arkeum Legion but also the Abyssal beings that threaten a life of peace.

When Gigantrite soared into the sky after a long silence, blessings rained down on the continent of Solisium, and it let Resistance Soldiers ride on its back and brought them to different places as if cheering for the fight against the Arkeum Legion.

It was not an exaggeration that the Resistance, not even a regular army, could keep fighting against the Arkeum Legion in the vast continent of Solisium all thanks to guilds that like-minded soldiers create together.
DaVinci and Jacque Hander sent down contracts to guilds on the Resistance level and provided adequate rewards.
Guilds competed with one another to be blessed by Boonstones that contain the energy of the region, since it was one of the greatest honors a guild could receive.
Huge monsters and those with evil energy awoke in Laslan and Stonegard. The Resistance decided to defeat them before they joined forces with the Arkeum Legion and sent out a decree to all soldiers.

The wizards of Venelux built a special portal at the Guild Base. It uses part of the Star Fragment's power that allows them to travel different dimensions or move through time and space. The mysterious portal allowed each guild to fight against monsters and great evils as much as they liked.

Syleus ran away from Greedal and arrived at his sanctuary. He created an abyss there and let loose all kinds of test subjects and monsters.
The Resistance has been exploring the abyss, but they found out only recently that there was an even deeper abyss.

It was a long time ago that the mysterious stone statues were discovered all around the continent of Solisium. Many people went missing around these statues, and the Venelux wizards' study revealed that you can pass through the statue, thus blocking the surrounding area and moving to a new dimension. Later, the Resistance started calling them Riftstones.
The Resistance participated in festivals and celebrations in the reclaimed Talandre and received fitting rewards according to their contributions.
As soon as they reclaimed Talandre, the guilds ran to claim the Boonstone for themselves. It was for the honor of being the first guild that was protected by the Boonstone of Talandre.
Huge monsters and those with evil energy appeared in Talandre as well. The Resistance announced a decree to defeat those monsters emerging in Talandre.

The wizards of Venelux expanded the connecting paths of the special portal in the Guild Base so that it can connect to the monsters appearing in Talandre, allowing guilds to fight against even more monsters.
There are places in Talandre where Abbysal beings exist. The Resistance decided to end the curfew in Talandre and order the raid of the Abyss.

Riftstone found in Talandre contained even more powerful energy. Guilds gathered more around the Riftstone for their own interests. Thus, many guilds fought in scuffles resembling actual battles for the Riftstone.
At festivals and celebrations, the Resistance divided themselves into camps and fought in skirmishes meant to resemble battles. But they asked the Einar Order for a blessing so that no one would die.

As guilds grew more and more, there was an effort within the Resistance to recruit skilled guild members and develop guilds themselves. Believing they could grow even more with skirmishes meant to imitate actual battles, they asked to hold guild battles at each region's festivals and celebrations.

One day, Sylaveth's purple energy started to spread all over Solisium. That energy corrupted powerful monsters and the forces of evil, which were sensitive to the Star Fragment's power. The energy corrupted and eroded them so that they emerged even more powerful.
The wizards of Venelux called this phenomenon Ascension.

Upon hearing the news that a new stone statue was found in the abyss, all guilds hurried to claim the Abysstone. They knew better than anyone else that the easiest path to becoming the strongest guild was to claim the abyss.

Great horrors different from the Arkeum Legion were asleep all over the continent, from the oldest monster to powerful wraiths of despair. It is time to eliminate them and rid the world of these horrors.

Following Velentra's insane devotion, Calanthia reappeared at the Tower of Greed. The purple witch who once terrorized the world is now trying to drive the world into chaos with even more powerful mana than before.
Even the oldest monster or the wraith of despair could not avoid ascension. The ascended great horrors became even bigger, primal fears and attacked the Resistance.

Calanthia only acted for her lord, Reville Lupius's resurrection. Driven by blind love and destructive obsession, she was preparing for a forbidden ritual to resurrect the dead. Even her own life mattered not for that cause.

DaVinci Aron and Jacque Hander, who reclaimed the Stonegard Castle from the Tyrant Fernan and the Arkeum Legion, let the Resistance fight over the interests of Stonegard Castle so that they can grow through mock battles.

The competition between the best guilds over Stonegard Castle is held with no casualties thanks to the blessing of the Einar Order. The Resistance grows through these mock battles and prepares for the fight against the Arkeum Legion.

Syleus turned the ancient underground tomb into his own lab, now known as Syleus's Abyss. The labyrinthian halls teemed with immortals and monsters, so Syleus created a follower, Heliber, to guard the lab. Ever the loyal servant, Heliber faithfully guides his master through the lab—and leads unwelcome visitors to their deaths.

According to the ancient texts, Belluatan looked across the plains one day and spotted a lion. Seeing something of himself in the creature, he embedded within it a fragment of the Star of Sylaveth. The Order's avaricious, chaotic influence warped the lion's appearance over time, twisting its form into that of the hideous beast now known as King Chimaerus.

Wizard Skultus of the Sylavean Order bestowed the gift of a Star Fragment upon the queen ant Lacune to bolster her abilities. She grew in size as well as power, and her chitin took on a shimmering golden hue. Seeing this, Skultus whispered a promise, or perhaps a prophecy: "You are destined to rule the underground." It wasn't long before it came to pass, and Lacune now lords over the underworld from a clandestine throne—a secret space she used her magic to create for herself.

The Arkeum Legion sent one expedition after another into Syleus's Abyss, desperate to harness the dark power residing within. None were prepared to face the countless monsters roaming the passageways, nor navigate the labyrinth. Every expedition failed. Upon discovering Heliber, the Legion seized on the idea of using him to gain control over the Abyss. They eventually managed to capture him, imprisoning him in a stone casket. Yet even stone could not hold Heliber forever, and when he broke free of his prison, he was even stronger than before. The sole Arkeum Shadowmancer to survive the encounter called upon the specter Karnix for help.

Ahzreil, an Elder of the Sylavean Order, put a stop to the experiments and abandoned the monsters under the temple, sealing them away for good. Trapped with no others to prey upon, the monsters turned on each other, but King Chimaerus made short work of them all. According to one Shadowmancer's records, if King Chimaerus absorbs greater mana, it could transform into an even deadlier beast called Rex Chimaerus.

A creature of dark magic empowered by a Star Fragment, the Queen Ant instinctually defends her kingdom with ruthless ferocity. With each of the countless invaders she consumed, her magic grew, until at last she took on a newer, deadlier form with a new name - Lequirus.

Ahzreil and his followers kidnapped a Light Elemental Spirit and carried out a cruel ritual, corrupting and transforming it into a Dark Elemental. The Elemental was bound by the ritual, but destroyed any who dared approach it. People eventually began calling it Shaikal, after the legendary Dark Elemental.

The giant orc King Verte was a powerful being created by dark magic, but proved too uncontrollable to serve Arkeum as a weapon of war. Instead, Tuaren used King Verte's experiment as a template, ultimately creating an even more advanced weapon. Although smaller and more tempered, Duke Magna wields highly concentrated dark magic, making him more powerful and even more dangerous.

A violent tyrant named Toublek of Saurodoma Island possesses the reptilian gift of infinite regeneration as well as the power to use sorcery, making him impervious to even the most devastating attacks. Once an elf wizard, Toublek's reptilianism is the result of a magical experiment gone awry. Now, he's become the terror of Saurodoma Island, kindnapping innocent victims to perform experiments on in hopes of finding a way to reverse his transformation.

The Arkeum Legion has teamed up with the Sylavean Order to create a torture chamber within the Shadow Crypt in order to extract vital information to crush the Resistance. Kaligras, the Arkeum Legion's chief torture technician assigned to the facility, always hides his face behind a dark mask. Behind this hideous mask lies a twisted desire that revels in gruesome murders and horrific screams.

Gaitan sought revenge against humans for mistreating goblins. With the help of the dark elf Soleil, Gaitan gained strength beyond any ordinary goblin. With this new power, he waged a bloody war against humans. They say the blood shed during battle turned the sea around the island red. Gaitan named his new clan Bloodwave and continues to gain power, slaughtering every human he can. Now, the ambitious Red Goblin King aims to unite all goblin clans and take over the world.

Toublek, who was once an elven wizard, performed heinous magical experiments to return to his original form. In the end, he obtained the power he sought by engraving powerful magic onto his own body. However, the power created from such senseless slaughter eventually ate away at Toublek's sanity. Toublek forgot his original goal of becoming an elf once again, and became the merciless tyrant, Kertaki, who sought nothing but even greater power.

The Dark Elemental attracted beings from Diabolica. These monsters mercilessly slaughtered people under Shaikal's will. Ahzreil, wanting to use Shaikal as a weapon of war, cast a powerful dark magic to bring his mind under control. However, Shaikal instead absorbed Ahzreil's power and became a being of even deeper darkness. In the end, Shaikal turned into an incomprehensibly powerful being, Shakarux, forcing Ahzreil to finally give up on him.

The Arkeum was pleased with Duke Magna's performance. However, Tuaren wanted to further test how strong his weapon could become. He performed another experiment at the risk of destroying Duke Magna. He drained the power from all of his spare test subjects and injected it directly into his creation. Empowered beyond the limits of his mortal shell, Duke Magna collapsed in agony, only to be resurrected a short time later as a supremely powerful being, Turka.

The Ogre who lost everything to Humans built his own kingdom in the deep forest. He used his enhanced intelligence and physical ability (thanks to a certain Elf from a long time ago) to gather other Ogres and declared a war on Humans. As Human casualties started to happen, Humans sent an army to remove the Ogres, but even the soldiers were all found dead. Humans then began to refer the Ogre king as "King Khanzaizin."

They say there is a secret room hidden within the depths of Bercant Estate. This place was magically created by the architect of the mansion, and over time, it was expanded to include other rooms at the lord's request including a hearing room, a garden, and even a prison. One day, Limuny, the Mansion's master and the Spineflower Knight commander, released the florified monster that Norn had become. In exchange, Norn granted the Spineflower Knights great power, for the price of their humanity.

Skultus, the Grand Elder of Sylavean Order, performed the demon summoning ritual disguised as a holy sermon. He hypnotized his loyal followers before sacrificing them to summon Grayeye. However, he soon realized he didn't have the power to control the summoned demon, and hastily sealed the creature underground. Buried beneath the earth, Grayeye waits and schemes. As the demon gathers puppets and feeds on its victims' fear, it may yet gain the strength to break Skultus's seal.

Norn Bercant was kidnapped by the Crimsons and became a test subject for Kaiser's Florification experiments. While she escaped the lab, she could not escape the curse, turning into a powerful Florified monster. Using her own potent magic and the powers granted by the curse forced upon her, she created her own mutant garden and cut herself off from the rest of the world.

Kaiser Crimson, the head of the ambitious and cutthroat Crimson Family, was a thoroughly ruthless killer. He kidnapped countless civilians and used them for his experiments to create the perfect bio-engineered weapon. When his vicious experiments finally escaped his secret lab, the mutants spread far and wide, killing everyone in the manor. It is said that Kaiser himself was infected by his own freed monsters, turning into the most powerful creature among them.

Lord Embergourd, the self-proclaimed Lord of Pumpkins, is trying to make the best pumpkin field in all of Solisium right in his personal stronghold. With the help of his watchers and treacherous traps, he was able to steal the land from its rightful owners. Adventurers are gathering to reclaim the pumpkin field.

Velentra, a professor at Venelux, was captivated by Calanthia's immense magic power and became obsessed with her. Driven by madness, Velentra grotesquely disfigured herself, even transplanting Calanthia's severed left arm in place of her own to gain access to the power of the Star Fragment. Now, in her secret chamber, Velentra is testing a forbidden spell to resurrect Reville and fulfil Calanthia's wish.

Nerzatum, the ancient elephantine horror, was resurrected by the Sylavean Order's necromancy. But upon awakening, it turned the Order's own necromancy against them, slaughtering every last summoner. Won over by Nerzatum's immense power and cunning, Sylaveth's shaman Namarch betrayed the Order and swore loyalty to the beast. Wherever Nerzatum roams, endless carnage and ruin follow, and the line between the living and the dead becomes irrelevant.

The Arowana has a silvery or golden body. It's characterized by its elongated, crescent-shaped body and pronounced scales. Its lower jaw is more prominent than its upper jaw, giving it a very powerful bite. Its tongue is hard as bone, which is why it's nicknamed the Bony Tongue Fish, and fishermen know to handle it with care or risk being bitten. It lives in freshwater and warm water temperatures. They are usually seen in the Veder Mountains as well as some regions near Stonegard.

The Fonsiné Barracuda has a gray body dotted with white markings, giving it a distinctive appearance. Its long, stiff body resembles a skewer, and its sharp teeth and fierce temper make it a highly dangerous fish. It's said to be native to the Fonsiné River in Belphoret, but can also be found in Veder Mountains and near Stonegard.

Native to the Belphoret region, the Belphoret Bass is silvery white and pale green, with a darker back and white sides and belly. It has long narrow black stripes on its sides and spiny fins. It's found in the lakes and rivers of almost all regions.

The Largemouth Bass has a sizeable mouth, hence its name. It's characterized by its green back, white belly, and black stripes down the sides of its body. It typically lays around 6,000 eggs. It lives in freshwater, such as lakes with abundant algae, and feeds on fish and insects. Its sharp dorsal fin and large mouth make it a difficult fish to handle. It's usually found in Laslan region.

The Pajama Cardinalfish is a small fish with an unusual habit: when the female spawns, the male carries the eggs in his mouth until they hatch to protect them. While it does this, the male will not eat for two to three months until the young can venture out on their own. It lives in freshwater and has large, reddish eyes and two forked dorsal fins. It has a yellow head and a black band down the middle of its body that looks like a belt. It's usually found in some regions near Laslan and Stonegard.

The Dolly Varden trout has a slender, elongated, flattened body. It has a large mouth with the back of the upper jaw set slightly behind the back of the eyes. Its coloration is yellowish-brown on the dorsal side and silvery-white on the ventral side, with light yellowish-brown rounded spots on the sides and light yellow spots below the lateral line. It's usually found in lakes and rivers in Laslan and Stonegard regions.
The Imp Catalufa is a small fish. Its body is dark orange and red, and its dorsal fin looks like spikes. It is carnivorous and nocturnal. It's found in lakes and rivers in Laslan region.

The Lanquis Barracuda has a body that is brown with a yellowish tinge, and it's characterized by yellow spots and stripes. It's native to the rivers of Lanquis, but is currently found in freshwater throughout Laslan. Fishermen often debate the difference between Lanquis and Fonsiné species.

The Solisium Carp has a body that is streamlined, long, and broad. The body is yellowish-green in color, darker on the back, lighter on the belly, and brown on the sides. Its head is conical, with two pairs of whiskers and well-developed teeth. It's often found around the Sanctum of Desire in Stonegard and in the Northern Forest region.

The Silver Anchovy has a body that is almost oval in shape, with a dark blue color on the back and a silver color in the center and belly. Its scales are easily shed, which is why it's often caught with missing scales. It lives in large schools to protect itself from predators. It's usually found in all shallow seas and grows very quickly, making it a food source for many creatures.

The Pink Cod, popular for its taste, is gray or pinkish on the back and white on the belly. It has numerous spots and wavy lines on its dorsal fin and sides. Schools of Pink Cod are usually found in deeper waters of certain Laslan and Stonegard regions, though it can also be found in shallow waters during spawning season.

The Butterflyfish has a flattened, rounded body. Its mouth is small and protruding. Its coloration is yellow with black vertical stripes across the eyes and body. It lives in coral reefs and is usually only active during the day. Its bright colors and small size make it a popular pet fish. It's found in some regions in Laslan and Stonegard.

The Taion Eel's body is slender and elongated, and flattened at the sides. Its dorsal and caudal fins are connected. It has thick skin that is yellowish-brown with irregular horizontal bands of dark brown. It's a carnivore and eats all kinds of fish and invertebrates. It's bold and has a fierce temper. It lives in schools on reefs in shallow waters, especially coral reefs, in some regions in Laslan and Stonegard.

The Ballan Wrasse has a relatively large head and heavy body, but a small mouth. It is usually emerald in color, and lives in rocky areas and can change from female to male in some environments. It's widely used as a food source. It's found in certain regions in Laslan and Stonegard.

The Amberjack weighs about 100 kg and has a silver body with a purplish-blue back and yellow side stripes. It has sharp teeth and a strong bite, making it difficult to handle when caught. It lives in waters in temperate climates. It's usually found in Laslan and Stonegard regions.

The Barracuda is a large fish, and its body is grayish with a silver-white belly. It has short dark brown horizontal stripes on its back that don't extend beyond the lateral lines. Its fins are also mostly dark brown. It is aggressive and territorial, making it a top predator. It lives mainly in warm, clear waters in Laslan and Stonegard regions.

Found in all of Solisium's oceans, the Aurora Starfish has a distinctive body and arms. It uses its whip-like arms to crawl across the seafloor when moving, and is usually found in some regions in Laslan and Stonegard. It reveals a beautiful rainbow of colors when heated.

The Striped Mackerel is about 10 kg in weight. Its body is silver with several black-blue bands running from the head to the back. Its diet consists of small fish, squid, and crustaceans. It lives mainly in the temperate seas in some regions of Laslan and Stonegard.

The Blacktail Snook has a silvery body with a dark brown line along the sides that extends to the tail. The dorsal fin is gray and darkens toward the tip. The other fins are transparent or yellowish, and the caudal fin is black throughout but lighter at the tip and in the middle. It is mostly found in the oceans in warmer climates, and some regions in Laslan and Stonegard.

The Small-Mouthed Rockfish has a yellow or green body, marked with dark-colored spots and bands. Novice anglers should be careful, as this fish is much stronger than it looks. It prefers cold and clear rivers near Stonegard Coast and in some regions in Talandre.

The Black Bream generally weighs about 2 to 4 kg. It is flat on the sides and its fins are gray or black. In clear waters, it may appear bronze in color. It usually lives in the lower reaches of rivers and feeds on algae that live in the nutrient-rich muds. It's typically found in parts of Talandre, as well as north of Laslan and Stonegard.

The Bluegill is a small fish that lives in freshwater where the current is not strong. It has surprisingly sharp dorsal fins. It's a fast breeding fish due to how well parents protect their eggs from larger predators. It is an omnivorous fish that feeds on a variety of fish species. The upper body is dark green and the belly is yellow. Flaky, tasty, and versatile. It's usually found near Stonegard Coast and in some regions of Talandre.

The Luderick is a fish characterized by its yellow eye color. Luderick come in various colors, but golden ones are most common. Its dorsal and pectoral fins are grayish red, while its other fins are bright red. It mainly lives in clean fresh water with lots of vegetation. It's usually found near Stonegard Coast and in some regions in Talandre.

The Mullet has silver scales and thin stripes, with large eyes and thick lips. Mullet is highly adaptable and survives in various water conditions throughout Solisium. It is a cheap cooking ingredient that is popular among commoners. It's usually found in some regions in Talandre.

The Lanquis Carp is a fish that lives in rivers and streams. It has a gold or olive-colored body, a blunt tail, and rounded back and belly fins. It's not easy to spot because of its dark color, and its skin is very slippery, so people often lose it even after catching it. It's usually found in some regions in Talandre.

The Discus is a fish prized for its gorgeous appearance. It has a disk-like flat body and has vivid colors such as green and red. Its vibrant colors and delicate appearance makes it a popular aquarium fish among the nobles of Solisium. It's often found in Talandre region's freshwater.

The Sunspot Rockfish is characterized by rows of black spots. Its young have a wide orange band on their tails. This fish has a relatively small mouth among other Rockfish. It is notorious for feeding on any small aquatic creature it can fit in its mouth. It lives in freshwater, such as streams and rivers, in parts of Talandre.

The Red Salmon's head is green and the body is red. Salmon usually go back to the sea after spawning, but some of them stay behind in the fresh water and migrate to freshwater lakes. Salmon that live in the fresh water turn red, hence their name. It is popular among anglers because of its distinct taste and striking color. It's usually found in some regions in Talandre.

The Heliber Goldfish, named for its Heliber-like coloring, is characterized by clear, bulging eyes. Its coloration becomes darker and its eyes protrude more as it matures. It's not particularly tasty, but its unique look makes it popular as a pet fish. It's often found in fresh water with weak currents in some regions in Talandre.

The Lanquis Bass is a species commonly found in rivers with warm temperatures throughout Talandre. It has broad gray stripes and a silvery body, contrasting a bright yellow tail and fins. It is known to be an aggressive predator that feeds on shrimp, crab, and small fish.

The Peacock Bass has a distinctive spot on its tail. It feeds on anything it can fit in its mouth. It swallows its prey whole, using a line of teeth in its throat to keep hold of its meal. It tastes delicious when cooked and is considered a luxurious cooking ingredient. It's usually in some regions in Talandre.

The Squid has three parts: head, body, and arms, with both eyes located between the arms and body. It can be found throughout Solisium's sea, from the coast to the deep sea. It is a bioluminescent nocturnal species that is active at night. They are both carnivore and prey, feeding on smaller fish while serving as a primary food source for bigger creatures. It's usually found near Stonegard Coast, around Saurodoma Island, northern Laslan, and Talandre's swamps.

When the Rainbow Ray-Finned Fish is a small fry, it is gray, but as it matures it gains black, blue, green, and red bands on its back. All fries are female when they hatch, but if the conditions are right, some turn into males as they grow, changing their colors as well. This fish lives in seas with a moderate climate, hiding in reefs. It's usually found near Stonegard Coast, around Saurodoma Island, northern Laslan, and Talandre's swamps.

The Blue Filefish is oval and flat. The mouth is small and the teeth are sharp. Its body is black, the back is yellow, and has blue or white spots on the belly. There is a yellow line from the back to the dorsal fin, and the tip of the caudal fin is black. It is popular as an aquarium fish due to its beautiful color. It lives near coral reefs in warm shallow waters near Stonegard Coast, Saurodoma Island, northern Laslan, and Talandre's swamps.

The Mackerel has a bluish back and a silvery white belly. There are dark blue patterns around the dorsal fin. The tail is yellow and the edge is black. It lives in cold clear seas, staying somewhere between the surface and mid depth of the water. In the spring and summer times they stay in the shallow places and move to deeper water in fall. It lays a lot of eggs and has a good taste, which makes it a popular cooking ingredient. It's usually found near Stonegard Coast, around Saurodoma Island, northern Laslan, and Talandre's swamps.

The Horse Mackerel is a common fish known for its distinct flavor. Its back is a soft blue, with lighter silver markings along its sides. The color gets darker closer to the end of the caudal fin. It prefers warm oceans and mainly lives near the coasts. It's usually found near Stonegard Coast, around Saurodoma Island, northern Laslan, and Talandre's swamps.

The Mahi Mahi is a carnivorous fish that feeds on Flying Fish and Squid. Its body is bluish green and its underside is yellowish silver white, with striking green spots all across its body. It lives in warm climates and stays near the water's surface. It sometimes follows around ships or floating objects. It's usually found near Stonegard Coast, around Saurodoma Island, northern Laslan, and Talandre's swamps.

The Skipjack Tuna prefers temperate waters and is only active when it rains. It has no scales on most of its body, with blue on its back contrasting its silver sides and belly. It is characterized by the stripes running down its side and small teeth. The Skipjack Tuna often changes its habitat several times during its life cycle. It's usually found in Talandre's swamps, northern Laslan, and in the valleys east of Stonegard.

The Mantis Shrimp is a carnivorous crustacean that feeds on small fish. Depending on the shape of pincers, they are categorized as either punch-type and spear-type. They generally live in burrows near the coasts in warm climates. Its two prominent, compound eyes are exceptionally sensitive and can move independently. It's usually found in Talandre's swamps, northern Laslan, and in the valleys east of Stonegard.

The Striped Crimson Seabream is reddish-brown, with a brownish face and white cheeks. It has horizontal white stripes along its body. It lives near coral reefs or rocks in Talandre's swamps, northern Laslan, and in the valleys east of Stonegard.

The Pennant Coralfish is a small fish that has vivid black and white band patterns, along with a long dorsal fin and yellow tail. Pennant Coralfish are generally not very flavorful, but some people consider their dorsal fin a delicacy. It's usually found in Talandre's swamps, northern Laslan, and in the valleys east of Stonegard.

The Kahawai is bluish-silver, and there are blue spots on the back. The flesh of Kahawai is a striking red color. In small fishing villages, Kahawai is traditionally prepared by smoking near a bonfire. It's usually found in the shallow waters of Talandre's swamps, northern Laslan, and in the valleys east of Stonegard.

The Blacktip Shark has an angular face and a sturdy, streamlined body which enables it to swim at high speeds. The back side its the body is dark gray, and its belly is white. It is active only when it rains, and is known to be a violent predator, but it tends to avoid humans. It's usually found in Talandre's swamps, northern Laslan, and in the valleys east of Stonegard.

The Ghost Thornfish is a freshwater fish that has been "wraith-ified" by magic. As such, it's unable to die from natural causes. It appears very bony. It dies only if its head is destroyed. No one knows where these bizarre fish came from. It's often seen in the ruins in Laslan regions filled with Deathly Energy, and also near the hills bearing purifying energy.

Unlike other lava fish, the Flame Fish has a little fire elemental in its heart instead of lava. It has a beautiful tail and a body that radiates with a striking red glow, making it popular amongst collectors. It lives at the Lava zone, and feeds on Lava Starfish. It's often found in Syleus's Abyss.

The Ice Smelt is covered with icy scales. It can swim fast with its blue straight fins and tails. According to research, this fish was mutated by Deluzhnoa's powerful energy, and is usually found in rivers and lakes of colder regions. It's only seen near the temple of Deluzhnoa.

The Lava Catfish is covered with thick, igneous skin that can withstand extremely high temperatures. Because it has magma flowing in its veins, its body temperature can reach scorching levels when agitated. When it dies, its body turns into stone after about 10 minutes. It lives in the Lava zone, and feeds on anything that is found in the Lava. It's often found in Syleus's Abyss.

The Lava Eel has magma flowing in its veins and very slippery skin that is resistant to heat. Its body heats up when it encounters enemies, and sometimes it even leads to an explosion. When it dies, the magma in its body cools down and its remain turn to stone. It is usually found at the Lava zone of Syleus's Abyss.

The Lava Starfish is covered with hardened dark skin. Despite being a slow creature, the central part of its body is as hot as lava. It melts rocks to feed on them, and lives at the Lava zone. It's often found in Syleus's Abyss.

The Leaf Sea Horse wears a leaf around it body. It is not a seahorse despite its appearance; it is actually a mutation that has both the characteristics of a plant and animal. According to research, it was born from magic spores that fell into the water. This creature is faster than it looks, and is usually found in certain parts of Laslan's seas.

The Mushroom Jellyfish has a blue body and uses its long tentacles to swim and hunt prey. On special occasions, its head lights up in blue. According to research, it is a species mutated from an ordinary jellyfish that swallowed magic spores, and many adventurers see them as a bad omen. It's usually found near the Crimson Manor in Talandre and the Red Fog Island beyond the swamps.

The Obsidian Starfish is heavier and slower than ordinary starfish. Its body is black and has a blue obsidian stone in the middle. Like other starfish, it moves slowly while consuming microorganisms and obsidian rocks found in the water. It is found in rivers and lakes in some parts of Talandre.

The Sea Cockatrice has skin that is similar to a Drake's. It has distinctive blue fins that looks like wings and an unmistakable chicken-like head. This strange seahorse has spawned countless myths, as well as plenty of scientific debate on its unique biology. It is usually found in Talandre's swamps, Akidu Valley, and Saurodoma Island.

The Swamp Eel has layers of scales on its back. Like the prey it hunts, this eel is brown like mud, and has strong back muscles so that it can swim through thick mud. It's usually found in the Swamp of Silence in Talandre and the Red Fog Island beyond it, and in the Temple of Truth.

The Swamp Mudfish is a brown fish with strong muscles to swim through the swamp's thick mud. It detects preys using the tentacles on its head. It feeds on small larvae and microorganism that live in the mud. It's usually found in the Swamp of Silence in Talandre and the Red Fog Island beyond it, and in the Temple of Truth.

Azure fish species appear across the land during a specific period in summer due to a mysterious magical phenomenon. The Azure Pennant Coralfish's usually yellow body shifts to a bluish hue, with the tips of its fins emitting a soft, blue glow. When darting through coral reefs, it creates the enchanting illusion of a wandering star.

Azure fish species appear across the land during a specific period in summer due to a mysterious magical phenomenon. The Azure Cardinalfish's scales shift to celestial blue and emit a soft bioluminescent glow. While it remains nocturnal, its entire body gently glows in the dark, making it easy to spot even at night.

Its silvery scales gleam like ice as it swims through the water, leaving behind a shimmering afterimage. It can only remain active in cold water, so when temperatures rise at midday, it retreats to greater depths. During spawning season, vast schools of them form beneath the ice.

Hard spines jut out from its dorsal fin to protect it from predators. These spines are so cold that they can freeze your hand if you touch them, and even if they break, they grow back over time. Despite its small size, it can swim incredibly fast, vanishing in an instant like scattered snowflakes.

Its reddish scales stand out vividly through the gaps in the ice, making it easy to spot from far away. Thanks to its powerful swimming ability, it moves boldly through freezing rivers filled with drifting ice. As it matures, its dorsal fin grows sharply upward. In adulthood, it resembles a shard of red ice floating on the water's surface.

Its scales are as white as snow and take on a faint blue sheen in the light. It is timid by nature and is only found at the bottom of deep lakes, even in snowy regions. Some locals believe that catching this fish brings good fortune.

Small ice formations that resemble floating ice grow from its shell. The shell helps preserve body heat and camouflage the turtle as drift ice, which helps it avoid detection by predators above the water. It is primarily found in shallow waters. On snowy days, its disguise is so effective that it becomes difficult to spot.

Its entire body glows with a blue sheen as it swims, leaving behind a soft trail of light. It is extremely agile and threatens predators with its claws when it senses danger, and then quickly turns and flees. It feeds on small fish and hides among the rocks beneath the ice to avoid its enemies.

With its slender, elongated body, it swims like a ghost, leaving only fleeting traces behind. This predatory species is known for its fierce teeth and mainly hunts small fish. Sometimes, at midnight, it leaps above the ocean surface, startling fishers.

Its thin, translucent body is visible beneath the ice, giving the appearance of a floating sheet of ice underwater. It lives close to the bottom and strikes back with its sharp tail when threatened. The colder the water, the more transparent its body becomes.

A catfish with powerful jaws and thick, deep-blue skin. It breaks through ice with its strong jaw, hides in the cracks, and tears into its prey with a single snap. Its distinctive, ice-like teeth earned it the nickname "Frost Spike."

Its scales are as hard as armor, making them difficult to cut, even with a blade. To withstand frigid waters, its body is covered in a layer of bluish fat. With few natural predators, it has a long lifespan, with some specimens surviving for over a hundred years.

A small, teal-colored fish that lives in cold regions. Often found in shallow waters off snowy shores, its glimmering scales make it easy to spot against the snowy backdrop. At night, it emits a green glow, creating a fantastical spectacle beneath the sea.

A herring that travels in schools only in frigid seas. When predators approach, it shifts into dazzling colors to protect the school from attack. Like other herring species, its flesh is rich in oily fat, to the point that it can even be used as fuel.

A cod that follows swift currents and shifts its habitat accordingly. Its scales shimmer with a green sheen, and it usually searches along the bottom for food. Its flesh is firm and highly flavorful, making it a prized ingredient in a variety of dishes.
Known for its large, speedy tail and firm, muscular body. It inhabits the deep sea near glaciers and rarely lets go once it bites. Its blue and silver scales reflect a pale light.

A pufferfish bristling with icicle-like spines in every direction. Its entire body gleams like glass and appears to change color, depending on the angle of the light. It is so sensitive to temperature that it seems as though it would melt with just the touch of a finger.

A sleek shark with a translucent body marked by pale blue and white patterns. It is the fastest predator in the sea. It can regulate its body temperature so it can move swiftly even in frigid waters. The patterns on its back glow faintly, creating the illusion that it has vanished like a ghost.

It dwells in the depths of cold seas. Its body is protected by a long, horn-shaped, spiral shell with mysterious patterns on its surface. When enemies approach, it retreats into its shell and releases a special pigment that confuses them.

It moves slowly through the cold deep sea. It has a dark purple body and an orange glow from the lure on its head. If stung by the venomous barb on the lure, its victim will lose consciousness and become paralyzed from the potent toxin. Though small, it is highly aggressive and even predators do not provoke it lightly.

A species found only in the deep ocean, it emits a faint glow from its vestigial eyes and the patterns on its scales. Though it cannot see, it uses unique sensory organs to detect the flow of water and move accordingly. According to ancient legends, catching this fish invites the wrath of the sea.

A powerful predatory fish that hunts large species, usually lurking beneath the ice for prey. It has a dark blue body and jaws strong enough to break through ice and leap above the surface. Fishers along snowy coasts prefer to fish where the ice is thick to avoid being attacked by this fish.

A species of seahorse that mainly inhabits the deep sea. It is much larger than ordinary seahorses, and its golden fins spread like wings, giving it the appearance of a small dragon. When the patterns etched across its body glow gold, it creates a fantastical sight in the dark depths of the ocean.

A fish with two horns and sharp teeth like a wolf's fangs. It has a highly developed sense of smell, allowing it to easily detect the scent of blood, and it tends to hunt in packs. When pursuing prey, it swims erratically to confuse its target.

A large fish with a powerful, blade-like horn on its head. It can smash through ice as it forces its way through rivers and lakes. It moves in schools, and when the lead fish breaks the ice, the others follow through the opening. According to legend, a river deity transformed into this fish to open a path through frozen waters.

The Magma Axolotl is a mysterious creature that lives in scorching magma, with dark red scales like hardened volcanic rock and orange fins. A kind of axolotl, it has an irresistibly cute appearance, and it emits intense heat from its back, which allows it to swim freely even through lava. At times, it superheats its body and releases an explosive burst of heat to escape danger.

The Infernal Octopus is a giant octopus that has adapted to the extreme environment of lava. Thanks to the fire element that flows through its entire body, it is not harmed by magma. Its skin is dark red, and the searing magic flowing within it pulses with a periodic crimson glow, like the heartbeat of molten lava.

Morokai, the orc who betrayed his clan, is a cruel undead monster who carries his heart atop a magic staff. He has captured countless innocents in Carmine Forest and fed them to the spiders.

Sylaveth Grand Elder Desperion combined the magic of Star Fragments with the aggression of several beasts inside a lion's body. The result was the King Chimaerus, a monstrous chimera with astonishing strength.

While lost in transit, a combat golem absorbed Star Fragments discovered in the desert. Corrupted by its new power source, this construct was transformed into a deadly machine known as Excavator-9, known to demolish anything (and anyone) in its path.

Chernobog, a gold-scaled Basilisk, uses petrification attacks and wields a hammer-shaped tail that possesses tremendous destructive power. It is said that Chernobog's magical powers are derived from a wizard it once swallowed whole, a long time ago.
Before his death, Ancient King Cornelius sealed up his soul in a set of armor using dark magic. Centuries later, a wizard named Syleus used the evil powers of darkness to reanimate this armor.

Skultus, using what he'd learned from Desperion, used the magic of Sylaveth to bolster the queen ant's power. As she grew in size and her chitin turned a glittering gold, they say Skultus whispered, "Golden armor, fit for a Queen."

Talus is a giant golem named after its creator, the wizard Talus. It was created for the purpose of battling the Temitrans in The Raging Wilds. This powerful creation uses nearby rocks to create Stone Golems that help defend its territory.

A horror born of experiments using both human and dark elven dark magic, Minezerok relentlessly massacres humans and absorbs their souls to protect its own unstable form as it guards Sylaveth's sacred place.

The Shadowmancers of the Sylavean Order who gathered in the village of Turayne gazed at the huge Manastone and began to chant a spell. With this, they awakened the body of Adentus, the legendary chief priest of the orcs, as a zombie.

When Greedal injected his apprentice Porfos with the essence of cold, the mutation began, and his rapidly cooling body shattered into pieces. But the pieces soon came back together, and Porfos was resurrected as a lich.

The Shadowmancer Junobote pulled out one of his eyes and dedicated it to an ancient demon. The demon turned the eye into a powerful monster called Malakar and tasked it with guarding the area around the Sanctum of Desire.

Greedal tempted Aridus, who communicated with insects, with the promise of eternal life, and experimented on him by injecting him with the element of desolate earth. Aridus became a lich, ruling over insects in an earthen body.
Frustrated at his miserable fate, Ahzreil became a loyal follower of Sylaveth, who cursed and sought the destruction of Einar—the very god Ahzreil once ardently believed in.
Frustrated at his miserable fate, Ahzreil became a loyal follower of Sylaveth, who cursed and sought the destruction of Einar—the very god Ahzreil once ardently believed in.

Grand Aelon, once a protector of the forest, gradually succumbed to the encroaching dark energy caused by humans' careless influence. Now a merciless monster, Grand Aelon hunts and kills humans who threaten the natural world.

Nirma, a former dark wizard, became the subject of a series of elemental injection experiments. After enduring a seemingly endless cycle of pain, death, and reawakening, she emerged stronger than ever, having gained the power to summon tempests and lightning at will.
Junobote, 9th Elder of Sylaveth, sought out an ancient fiend that had been sealed away to gain dangerous knowledge, and transformed into a demon after seeing the Forbidden Book there.

A violent tyrant named Toublek rules over Saurodoma Island. He has the reptilians' gift of infinite regeneration and can even use sorcery, and thus cannot be killed by even the most devastating attacks.
Young Kuaku, who left his clan, later returned as a giant lycan with ferocious might and terrifying claws. A few years later he became the clan chieftain Kowazan, ruling over numerous clans.

Tevent's soul, once sealed away in the Oath Artifact, found its way into the body of a wizard named Greedal. Following Greedal's death, Kazar resurrected Tevent in the form of an enormous skeletal abomination.

Queen Bellandir can sense magic, and uses a huge sand vortex to catch her prey. It is said that this giant sandworm was created by the wizard Skultus, using power drawn from the Star Fragment of Sylaveth.

The Dolly Varden trout has a slender, elongated, flattened body. It has a large mouth with the back of the upper jaw set slightly behind the back of the eyes. Its coloration is yellowish-brown on the dorsal side and silvery-white on the ventral side, with light yellowish-brown rounded spots on the sides and light yellow spots below the lateral line. It's usually found in lakes and rivers in Laslan and Stonegard regions.

Size: Medium

Native to the Belphoret region, the Belphoret Bass is silvery white and pale green, with a darker back and white sides and belly. It has long narrow black stripes on its sides and spiny fins. It's found in the lakes and rivers of almost all regions.

Size: Small

The Pink Cod, popular for its taste, is gray or pinkish on the back and white on the belly. It has numerous spots and wavy lines on its dorsal fin and sides. Schools of Pink Cod are usually found in deeper waters of certain Laslan and Stonegard regions, though it can also be found in shallow waters during spawning season.

Size: Medium

Found in all of Solisium's oceans, the Aurora Starfish has a distinctive body and arms. It uses its whip-like arms to crawl across the seafloor when moving, and is usually found in some regions in Laslan and Stonegard. It reveals a beautiful rainbow of colors when heated.

Size: Small

The Silver Anchovy has a body that is almost oval in shape, with a dark blue color on the back and a silver color in the center and belly. Its scales are easily shed, which is why it's often caught with missing scales. It lives in large schools to protect itself from predators. It's usually found in all shallow seas and grows very quickly, making it a food source for many creatures.

Size: Small

The Striped Mackerel is about 10 kg in weight. Its body is silver with several black-blue bands running from the head to the back. Its diet consists of small fish, squid, and crustaceans. It lives mainly in the temperate seas in some regions of Laslan and Stonegard.

Size: Medium

The Largemouth Bass has a sizeable mouth, hence its name. It's characterized by its green back, white belly, and black stripes down the sides of its body. It typically lays around 6,000 eggs. It lives in freshwater, such as lakes with abundant algae, and feeds on fish and insects. Its sharp dorsal fin and large mouth make it a difficult fish to handle. It's usually found in Laslan region.

Size: Medium

The Arowana has a silvery or golden body. It's characterized by its elongated, crescent-shaped body and pronounced scales. Its lower jaw is more prominent than its upper jaw, giving it a very powerful bite. Its tongue is hard as bone, which is why it's nicknamed the Bony Tongue Fish, and fishermen know to handle it with care or risk being bitten. It lives in freshwater and warm water temperatures. They are usually seen in the Veder Mountains as well as some regions near Stonegard.

Size: Small

The Amberjack weighs about 100 kg and has a silver body with a purplish-blue back and yellow side stripes. It has sharp teeth and a strong bite, making it difficult to handle when caught. It lives in waters in temperate climates. It's usually found in Laslan and Stonegard regions.

Size: Medium

The Lanquis Barracuda has a body that is brown with a yellowish tinge, and it's characterized by yellow spots and stripes. It's native to the rivers of Lanquis, but is currently found in freshwater throughout Laslan. Fishermen often debate the difference between Lanquis and Fonsiné species.

Size: Medium

The Solisium Carp has a body that is streamlined, long, and broad. The body is yellowish-green in color, darker on the back, lighter on the belly, and brown on the sides. Its head is conical, with two pairs of whiskers and well-developed teeth. It's often found around the Sanctum of Desire in Stonegard and in the Northern Forest region.

Size: Large

The Butterflyfish has a flattened, rounded body. Its mouth is small and protruding. Its coloration is yellow with black vertical stripes across the eyes and body. It lives in coral reefs and is usually only active during the day. Its bright colors and small size make it a popular pet fish. It's found in some regions in Laslan and Stonegard.

Size: Small

The Taion Eel's body is slender and elongated, and flattened at the sides. Its dorsal and caudal fins are connected. It has thick skin that is yellowish-brown with irregular horizontal bands of dark brown. It's a carnivore and eats all kinds of fish and invertebrates. It's bold and has a fierce temper. It lives in schools on reefs in shallow waters, especially coral reefs, in some regions in Laslan and Stonegard.

Size: Medium

The Blacktail Snook has a silvery body with a dark brown line along the sides that extends to the tail. The dorsal fin is gray and darkens toward the tip. The other fins are transparent or yellowish, and the caudal fin is black throughout but lighter at the tip and in the middle. It is mostly found in the oceans in warmer climates, and some regions in Laslan and Stonegard.

Size: Large

The Barracuda is a large fish, and its body is grayish with a silver-white belly. It has short dark brown horizontal stripes on its back that don't extend beyond the lateral lines. Its fins are also mostly dark brown. It is aggressive and territorial, making it a top predator. It lives mainly in warm, clear waters in Laslan and Stonegard regions.

Size: Large

The Ballan Wrasse has a relatively large head and heavy body, but a small mouth. It is usually emerald in color, and lives in rocky areas and can change from female to male in some environments. It's widely used as a food source. It's found in certain regions in Laslan and Stonegard.

Size: Small

The Imp Catalufa is a small fish. Its body is dark orange and red, and its dorsal fin looks like spikes. It is carnivorous and nocturnal. It's found in lakes and rivers in Laslan region.

Size: Small

The Pajama Cardinalfish is a small fish with an unusual habit: when the female spawns, the male carries the eggs in his mouth until they hatch to protect them. While it does this, the male will not eat for two to three months until the young can venture out on their own. It lives in freshwater and has large, reddish eyes and two forked dorsal fins. It has a yellow head and a black band down the middle of its body that looks like a belt. It's usually found in some regions near Laslan and Stonegard.

Size: Small

The Fonsiné Barracuda has a gray body dotted with white markings, giving it a distinctive appearance. Its long, stiff body resembles a skewer, and its sharp teeth and fierce temper make it a highly dangerous fish. It's said to be native to the Fonsiné River in Belphoret, but can also be found in Veder Mountains and near Stonegard.

Size: Medium
