It gets dangerous at night. Make sure you have good weapons.
The weather shouldn't get in the way of crafting a weapon.
Anything else you'd like to see?
Make sure your gear keeps up with your skills, friend!
Leave your materials in Storage. Don't lug them around.
The basic materials for weapons are Manasteel and Mystwood.
No matter how good your weapon is, you have to upgrade it if you want it to really shine.
Why don't you try crafting an Uncommon weapon?
Sorry, but your weapons don't seem to be up to scratch.
That weapon you have looks pretty good!
Hm... To get better weapons, you'll need lots of precious materials.
Want better weapons? Of course it's possible. Let me take a look.
There's a reason such items are rare. It's hard to find their Crafting Scrolls...
I never tire of looking at weapons as excellent as yours!
It'll be hard to get a hold of a weapon better than the one in your hand.
Stop by often. I want to see what new weapons you'll bring!
As an adventurer in Laslan, surely you've heard of Arless, the weapon smith? His Immortus weapons are lethal to the Undead.
If you're planning to hunt Zombies or skeletons, visit a smith named Arless. He should be roaming around Vienta Village.
To make a weapon to fight Immorti, you should find Arless. I hear he's been seen around Vienta Village in Stonegard at night.
Toiho! Just leave your things with me, my friend!
You can ask me anything about weapons, my friend!
A weapon's only as good as its wielder!
Come one, come all! Take a look at our new weapons and armor!
A good weapon is worth ten Amitoi!
Hello, friend! Come on in and look around!
A keen weapon for those with keen skills!
If you want to protect yourself in the dark, you'll need a weapon!
Our weapons that won't rust, not even in the rain!
Friend! Where are you off to without any weapon?
Don't go out there empty-handed! Take a look at our fine weapons and armor!
High-grade equipment is precious... You need to make it yourself.
It's not enough to buy gear, you have to maintain it! But you know that.
A good weapon means taking fewer attacks.
If you go to Artisan Street by Kastleton Market, you can craft things yourself.
If you don't have the materials, you should try using ready-made goods instead. Take a look around!
I don't have any Uncommon equipment, but anything is better than going empty-handed!
It's very dangerous to leave the village without a weapon...
Toiho! How are you, my friend?
On the road, the best companion is a good blade!
Choose a piece of equipment you fell in love with, you usually won't regret it!
Who are you? I can't believe someone is still alive in this place...
Haha... I'll give you something you'll remember for a lifetime!
I don't want you to die too easily!
Ow, my head... Is this how you made me?
Death comes for you. There is no escaping it.
Let me lead you to your doom!
Ugh... Soon, it will be the dawn of Sylaveth's new age...
Have you ever faced the Despairing Abyss?
Don't forget: death brings the risk of resurrection.
May Syleus' world reign one day.
Shall I teach you the meaning of pain?
I will repay your mana with despair!
It is meaningless. There is nothing but pain...
Come on. I'll welcome you anytime. Hahaha!
It's quiet now. I won't forgive this commotion in Carmine Forest.
This is good prey. Children, wait just a moment.
Can you hear my heartbeat? It's the last sound you'll ever hear!
I will hunt you down to kill you as long as I draw breath in my lungs!
I can't lose...! I can't die!
My beloved Spiders must not starve. I'll have to find something else to hunt!
Ha... What's the point of immortality?
Yes, yes, you're the only ones who truly console me.
Shush now... I've come all this way to reap your souls.
Oh, this doesn't taste so bad!
I will grant you a beautiful death!
For it all to have been in vain!
I refuse to go back again!
Hmm... which soul should I choose?
Lord, may you give me the strength to slay my enemies!
Whoever invaded the king's territory will make it out alive!
I will be back, no matter what!
Where are those... who can appease my grudge...?
My rage will last for eternity!
May you slumber in eternal darkness!
How far will you run this time?
It's no use fleeing. All intruders will die.
Your death is a necessary sacrifice.
I'll burn your soul until there is nothing left but ash and dust!
I will use the souls offered to me... completely!
Chase them to the ends of the abyss!
The fury of the icy cold will overtake you all.
I'll give you a taste of this pain!
I will burn everything I see!
I will burn everything I see!
Pathetic. That was just a tickle!
Do you truly think you can survive?
Just give it up, now. You cannot evade the specter of death.
Prepare yourself. The final rite will at long last begin!
Your soul is ripe for the taking!
Why don't you follow your friends down to hell already?
Did you hear? That is the requiem for your souls.
Hm, there aren't enough people in the audience.
You look relaxed. What are you gawking at?
I wasn't even close to being done... Tsk tsk.
I don't need applause! Let's get straight to the point!
Hm, I shall show everyone a piece of my sincerity.
The cold winds and icy earth will never forget you!
The cold winds and icy earth will never forget you!
Fury and fear be upon you!
There is nowhere to run! Pay for your sins!
This is the price of sin!
The forest will be revived with your life!
The forest is eternal. I, Grand Aelon, am its caretaker.
Even the sky weeps for the cursed forest.
Pitiful beings with no concept of introspection... You keep repeating the same sin...
Have you come to sully the forest again?
Ugly creatures gnawing at the forest!
The forest's grudge is eternal. Never forget!
I will not forget the sin of the rootless...
Now only the energy of death surrounds me...
If only I could purify this land, I would swallow the darkness...
Want to check out the fresh ingredients that just came in today?
When it comes to cooking, it's the ingredients that decide the outcome.
Welcome! Take your time and have a good look around.
Ah, perfect timing! We've got fresh ingredients in again today.
I'll take your ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Star Fragment^</c>, even if I have to pry it from your corpse!
Argh... You won't be able to escape ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Lord Kazar^</c> until the day you die...
I am ^<c=@MK_D_Selection>looking for a red flower^</c>. I have this token.
Yes, welcome. Good, I see you have Clay's token. Suspicious folk have been asking about Martinay lately, we suspect they're with the ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Arkeum^</c>.
I don't know what the nefarious Arkeum want with her, but under these circumstances, we have no choice but to be wary of outsiders seeking Martinay.

Oh, sorry for stalling. You need the rest of the passphrase to find Martinay. The first part of the phrase is ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>"The Light Fragment."^</c> Ask the Skills Researcher for the other half. Just say that you are looking for a red flower.
Sorry, what was the first part of the password again?
Did you forget? The first half of the password is ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>"The Light Fragment"^</c>. You'll have to go and ask the Skill Researcher for the rest.
Are you okay? Can you fight?
The people from Arkeum were looking for a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Star Fragment^</c>. Watch out - they might be after you, too. Let's start by finding a clue!
Huh? What kind of book is this?
We've looked everywhere here. Let's check the second floor!
What's important is finding a way to master the power of the Star Fragment!
Ah, could you help me with one more thing?
Is there anything I can do to help?
These Golden Rye Pastures are a breadbasket of this region, but enlarged insects are negatively impacting our yield.
My master concocted some pesticide, but a bunch of goblins mistook the sacks of pesticide for sacks of grain and ran off with them. They eventually realized their mistake, though.
They dumped them all over the farm, and we're having trouble retrieving them all. Would you please bring them to us, if you ever find one?
Ah... When did we run out of this?
Oh, uh... You mean you already gathered all the ingredients? It's just... I've made a bit of a mistake.

Well... When I went to look for the last ingredient, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mandrake Root^</c>, I discovered that we were all out. I was so sure we had some left. This kind of incompetence is probably why I can't gain the master's approval.
It'll be ok. Don't be so hard on yourself.

Forgive me, I'm complaining without good reason. Anyway, the Herbalist isn't here, so I can't leave the apothecary. You'll probably have to find the last ingredient yourself. You'll be able to get a Mandrake Root at the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mandrake Farmstead^</c> on the east side of the farm.
After acquiring the final ingredient, go and find my master on ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Windhill Shores^</c>. He'll make you what you want.
Tell me about the materials again.
Go and get the last ingredient, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mandrake Root^</c>, from the Mandrake Farmstead on the east side of the farm. Then, go see my master at Windhill Shores.
It sounds like people are moving around behind the entrance.
Nothing's happening at the Lighthouse right now.
There's nothing else to do at the Lighthouse right now.
Open the door to enter the lighthouse.
I am ^<c=@MK_D_Selection>looking for a red flower^</c>.

So, Clay sent you. The second half of the password is ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>"whispers."^</c> You want to meet with Martinay? Head to the Kastleton Infirmary on the north side of town. Say the password, and you'll be allowed to enter.

By the way, many of the townsfolk, including myself, have been brought to health by Martinay's healing skills. Please take care not to let anything happen to her. Keep an eye out for anyone suspicious on your tail, just in case.
Hi, me again. Can I get the second part of the password again?
The second half of the password is ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>"whispers."^</c> Say it to get into the Kastleton Infirmary on the north side of town.
Oh, what a life! Growing difficult plants like mandrakes was a foolish choice.
Welcome to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mandrake Farmstead^</c>, where we grow 'em with love from seed to harvest! If it's fresh Mandrakes you need, you've come to the right farm.
I am looking for Mandrake Root.
Oh my, I've just run out of roots. How about ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>collecting^</c> as many as you need yourself? And in exchange, you can have everything for free!
I'll do what I can to gather them.

Then, try harvesting the roots from the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mandrakes^</c> planted out in the field. Oh, by the way, Mandrakes will turn violent when you try to harvest their roots, so be extra careful.
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mandrakes^</c> don't like it when you try to harvest their roots, so be careful!
You must be on your way to find the old Herbalist. I just happened to see him on ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Windhill Shores^</c>. Try looking for him there!
There's a notice saying it's closed. There's no response.
There's a notice saying it's closed. There's no response.
There's a notice saying it's closed. There's no response.
There's a notice saying they're closed, and despite your knocks, there's no answer. You try to remember the password you learned. The password was...
There's a notice saying they're closed, and despite your knocks, there's no answer. You try to remember the password you learned.
Try to think of the second half of the password.
You sense someone's presence beyond the entrance and hear the click of a lock being opened.
You sense someone's presence beyond the entrance and hear the click of a lock being opened.
There is still no answer. It seems like that wasn't the password.
There are no signs of life. Martinay must also have left.
You can sense someone on the other side of the door, but the door is not locked.
Open the door and go inside
I put the calming potion on the table. Try drinking it.
Adventurer, because of you, I was able to hear about my sister before it was too late. Thank you.
Now that her hiding place has been exposed, Zaroth's men will find this clinic sooner or later, putting the villagers in great danger.
So, I also decided to leave before it's too late. I wish I could have created a true cure for you... I'm sorry.

My calming potion won't be enough to fully control your mana. It's too powerful. But it'll keep it from raging out of control for the time being. I'll focus on developing a proper, long-term treatment.
When we meet again, I'll be able to cure you completely. Until then, please take care of yourself and be safe out there. Don't forget that Zaroth and the Arkeum Legion could be after you.
I've got Clay's token, and I...
This is... ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Clay's token^</c>. Einar reveals the truth in mysterious ways. I see you have no evil intentions.

^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Martinay^</c> is currently in hiding. You will need a secret ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>passphrase^</c> to meet with her. It's a safety measure to protect her from the ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Arkeum^</c>.

To get the first part of the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>passphrase^</c>, speak with the local Sundries Merchant. Tell them ^<c=@MK_D_Selection>you are looking for a red flower^</c>, and show Clay's token. Then, you will receive their part of the phrase.
There's something else I'm curious about.
You still have unanswered questions, I see.

^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Waypoints^</c> are one of the greatest implementations of Venelux magic. They allow you to instantly traverse from one location to another. Originally, teleportation was a spell that only the most skilled wizards were able to cast, by creating distortions between spaces using the elements of wind and earth.

It was the wizard ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Clay^</c> who completed the schema to make Waypoints, so that teleportation could be accessible to everyone. Anyone can use a Waypoint without any special training.

Try placing your hand on the Waypoints in the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>plaza^</c> and at the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Golden Rye Pastures^</c>. Afterwards, talk to Resistance Officer Ashton. He'll explain the rest.
Huh...? You must have come to see Martinay.
After speaking with you, I told Martinay about her sister, and she left to find a new treatment.
She asked me to give you a letter if I ever met you... It's over there. Give it a read.
Don't worry too much about Martinay and Adriana. They'll be reunited.
I'll clean this place up. You take care of yourself.
How do you operate the Waypoints?
Ah, looks like it's your first time using a Waypoint! If you place your hand on a Waypoint, the schema will be activated and the stone will ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>glow blue^</c>.
Open your ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>map^</c> and select a Waypoint activated with blue light. You will be instantly transported to that location.
The tools Martinay used to make the medicine are lying on the desk.
There is a completed Mana Calming Potion on the desk.
Thanks for the Mana Calming Potion.
Thanks for the Mana Calming Potion.
I can't find the ingredients. My assistant should be here to help, but... Hey, how about you lend me a hand?
Master isn't here right now. Please come back next time.
We don't get too many visitors around here. Have you been looking for me?
An ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Oath of the Resistance^</c> is inscribed upon the Monument Stone.
It's a magnificent monument stone. "Resistance Oath Stone" is written on it.

"I, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>DaVinci Aaron^</c>, as the^<c=@Codex_AD_HN>
leader of the Laslan Allied Resistance Forces,^</c>
hereby erect this Monument Stone to honor the heroes
who dedicated their lives to the will of the Resistance."
"Those who seek to become part of the ^<c=@Codex_AD_HN>Resistance^</c> must take their oath with the desire in their heart to follow the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>will of the Resistance^</c> engraved here."
"As of this moment, I have become part of the honorable Resistance and will ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>defend the peace of Solisium^</c>."
"I will fight, standing on the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>side of righteousness^</c>, against the ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Arkeum Legion^</c> that threatens this land."
"I will ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>complete^</c> ^<c=@MK_UI_Contract>contracts^</c> and never ignore the plight of those who need assistance."
"I hereby swear as I take this ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>pledge^</c>."
I haven't seen you around before. So what brings you here?
Hi, I've come to ask about healing.
As I'm sure you heard on your way here, I can't treat anyone right now unless it's an emergency. Would you mind coming back later?
Oh, I see... Clay probably sent you to help with my research. The truth is, my sister is also suffering from the same symptoms as yours, and I've been searching for a ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>cure^</c>.
The ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Mana Calming Potion^</c> I'm creating should be able to help. Let's see... Oh, drat! I just used my last batch of ingredients.
Then, I'll tell you where to go and what I need. Head to the ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Golden Apothecary^</c> in the Golden Rye Pastures, you'll be able to find some Rancid Powder.
Just get me some ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Rancid Powder^</c>, and I'll whip up a Mana Calming Potion for you.
Glad to see you feeling better.
I thought the master had given up on me, but now I know that's not true... Hahaha... Ah, I'm sorry you had to hear all that.
Um... Do you need something from the master?
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Rancid Powder^</c>? Well, I know how to make it, but... No, no, please forget what I just said.
I can't. I haven't received the master's approval yet. What if I just tell you the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>ingredients^</c> you need, and you can gather them and find him yourself?
Collect Decomposed Hearts from ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Violent Harvesters^</c>, Poison Stingers from ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Wasps^</c>, and Contaminated Horns from ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Scarabs^</c>.

Come back here with all of those, and I'll give you the last ingredient. Then, if you take all the ingredients to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Windhill Shores^</c> and find my master, he'll make the powder for you.
I'll need some Rancid Powder in order to create a Mana Calming Potion. You can obtain Rancid Powder from the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Golden Apothecary^</c> over at the Golden Rye Pastures.
What were ingredients in Rancid Powder again?

Collect Decomposed Hearts from ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Violent Harvesters^</c>, Poison Stingers from ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Wasps^</c>, and Contaminated Horns from ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Scarabs^</c>. Return to me once you have the ingredients.
Oliver told me how he felt after he met with you. I should have talked to him earlier.
Huh? These are the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>ingredients^</c> needed to make Rancid Powder. Martinay must have sent you. But how did you know about these ingredients?
Your apprentice told me about it.
Oliver, that clever boy... How did he figure this out already? He's quite bright.
Herbalists have to go to perilous places to acquire ingredients, but Oliver can't even stand the sight of a mere ant. I'm waiting for him to overcome his fears.
Well, I'll make the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Rancid Powder^</c> for you right away. It must be urgent for you to come all the way out here, but look at me, rambling on.
Here's your Rancid Powder. Planning to go straight back to Martinay? In that case, why don't you try opening your map and teleporting to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Kastleton^</c>?
Aren't you on your way back to Martinay? If you open up your map and teleport to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Kastleton^</c>, you'll get there quickly.
You're back. Did you get some Rancid Powder?
Here's some Rancid Powder I had made.
Good work. The ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Rancid^</c> Powder you brought is excellent in quality.
Just as I thought! It's much more effective. I tried to improve the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>efficacy^</c>, but I didn't expect the results to be this good...
The calming potion's effect is very effective this time. I need to bring this to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>my sister^</c> right away. But as you know, I'm in no position to be wandering around outside...
You helped me, so I'll help you.
Oh, thank you so much. I made this potion earlier, and I used the same method to create it once more. Please pass it this to my sister's friend, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mina Pye^</c>.
Mina is able to send anything to my sister on my behalf. We keep it this way since I don't know if Arkeum forces will ever catch up with me.

I've stabilized your power with the Calming Potion, but your Star Fragment power could be revealed at any moment. Hmm, it would be reassuring if you had a more powerful weapon... Do you have some Weapon Growthstones?
Huh? How can I help you?
Were you able to find any clues that might help you out? Hopefully, you and Adriana can be free of the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mauvessence^</c> soon.
Here is the Mana Calming Potion.

Seeing that you brought the Calming Potion, I'm pretty sure that Martinay must have sent you. If she sent this out of the blue in such a hurry, then things probably worked out well for her. Sorry, but ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Adriana^</c> isn't exactly here right now.
Not long ago, Zaroth's men found Adriana's hideout. Last night, Adriana said she would have to run far away to escape him.

Martinay's calming potion wasn't enough to fully control Adriana's ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>power^</c>. Adriana didn't tell me where she was going, but she would find a way to suppress her mana, away from Arkeum's eyes.
There might be some clues left in the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Lighthouse^</c> where Adriana stayed. Right, I'd better go break the news to Martinay. By now, Adriana should be out of Laslan.
There's a pile of books. It looks like research materials someone left.
It appears to be someone's diary. There doesn't seem to be any information to be gained here.
The hole in the book makes it difficult to read the contents. From what you can discern, the book seems to be about the history of the Casill family.
Judging by the decoration on the book's cover, it doesn't seem like just any old book.
The open book catches your eyes. It seems to be a research book written by Adriana.
It's full of complicated magic schema. On the margins of the page are words that have been stained by tears.
"I can't forget that horrible nightmare I had. So many people in despair... All of them writhing in pain..."
"With time, my memories became clearer. It's agonizing, but I just can't give up. At the very least for Martinay's sake..."
There's a book on the chest.
It appears to be her diary. You examine the most recent entry.
"I felt someone's presence in my sleep. I thought it was just Mina at first. But then I could tell from the heavy footsteps that the intruder was someone I didn't know."
"I quickly hid myself and watched the intruder pass by. The pattern engraved on their sword meant that they were part of the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Arkeum Legion^</c>."
"Just why are the Arkeum looking for me again? I can't allow that ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>tragedy^</c> to be repeated. It's probably time for me to leave. At the very least Martinay will be safe."
Considering that it has less dust on it, it seems this book was used more recently.
Adriana used to live inside that ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Lighthouse^</c>. There might be some clues left inside. Check it out.
There doesn't seem to be any more useful information in the chest. You should just leave it until Adriana returns.
It's a chest with an eye-catching flower decoration. It's locked and can't be opened.
The chest has the same decoration as the key.
It's full of Adriana's things. You notice a parchment with dense writing on it.
"Just who is Janice Cartair, anyway? She recognized my power immediately and knew that as long as I possessed it, I would be targeted by ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Arkeum^</c> for the rest of my life."
"She ended up telling me that the only way to truly be free from the Arkeum was to leave as soon as possible and find some way to gain control over my ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>power^</c>."
It's an old chair someone used. It looks like the oldest item in the room.
It looks like she spent a lot of time in this chair. What decision did she come to in the end?
I too will fufill this Oath.
Urgh, I can't lose to some kid...!
Open the chest with the key.
You insert the key and turn, and the chest opens.
"And she said she wanted to leave a clue for people like me, and that she would record what she saw and heard from me in the Scales of Time."
How did people manage to do all these difficult tasks in the past?
Never seen a magic golem before? Haha! Feel free to look at it as much as you want!
Ahem... I'm afraid he's not available at the moment. Please come back later.
You know how to use ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Waypoints^</c>, right? If you aren't sure, go ask Priestess Grace. Using them makes it a breeze to return after procuring materials.
Your symptoms are clearly getting worse. Hurry, bring me some Rancid Powder!
I'll make the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mana Calming Potion^</c> for you right away.
Alright, here you are. Why don't you try it and see ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>how it works^</c>?

And she asked me to wait to tell Martinay about this as long as possible, because she didn't want her to follow her. I think Adriana felt that the only way to protect Martinay was to stay away from her.
There's a giant hole in the front! I think we can go down there.
There's something huge over there. Be careful.
Wow, that guy is coming on strong.
Because of the electricity flowing in the water, it's hard to get closer.
We'll have to jump carefully so we don't fall into the water.
It looks like that Crackel is generating electricity.
Electricity! Hurry out of the water!
It might've become too strong now.
Now, let's find the bait from the chest!
(Oh, that doll...) ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>, you should take that doll, too!

To make skills stronger, you need the appropriate ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Skill Growth Book^</c> for the skill's grade. For example, if you want to grow an ^<c=@ItemGradekB>Uncommon Skill^</c>, you'll need an ^<c=@ItemGradekB>Uncommon Skill Growth Book^</c>.
How do you make skills stronger?
Say... didn't you visit me before?
I knew it. Thank you for helping out Martinay. I will prepare special items for you, just this once.
Create Skill Growth Books to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>grow^</c> the skills you want. It's easy once you get started.
Good, good, you've learned a new skill. Once you've acquired a new skill, you can enhance it using a Skill Growth Solution.
For Uncommon Skills, you need Quality Growth Solutions. For Rare Skills, you need Rare Growth Solutions.
Why don't you go ahead and give it a try? Collect all of the necessary ingredients, craft a Quality Solution, and then use it to enhance one of the skills you've learned.
Experienced adventurers can use ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>skill specializations^</c>. Depending on the trait you choose, the same skill will have a completely different effect.
Is there anything else I should know?
Once you've gained enough experience, consider building your own ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>skill specializations^</c>. They'll help you in your future battles with Arkeum.
Okay, then come find me when you need Skill Books or Growth Solutions.
Not an issue for me, I'm fine.
Not an issue for me, I'm fine.
Adventurer! Uh... just forget it. (This person seems busy with other work, perhaps they won't help even if I ask...)
There's not much time left. What should I do...?
Adventurer! I'm doing my best to train and become the very best hunter I can be.
Hopefully I'll be able to meet the hero who saved my life if I end up becoming a famous hunter?
Adventurer! Oh, uh, never mind! (This person looks too weak to fend off a wolf...)
There's something I desperately need, but no one will even listen to me. Couldn't you find it in your heart to help me out, Adventurer?

Have you ever heard of ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Iskale^</c> the Gray-Fanged? He was this dreadful wolf that possessed terrible Mauvessence. Back in my younger days, I almost ended up getting killed by Iskale.

The only reason I'm alive to speak to you about this today is that ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Henry^</c>, the lord's son, came to rescue me and the other children. He heroically sacrificed his own life to defeat Iskale...
Whenever I get the chance, I try to visit Henry's grave in Kastleton Abbey to leave some offerings. Last time, I made some gloves for him using the hide of a rabbit that I caught!
The anniversary of Henry's death is coming soon, so I'd like to prepare a special ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>gift^</c> for his grave...
I saw a beautifully-crafted ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Keepsake^</c> at an old hunter's house once. He said he got it from participating in the Wolf Hunting Contest that is held in Henry's memory.
I wish I could get one of those Keepsakes and bring it Henry's grave, but I'm still too young to participate in the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>contest^</c>...
Y'know what, I'll get you a Keepsake.
You don't mind? You'll really get one of those Keepsakes for me? If that's the case, then I... No, never mind.
Hmm, there's got to be more to this.
Actually, it would be nice if I could have ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>two^</c> of these Keepsakes. Do you think it'd be possible to get two?
Thank you so much, Adventurer! The contest is hosted at the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Lord's Residence^</c> in Kastleton. Go there and ask how you can participate.
Oh? You couldn't find the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Lord's Residence^</c>? You must get lost pretty easily.
Okay, listen carefully. The Lord's Residence is in the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>northeastern part of Kastleton^</c>. It's a huge building with a garden, it's hard to miss!
So many things to do! Making arrangements for the contest, checking up on the farm...
I hear there's a Wolf Hunting Contest.
I hear there's a Wolf Hunting Contest.
My sincere apologies. I should have told you in advance that the Keepsakes were only given out in the past...
Still, the contest was held without a hitch because of you!
I know that you've come a long way, but our situation is pretty bad. We might even have to shut down the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>contest^</c> at this rate!
We must lure the wolves to proceed with the contest, but the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>bait^</c> we've been using just isn't working.
Lord Hobs cherishes this contest. He hasn't missed a single one! You have no idea how much trouble I'll be in if this year's event falls flat...
Wait. If you're here for the contest, can you please help me? I need some ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>ingredients^</c> to make a new kind of bait!
I'm after some Wolf Hunting Keepsakes.
A Wolf Hunting Keepsake? But that's... No, never mind! First you need to help me procure the ingredients needed for the bait, okay?

Please defeat ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Crackel^</c> in the wrecks on ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Windhill Shores^</c>. They're tricky to find, but the wolves love eating them. The stench of Crackel meat is irresistible bait for beasts like them.
Also, investigate any ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>chests^</c> that are left in the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Wrecks^</c>. They often contain fishing bait, which is quite effective as well.

Please remember, Crackel are difficult prey to hunt, so you should equip at least ^<c=@ItemGradekB>Uncommon level armor^</c>. Why don't you pay a visit to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Armor Crafter Rachel^</c>? I've already dropped a word with her.
Oh, you forgot where to get the ingredients for the Bait? Explore the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>wrecks^</c> on ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Windhill Shores^</c>!
You have to go to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Windhill Shores^</c> to get the ingredients you need to make the wolf Bait? It's supposedly located south of the village.
I'll be waiting for you over here while you get the Keepsakes!
Here are the ingredients I gathered.
That was fast! Thanks to you, the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>contest^</c> will go on!
So about the Wolf Hunting Keepsake...

Hm... Why don't you ask ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Chris^</c>, the head of the Association? He's also the lord's younger brother. He must be preparing for the contest at the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Western Campsite^</c> on the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Blackhowl Plains^</c>.
Use those ingredients to make some ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>bait^</c>, then bring it to Chris. Since you did all the work, you should be the one to deliver it to him. That way he can thank you in person!

Take the exit on the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>second floor of the Lord's Residence^</c> and head up to the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Kastleton Abbey^</c>. You'll find an ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Aged Herb Extract Jar^</c>. Steeping the ingredients in those jars makes the ^<c=@MK_D_Quote>bait^</c> extra fragrant and effective.
Chris is probably worried that the contest might not take place. On your way there, please send my letter to him via ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Parrot Mail^</c> to let him know the bait is on the way.
Oh, and just so you know, there's a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Waypoint^</c> in the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Blackhowl Plains^</c>, too. It will make traveling there much easier.
The ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Blackhowl Plains^</c>? You'll find them north of Kastleton. They are a large grassland with a lake in the middle.
What is it? My apologies, but I'm busy with the Hunting Contest, so please come back later!
Where is the person the Lord's Aide was supposed to send? Maybe we should postpone the contest...
Are you interested in the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Wolf Hunting Contest^</c>? It's a famous contest which attracts the best hunters in Laslan.
It started in honor of my nephew, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Henry^</c>, the hero of Kastleton.
Oh, you're the adventurer my aide told me about!
Wait, is that new wolf bait? Good, the old bait didn't work very well. I'm grateful for your help.
The ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Hunting Contest^</c> is the pride of Kastleton. Are you here to make a name for yourself?
There's a girl in Kastleton who wants Wolf Hunting Keepsakes...
What? ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Wolf Hunting Keepsakes^</c>? They were only given out in the early days of the contest... Our aide must have been mistaken.
But I am really touched by your story. I can't believe the children my nephew saved still remember him... It's something to be thankful for.
I have an idea. You should speak with the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>artisan^</c> who made the Keepsakes in the past. Find him, and tell him I sent you. Be warned though, the materials are hard to come by...
Are you willing to get them yourself? If so, you're going to need to collect ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Broken Wolf Fangs^</c> and ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Radiant Antler Fragments^</c>.

Wolf Fangs can be acquired by hunting ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Wolves^</c> on the plains. Deer Antlers can be found near ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Hamel's Tomb^</c>. That's where the deer of the plains go to end their lives.

You don't know about ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Hamel^</c>? Hamel was a mysterious deer that protected the Blackhowl Plains. The villagers believed Hamel was ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>sacred^</c>, and could travel through both time and dreams.

Hamel drove Iskale out once, but the monstrous wolf returned with a mighty ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mauvessence^</c>. He killed Hamel and took my nephew's life. If it hadn't been for that evil Mauvessence...

Lately, I've been seeing more ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Star-Born^</c> in the village. I have to admit, they make me a bit uneasy. With such strange powers, any one of them has the potential to turn out just like Iskale... I don't like to think about it.
Once you collect the materials, you'll need to visit the artisan named ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Thomas^</c> in ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Kastleton^</c>. Tell him it's a favor for me and he'll happily oblige.
Do me a favor? On your way to Hamel's Tomb, stop by the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Watchtower^</c> and light a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>beacon fire^</c>. It's a signal that the Wolf Hunting Contest will resume soon.
You can find Broken Wolf Fangs by hunting the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>wolves^</c> on the Plains.
Look for Radiant Deer Antlers around ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Hamel's Tomb^</c>. The antlers of the deer that die there glow with a mysterious light.
The ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Wolf Hunting Contest^</c> began in honor of Henry, the hero who saved the village from Iskale.
The contest helps us reduce the number of wolves in the Blackhowl Plains, so it's helpful for the village.
Did you hear that...? It's probably best if you don't tell people you're a Star-Born!
(Hiccup)... Sweet Ukarak... I don't even have money for another drink. Eh, who're you?
I heard you gave the Keepsakes to the girl. She was so thankful for your help!
Were you the artisan who made the Wolf Hunting Contest Keepsakes?
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Keepsakes^</c>? Yeah, I made 'em. Hic. But I made my last one a long, long time ago. It's been so long, I can't even remember how to use my tools...
I may not look it, but I'm... very anxious. Whenever I begin a new project, I become consumed with doubt, and indecision, and... (Hiccup).
Please, it would mean so much to Soiri.
Eh, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Soiri^</c>...? You mean, that girl Henry saved? But, I-I'd just mess it up, and disappoint her. And not just one, but two? No, I can't!
A master artisan never forgets their craft. I believe in you.
Alright, fine! I'll try! But I-I need total silence to work, so please don't make a sound!

Anyway, I hope Soiri likes 'em. It feels great to pick up my tools again and get a bit of my old confidence back. I want to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>make you something^</c>, too! ... Someday, I don't feel quite ready yet.
(Hiccup) Actually, you should visit ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Adrian, the Skills Researcher^</c>. A strong set of skills can make you more powerful. Tell him I sent you and he'll be good to you.
And I owe it all to you! Thanks, for helping me pick up my tools again. And nice to hear Soiri hasn't forgotten what ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Henry^</c> did for her, even after ten years.
Did you know ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Hamel sent a champion^</c> to fight with Henry the day he faced down Iskale? I saw it with my own eyes! It was... a miracle.
You know what's even more amazing, friend? A mysterious messenger from Hamel helped the young lord that day! I saw it myself! (Hiccup)
I'd make you something, my friend, but... I'm not good enough yet! If you equip good accessories, you'll be much stronger...
D-did you give the Keepsakes I made to the girl? I hope she likes them...
(Hiccup) Can't seem to get buzzed, no matter how much I drink...
Oh, I'm not here to drink. I came to meet someone who wanted an accessory crafted. Whew, I'm pretty nervous...
I'm curious about the Wolf Hunting Keepsakes.
You're a real lifesaver! Thank you so much! I'm so happy that you did all this for me!
I'll put this Keepsake to good use. I'll offer it at ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Henry^</c>'s grave to let him know the Hunting Contest is still being held in his name.
Why did you need two Keepsakes?
Actually... We weren't just saved by Henry. There happens to be another ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>hero^</c> who came to save us that day. However, that person vanished without even saying a word.
Do you think I'll meet that other hero some day? If I ever do, I'll hold onto this other Keepsake so I can give it to them.
Oh, if you have the time, you should go visit Henry's grave. You'll be able to find his tomb over in the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Abbey^</c>, that's the place where Henry fought Iskale...
Oh, really? That'd be real nice! ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Kastleton Abbey^</c> is located on a hill that's somewhere between the town and the Plains!
Oh, did you forget where the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Abbey^</c> is? You can find it somewhere between the town and Blackhowl Plains!
It's an old oil container. It bears traces of soot from a raging fire.
It's an empty oil container. It has scorch marks.
It's an oil container that was there when you met Henry, too. It bears traces of soot.
It seems possessed by a brilliant light. A Keepsake made with a material such as this would be worth boasting about.
They're the remnants of large deer antlers. Fascinatingly, they're shining with beautiful light.
It's a tombstone for the hero, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Henry^</c>. May he who sacrificed everything for the village rest in peace.
An unusually well-kept tomb that stands out. It seems to be the grave of someone famous.
It's a tombstone honoring a hero.
It's full of bottles of oil. It seems the oil used for lamps in the village is stored at the Abbey.
I'll just take a look inside the bottle.
The bottle is full of oil.
It would be better not to play with fire nearby.
Thank you! I couldn't have fought them off without you.
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Iskale^</c> is leading wolves to attack the village. What happened to the others in the Abbey? What about the kids?
Oh? Come to think of it... You're not from our village, are you? How did you end up in a dangerous place like this...?
You must leave! The wolves will be here soon. If you head downhill, you'll find the village. You'll be safe there.
I have to look after the others here. The wolves attacked and the people in the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Abbey^</c> weren't able to flee to the village.
There are ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>young children^</c> among them. We must rescue them quickly... If they're still alive.
Really? It will be dangerous, but... Thank you.
There was no one inside or behind the Abbey. Let's look below.
Ack! The children are in danger!
Did you come here to save us? I want to go home...
I couldn't save everyone, but... thanks to you the children are safe.
The wolves could be back any minute. I must get ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>them^</c> to the village.
It won't be easy to protect the children while we make our way down in the dark. Can you help me once more?
Yes, I'll gladly give you a hand.
Thank you. I don't know where you came from, but I'll never forget your kindness.
Oh, I haven't properly introduced myself yet. My name is ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Henry Kastler^</c>.
Would you mind telling me your name?
I'll lead the way. Please check on the children to make sure they are keeping up.
Did he say Henry just now? He can't be...
Uh... Who are you...? Are those scary wolves still around?
Hello, I've come to rescue you.
Uh... You just saved my life...
Those wolves were just outside the door... And I... I felt so terrified... I felt for sure I was going to die then and there.
Hello, my name is ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Soiri^</c>. What should I call you, adventurer?
Here! Come over here for a minute!
Shh! Let's keep our voices down. Henry mustn't overhear.
Isn't it strange? Iskale died ten years ago! And Henry, too...
I'm not sure what's happening either.
If this is the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>past^</c>, couldn't we help Henry to survive?
Um, of course our survival comes first! But if the Alpha Wolves are this strong, how awful must Iskale be?
We really appreciate your help here...
I'm sorry. I need to think for a minute.
Phew, my heart just won't stop pounding like crazy...
The village is straight ahead. Can you bring them to the village for me?
Why aren't you coming with me?
I have to go back to the Abbey. ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Iskale^</c> will be there soon.
Lately, I've been having the same mysterious dream. In that dream, I'm attacked, just like today. And in the end, I face Iskale alone at the Abbey.
In my dream... Only I know ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>how to defeat^</c> Iskale. And after that battle, an age of peace returns to Kastleton.
Now I understand the meaning of the dream ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Hamel^</c> sent me. I know what I have to do.
I'm not sure why Hamel chose me... I just know that it is my duty.
Oh! I think it's already begun. The wolves are coming!
Let me follow you to the Abbey.
I ask you once more. Please make sure that the children make it to the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>village^</c> safely. And...
Let's get the kids to village quickly and come back here to help Henry!
We need to make sure the kids aren't hurt!
It's much stronger than the other Alpha Wolves! Be careful. I'll protect the children!
Are you from the Abbey? Did you see my daughter anywhere?
Phew, that was close! We're here! That's the village right there!
Hold on a sec... When will Henry be coming back?
To have brought the children all the way to the village safely... You truly must be strong.
Oh dear, thank you for saving the children...
Thanks so much for bringing me home safe!
Daddy! This adventurer busted down the wall and saved my life!
You're amazing, my friend! How did you take on those fierce wolves? I wouldn't stand a chance!
I thought I'd never see my daughter again! I don't know how to thank you.
Are you Henry's friend? I heard that ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Henry^</c> went up to the Abbey alone to save the children...
Henry went to encounter Iskale at the Abbey.
No, that can't... ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Iskale^</c> is a monster! No human could stand against him alone!
And Henry is weak. If he went to fight Iskale, he'd be killed in a heartbeat. I hope he can find some way to come back safely...
Please, get rid of all those Wolves!
The village is just over that bridge there!
It's a hill with a view of ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Whisp Island^</c>. Helpie, I'll never forget you.
The sea breeze is refreshing. Whisp Island, visible from the mainland, looks somehow different.
It's been a while since I saw Whisp Island... I think you'll be able to see it from the Coastal Cliff. Would you like to go there?
That's great. You look more composed than the last time, so I guess it went well! Anyway, I have something to tell you. Do you know how to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>transfer upgrade levels^</c>?
I met Martinay thanks to you.
Gah, I thought as much! If you want to prepare yourself properly against all sorts of Arkeum spies, you need to know what transferring entails.
Brother! Let me tell you what I've learned from my other customers. When you get a shiny new high-grade weapon, you can transfer power from a rusty old weapon to strengthen it.

When you perform a transfer, the older equipment's upgrade level is completely moved to the new equipment! It's much more efficient than upgrading new gear from scratch. So, brother, remember to upgrade every piece of equipment as much as you can!
Got that, brother? Transferring power means you never have to throw away a piece of equipment! So, feel free to upgrade everything as much as you like! Hahahaha, it's easy!
Brother, this way. Come over here for a second!
Ah, you must be the adventurer that our aide mentioned. So, you're off to hunt Crackel? That means you're in need of some tough ^<c=@ItemGradekB>armor^</c>.

Usually, you need to bring materials to crafters like us to make armor. Since you came through Dave's introduction, I will provide the materials just this one time. Try ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>crafting^</c> the armor you need.
Hi, Dave sent me to see you.
Oh, not a bad job at all. Now ^<c=@ItemGradekB>upgrade^</c> the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>armor^</c>. You know how, right? Just like weapons, armor can be upgraded too.
The more you upgrade your armor, the more damage it can withstand. Here, I will give you some materials. Try ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>upgrading^</c> that armor you just crafted.
That's all I can teach you for now. Keep crafting and upgrading your armor. You're off to fight Crackel today, but you will surely face more fearsome opponents next time.
Did you catch a lot of wolves?
Did you catch a lot of wolves?
Enjoy the Hunting Contest before you go.
Here's how I did in the Hunting Contest...
Oh, now that I look at you again, are you not the adventurer who brought me new bait? Chris told me about you. I give you my sincerest thanks. You saved the contest.
What was it like to participate in the contest? Can you see why it is the pride of Kastleton?
This contest was first opened ten years ago in memory of my ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>son^</c>. As a father, I wanted to do anything I could to commemorate my son's sacrifice...
But now, the Hunting Contest also feels like a gift Henry left for the village. It has become a sort of celebration for brave hunters.
I know ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Henry^</c> would have loved these games. Ah... I miss my boy's smile.
If you pass through this village in the future, come take part in the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Wolf Hunting Contest^</c> again. I look forward to seeing your hunting prowess.
I would like to craft accessories.
Oh! Hello, adventurer! Do you need new accessories?
Oh my, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Thomas^</c>? Just hearing his name brings me joy. His craftsmanship used to be truly amazing. How can I help you, then?
I want to make some accessories.
Oh! You're curious about accessory crafting! If you bring the materials, I can make you great ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>accessories^</c>. You have to have accessories to be a true adventurer.
I'll give you some of the materials I have left over. ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Make^</c> any accessory you see fit.
The results seem quite pleasant indeed!
Want to hear something even more helpful? It's a way to bring out your gear's full potential!
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Upgrade^</c> your equipment! You can improve all your favorite gear. Keep at it, and you can make your equipment even more powerful!

Since you'll be traveling in dangerous places, I'll give you some upgrade materials. That way you can ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>upgrade^</c> your equipment yourself! Try upgrading the accessory you just made to practice.
Well, that's all I have for you. I hope it helps!
You're back, my friend! Did you try crafting some accessories?
Ahh, I see! If you ever need something made, the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>crafters^</c> will help you out. Thanks for the encouragement, friend! I wish you well.

Actually, here's another tip. Whenever you're ready to improve your skills, seek out ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Adrian the Skills Researcher^</c>. He's spent years honing his craft. He's your best bet if you want to get stronger and reach your full potential. Good luck on your journey, friend!
Excuse me, adventurer. I have a suggestion if you would like to hear it?
You are a great adventurer... But I would like to introduce you to a guild called the Worker Ants. Take this opportunity to work with them.
Wait... You don't know about ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>guilds^</c>? There are so many useful things you can do in a guild. And if you do well, you can get a big cut of the rewards.
If you want to know more about guilds, why not ask the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Guild Merchant^</c> right over there? And don't forget, it's the Worker Ants guild.
I uh... already belong to a guild.
Oh, is that so? Huh... That's too bad... Well, never mind, then.
But if you want to do well at guild activities, asking a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Guild Merchant^</c> to explain everything would be a good idea. He's right over there, so do pay him a visit.
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Guild Merchant Roberto^</c> is inside. He'll tell you more about guilds.
I'm interested in learning more about guilds.
Welcome. Come on in. How can I help you?
Aha, are you curious about guilds? Dave didn't send you here, did he?
Ah. Alright... He didn't recommend that you join up with some weird guild, did he? He better not have.

A ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>guild^</c> is an organization where people with the same purpose help each other succeed. In successful guilds, members cooperate in various activities and develop together. Cooperation really is the key to success.
When you contribute to the guild, you get better rewarded the more generous you are. In that sense, it's a good idea to be involved in your guild's community.
How would one contribute to the guild?
You build Guild Reputation through hunting, guild contracts, and donations. By doing those things, you can get rewarded with ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Guild Coins^</c>.
Speaking of which, why don't you join a guild and try it for yourself? If you bring me some Guild Coins, I'll explain things some more.
Oh, you've already joined a guild. That's great. Once you get Guild Coins through guild activities, come visit me again and I'll explain things further.
What do I need to do now?
To earn ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Guild Coins^</c>, build your Guild Reputation through activities like carrying out guild contracts and giving donations.
Here! I brought some Guild Coins.
Well done! You can get Guild Coins through various activities. You can exchange these Coins for all kinds of goods.
So, where do I exchange them?
You can exchange those coins with a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Guild Merchant^</c> like me. There are many fine products here, so please, look around.
Oh... I'm sorry to hear that you're joining another guild.
We are always open, so please come whenever you need something.
(Sniffle)... If we follow Henry and his friend, everything should turn out alright...!
What if there are Wolves hiding in the forest? I'm scared...
Ohhh... All those wolves are dead...
Mommy! Henry and this kind adventurer saved us!
These are deer horns shining with a mysterious light.
It's a fence overlooking the distant sea.
I wonder if Iskale also has the power of a Star Fragment. Hm...
How did this happen? It's like the Abbey we were at until just a moment ago... Did something change?
Argh, someone's being attacked over there! Help them, quickly!
They're going to die! Let's help!
The children are fine! I think they are just scared.
Are the kids okay? I think they were really surprised!
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>... Did you hear what that person called that boy just now?
Let's get the kids and escape!
There must be someone in the house!
We might be able to break this wall!
We did it! Let's go inside!
This wall, I think I can break it!
Done! I can go in now!
Be careful! I think that wolf also received power from Iskale!
Let's hurry up before Iskale shows up!
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>, I'll protect the kids! Deal with the wolves!
Let's go to the Abbey. I can't let Henry fight Iskale alone!
Henry is in danger! Let's get the kids home and go back to the Abbey!
We just need to go a little further!
Thank goodness the kids are safe!
Damn, more wolves...? I was sure I killed them all!
Ah, who is there? Please help me out!
The howl of the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Alpha Wolf^</c> resurrects the dead wolves!
It must be one of the three leaders of Iskale's pack!
You killed the Alpha Wolf. That's amazing...!
Oh no, there are wolves here, too!
If we'd just gotten here earlier... I could have saved them...
I hear someone in the house! This way!
It's ok the wolves are gone. Please open the door!
I think it's broken... What do we do now?
Oh! The ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mauvessence^</c>... It's another Alpha Wolf!
The children must be startled. Could we catch our breath for a moment?
Let's take a break. Are you hurt?
Well, let's hit the road again. No more breaks until we get to the village. You can do it, right?
We should go slowly so the children can keep up!
We must protect the children! I'll take this side!
It's Iskale! The wolves have been resurrected!
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>! Please protect the children until the end!
The contest is a booming success!
Is this where the Wolf Hunting Contest is held?
Oh, Soiri! You're safe, my daughter!
It's a dusty, empty oil container.
Which way is the Lord's Residence?
Is anybody there...? Uh... Please help me out here!
Waah, this door just won't open!
Henry, you saved me. I don't know how I can repay you.
The wolves have all been slain!
Oh, they left. That's too bad, but I can help you.
Huh?! Y-yes, but why do you ask?
I would like you to craft two Keepsakes for me.
But that's all in the past... I'm sorry. I wish I could make a Keepsake for you, but I've lost my edge. I can't even remember how to use my tools...
I resorted to drinking to calm my nerves. And soon enough, one drink became two and two became many more... And that's how I ended up like this.
J-just leave me alone! (Hiccup) I can't make any more Keepsakes.
What if I just mess it all up? Imagine how disappointed she'd be! Just thinking about it makes me nervous. (Hiccup)
D-do you really think I can do it? You did bring some fine materials... And I have the tools, but...
Thomas, I know you can do it.
Hmm... Hm? Maybe... this here... Yes... then, like this... There we go!
I-I've done it! Just take a look at these fine ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Keepsakes^</c>! The shape, the texture, these showcase the Deer Antlers and Wolf Fangs perfectly. Trophies, worthy of true hunters!
Now I'll make the second one. Wish me luck!
Oh! Such grace! I can't believe I made this! It shines as if blessed by Hamel himself!
A device whose purpose is unknown.
A device whose purpose is unknown.
This device is required for the defense of the Starlight Observatory Ruins.
This device was used during the Goblin Invasion. It's now broken and in need of repair.
Everyone, get ready! Let's show them what we're made of!
Please activate the Magic Traps set on the uphill path.
Okay, press the Explosive Device detonator!
Adventurer! Activate the Magic Trap at the end of the ruined observatory.
What are you doing! Kill them!
What are you doing! Kill them!
This is ours from this day forward!
Good! The One-Eyed Hawk has come!
Sorry I'm late. Leave the rest to us.
Sorry I'm late. Leave the rest to us.
It's been a long time, Gnoller the Butcher!
Kill the shamans first! I'll handle Gnoller.
They're tiring! Let's launch a full-scale attack!
There may be important orders among the Chief's belongings. Look closely.
It's dark, but please activate the Magic Traps set on the road.
Alright, we're ready. Let's go up!
Adventurer! The Magic Trap is at the end of the Starlight Observatory Ruins. It's dark, but you can see it well.
We'll take care of the goblins in the meantime!
There may be battle plans among Gnoller's belongings. Look closely.
There is a document on the ground with something written on it. It seems to have blown in from somewhere.
The document writes Contract Scroll with the Resistance Emblem on it. There appears to be more on the back.
Find the direction it came from.
I'm ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Noss, Contract Manager^</c> for Kastleton. I manage contracts for the ^<c=@MK_UI_Contract>Resistance .^</c>
Is this your lost Contract Scroll?
Where did you find this? Thank you. Let's see... Uh-oh, this is not good.
This is a Contract Scroll meant for the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Starlight Observatory Ruins,^</c> and it came to the wrong place. I should send it back before it's due, but I can't leave my post...
How about I bring it there for you?

Are you sure? Hm... But I can't entrust it to just anyone - ah, wait. Aren't you the adventurer who helped ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Martinay^</c> and the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Lord's Aide^</c>? You made the Wolf Hunting Contest possible, didn't you?
Please deliver it to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Ilira^</c> at the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Starlight Observatory Ruins^</c>. I'm so glad this ^<c=@MK_UI_Contract>contract^</c> can be completed on time.
The Resistance always lends a helping hand to those in need. We get requests to help with everything from minor problems to high-risk, life-or-death missions.
Normally, only Resistance soldiers can do this, but you have Clay's token, right? If he trusts you, we certainly can too. Take a look at some contracts if you want.
Now, take this to Ilira at the Starlight Observatory Ruins. Don't forget to open the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Waypoint^</c> in the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Urstella Fields^</c> on the way, hm? Take care.

Oh, and before you go, you should stop by ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Marianne the Accessories Crafter^</c> and pick up some ^<c=@ItemGradekB>accessories^</c>. The better your gear, the stronger the monsters you can take on.
Have you taken a contract before? Give one a go!
If you have Contract Coins, find a Contract Coin Merchant to spend them.

Is there anything you want to buy? Sorry, but I only accept ^<c=@MK_UI_Contract>Contract Coins^</c>. (Required to complete ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Chapter 3: Veterans Never Die > Appendix ▶ Resistance Contract Coin^</c>)
I want to exchange Contract Coins.
If you need anything, you can buy it here with Contract Coins. Take your pick.
Finished all the contracts already? The rumors about you are true. Come again any time if you want to take on more contracts.
Go meet ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Ilira of the Starlight Observatory^</c>.They're always short-handed there...
Before you go, you should stop by accessory crafter Marianne to pick up some accessories. The better equipped you are, the easier it will be to take on monsters.
I heard the Contract Scroll got to the Starlight Observatory Ruins safely, ha! Thank you!
What can I do for you? Only Resistance soldiers can take on ^<c=@MK_UI_Contract>Contracts^</c>.
This is really bad. What do I mean? Sorry, I can't tell you yet.
I picked up this contract scroll.
Oh, it's you! I heard a lot about you from Noss. You're said to be quite talented!

Nice to meet you! You've got Clay's token, right? Then, you're officially part of the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Resistance^</c>. While you're here, how'd you like to try taking on a ^<c=@MK_UI_Contract>Contract^</c>?
Here, take a look at these contracts! Don't worry, they all have generous rewards!
Let's see... You've got some good contracts. Nice. Oh no, Rubi's at it again.
Oh, that's my goblin friend over there, who's been pretty upset lately. I don't know what's going on.

Don't forget you can use your ^<c=@MK_UI_Contract>Contract Coins^</c> to buy goods from ^<c=@MK_UI_Contract>Contract Coin Merchants^</c>. ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Kastleton^</c> is the closest, so speak with the local Contract Coin Merchant next time you're in town.
We're all doomed! We're really doomed. We're all going to die!
Brother, you need to listen to me. The ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Urstella goblin^</c> horde is going to attack!
There's going to be a war! We're in big... big... big... big trouble!
While I was wandering, I saw the ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Urstella Clan^</c> collecting weapons. They said they were going to ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>hunt humans^</c>!
I heard it clearly with my own two ears! If we don't come up with a plan quickly, we'll all die!
I spoke to the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Watch Captain^</c>, but he didn't believe me. Friend, I never lie!
Thank you! I hope the Watch Captain can trust you like family and come up with countermeasures!
I'll find evidence and meet the Watch Captain.
Really? Oh, you give me hope, brother! You can find the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Watch Captain^</c> at ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Red Moon Lake^</c> in Carmine Forest. Good luck!
Where do I find this Watch Captain?
The Watch Captain is at ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Red Moon Lake^</c> in ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Carmine Forest^</c>. Try to be as convincing as possible! Good luck!
This is our guard post. What brings you here?
Are you an adventurer? We are from the Watch guarding all the way from Carmine Forest to Urstella Fields.
I have evidence of a goblin conspiracy.
The Captain doesn’t believe what that goblin says. It’s because of something that happened ten years ago. I don’t know the details.
Ugh. The Captain would believe me if there was any clear evidence.
It involves the White Bear goblin clan...
But if goblins are involved, there's a good chance Arkeum is involved too. I'm worried Captain Ruffello might get carried away.
The ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Goblin Shamans^</c> have a chest that is supposed to be located near an ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Urstella Fields Monument Stone^</c>.
If you don’t find it near one monument stone, go to another!
Did you find it? Oh, is this something written by Arkeum? Hurry and show it to the Captain.
My mother is proud that I've become a guard.
I came to see the Watch Captain.
Who said that? Was it that goblin again? Don’t waste your time and energy. Be on your way.
^<c=@MK_D_Quote>"Possessing a black heart... Front paws to the spider..."^</c> Those damn goblins! They have joined forces with ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Arkeum^</c> this time!
The black heart refers to Arkeum. The next part means they intend to attack. I've seen this code before, ten years ago.
Arkeum and the goblins are going to raid ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Carmine Forest^</c>? Over my dead body!
Thank you. Leave the rest to us.
What is this? Oh? It's a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>document from Arkeum^</c>. The goblins had this?
It says, "Possessing a black heart... Front paws to the spider..." This means Arkeum has joined forces with those damn goblins.
The black heart refers to Arkeum. The next part means they intend to attack. I saw the same document ten years ago.
Thanks for the help. You can leave the rest to us now and head back. Deputy! Gather the troops to prepare for the battle!
I'll talk to you later. We're busy preparing for battle right now.
Did the Watch Captain really believe you? You're amazing, brother! How did you do it? Tell me your secret!
This is the document from the chest.
Possessing a black heart? Front paws to the spider? Is this what it says? Is this all?
This isn't enough! Goblins always write in ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>three sentences^</c>! The last phrase is torn off!
I think this is a setup! Come on, we must alert the Watch Captain!
The Watch Captain has already gone to the Carmine Forest.
Oh no, that's not good! What do we do? At this rate, even the Watch Captain won't be able to... Oh, wait, One-Eyed Hawk will know what to do!
Henson Pillard, the former Watch Captain! He's probably at the small guard post by ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Crescent Moon Lake^</c>. We need to alert One-Eyed Hawk to the situation as soon as possible!
One-Eyed Hawk should be in the small post next to the Crescent Moon Lake!
Remind me again where One-Eyed Hawk is?
What is it? This place is dangerous with all the goblins nearby.
If you want to fight some goblins, go to the center of the plains.
What is it? This is a dangerous place and best avoided.
Well, some people call me that.
"Possessing a black heart..." Those goblins colluded with Arkeum! Where did you get this document?
"Front paws facing the spider..." That means there's going to be a battle soon. But the last sentence was torn off.
Those goblins must have split the message up in pieces. That's a victory ritual they have. We have to figure out the last sentence, and fast.
If you collect the pieces of the orders from the goblins, we will learn their full plan.
I will search and find the pieces of the orders.
Will you do that? Come meet me here as soon as you collect the pieces. Oh, and watch out for the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Giant Goblin Butcher^</c>.
What exactly do I need to do?
Get the pieces of the command document from the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>goblins^</c> in the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Urstella Fields^</c>. And hurry.
Get the pieces of the command document from the goblins in the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Urstella Fields^</c>. And hurry.
Here are the pieces I've gathered.
Good job! "Front paws to the spider and tail towards the star..."
It's a clever operation designed to lure the Resistance to Carmine Forest and then take control of the Starlight Observatory Ruins with elite forces!
The ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Starlight Observatory Ruins^</c> are strategic, and must be defended.
Go to the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Starlight Observatory Ruins^</c> and let the Guard know about the goblins' attack plan. In the meantime, I'll gather some troops.
Time is of the essence, hurry! I'll meet you there.
What needs to be done again?
Go to the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Starlight Observatory Ruins^</c> and let the Guard know about the coming attack. I better hurry, too.
This is our land! Arkeum even said it was ours!
This is an armband with the mark of the Resistance.
It appears to be quite old given the state of the bloodstains on it.
Hey, there is a sentence engraved on the back of the armband.
The Wolf of the Watch will not fall. With my brothers to the death.
Here, is this your lost armband?
Huh? Where did you find this? It's the armband that I lost a long time ago... Thank you for finding it.
Come to think of it, I don't think we've had a chance for introductions. Where are you from?
Whisp Island. Do you happen to know anyone named Yann Junath?
Yann was the elder of the island.
Ah, I see. Yan is my friend who used to travel around Solisium with me. If it weren't for that insidious Calanthia... It was such a long time ago.
Sorry, but would you mind bringing this to Ruffello? About time this armband gets itself a new owner. It will be helpful to him as well. Please don't worry.
This is the staff that Gnoller held.
You must hear about the attack! ^<imgf=IMG_CODEX_INS>
There appears to be something on the end of the staff. Let's see...
We defended the Carmine Forest, you helped to protect the Starlight Observatory, and you're not even a member of the Resistance. My thanks!
I was too rash. ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Zaroth^</c> almost got me.
Here, this armband is from Henson.
This is his arm band. How did you... get this?
I brought it at Captain Henson's request...
Captain Henson wants me to have this...? Me? I don't deserve this...
Ten years ago, most of the patrol members died in a plot by the Arkeum Legion. Only Captain Henson, myself, Gestahl, and Cisero survived.
Before I knew it, I was running away. I brought in reinforcements, but it was too late. My comrades died and the captain lost an eye.
Please think long and hard why you received the armband.
Sorry, but can I ask you a favor? I now know how Captain Henson feels, so can you return this to its ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>true owners.^</c>
To my comrades who died there ten years ago fighting to the bitter end. I can't leave my post, so I would ask you to do it for me.
What do you need me to do?
You will find the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Monument of Gestahl and Cisero^</c> in the Starlight Observatory Ruins. Please, bury this armband under the Monument.
Please bury this Armband under the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Monument^</c> in the Starlight Observatory Ruins.
There are two tombstones, placed side by side. They are so well maintained that they don't look ten years old.
It's a monument to Gestahl and Cisero. Pay tribute to their courage and bury the armband.
Glad to see you feeling better.
There you are. A big weight is off my mind thanks to you. I haven't forgotten Captain Henson's kind gesture. I will continue his legacy as best as I can.
I've been doing well thanks to you, Adventurer.
How is he doing these days?
You see Gestahl and Cisero's monument. It was built to honor their courage.
I did it! Don't hit me... Huh?
You were the one talking to Rubi at the Starlight Observatory Ruins, right?
Let me introduce myself. I am Ariella. I am researching the Urstella Fields' Monument Stones and the local goblins.
May I ask who you are?
Rubi has been feeling uneasy lately, and the goblins have been acting strangely. Based on my investigation, they appear to be gathering here.
They seem to be preparing for an important ritual. But I have no clue what that might be... Do you have any ideas?
Huh? Then they're here for... That ritual...?!
This last sentence may be a clue about their ritual...
How fascinating, I absolutely must know more. I have an idea, Adventurer! I will morph you into a goblin, then you can listen in on their gathering!
I know about as much as you do...
Oh, infiltration isn't one of my strong suits. Better if I send an expert like you to find out what the goblins' objective is! Good luck!

Today we head to the Spider Forest!
Brothers, we meet at night!
^<c=@MK_D_Place>At the Monument Stone^</c> by the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Starcluster Hill^</c>!
Now, listen up! The ritual is starting!
This is our time! A celebration of goblins, by goblins, for goblins! Now, let's begin! Hahaha!
Now, here's the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>last phrase^</c>! Don't forget! Meet us there!
The chest is now empty. It may look enticing, but it no longer holds valuable treasure inside.
Do you know what this key is?
Oh! This key belongs to the Urstella Clan! This engraving with a bear and a star symbolizes the Urstella Star!
This is something very precious to the Urstella Clan! Based on this emblem, it looks like a key to the place where the Urstella Star was stored. If you find what that key unlocks, you'll be rich!
Is it something like a treasure vault?
You're right. It looks like something from when the Urstella Clan used to live in the Carmine Forest. I remember an old warehouse from when I was little! I'll tell you where it was!
Yes please do. I'd like to know the location.
There is an ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Old Goblin Town^</c> to the south of the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Carmine Forest^</c> Waypoint. I saw a building with the same pattern on its door in that village.
Check if this key fits the lock! If it works, you'll be rich! How's that for repaying the favor?

Oh, did you forget? Go to the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Old Goblin Town^</c> to the south of the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Carmine Forest^</c> Waypoint. You'll find a building with the same pattern as the key on its door!
The chest has the same symbol as the key.
Insert the key and turn it.
It's rather stiff, but it turns when you exert some force. When you turn it all the way, you hear the lock click.
Nothing immediately catches the eye. Is it empty?
I'll look carefully inside the chest.
There's something small and shiny inside. It appears to be a small crystal, shining like a gem. Is this the Urstella Star?
A gem the size of a fingernail is shining. Rubi at the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Starlight Observatory Ruins^</c> will want to see this.
Hey brother! Did you find the Urstella star?
Here is the Urstella Star Crystal.
That's all? What a shame... It's small but it's beautiful! I heard Humans call this a gem. I want something that sparkles like this!
I'll give you the Urstella Star Crystal.
You're really giving me this? Hehe, thank you so much.
Oh, how have you been? I'm doing well! Adventuring is dangerous, so always watch your back!
Oh! Who's there? Sorry, I don't have very good eyesight.
I feel something familiar... Are you one who has the power of the stars?
Of course, you are. Could you listen to my story for a little while?
I've been drawing since I was young. I can't see, but it feels like some mysterious power is leading the brush.
I drew that ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>painting^</c> when I was young. It's a painting I gave to my dad as a gift. People get scared when I show it to them.
Uh... Adventurer? Could you have a look at my picture? I think you may discover something in it, please.
Sure, I'll take a look at your painting.
Thank you. The painting is there, so please take a look. I covered it with a cloth because people were afraid, but you can uncover it.
Please look at the picture next to me. What do you feel?
This energy, it's from you! Did you look at the painting?
It felt like... I was being drawn in by some kind of power...
Really? Actually, that's what my dad said. My dad had the power of the star too.
Does that painting attract people with the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>power of the star^</c>? My dad looked at that painting all day...
Adventurer... try to feel the power of the painting. Something special might happen if you do.
Have you tried pursuing the art of the painting? I feel like you have a gift for it!
I can't believe such a space exists within my painting... I guess only people with the star's power can enter.
It's fascinating. Thank you for showing me.
Wait... that's why dad was always... Ah, nevermind. Thanks to you, I solved the mystery.
I think I understand now, thank you. Please come look at my painting anytime if you think it will help you.
Please come view my painting any time, if it will help you.
Can you tell me more about your painting?
It looks like a painting. It would be rude to take a closer look without the artist's permission.
It's Ashien's painting. A cloth covers it, hiding it from view.
It's a mesmerizingly abstract scene. It seems to portray some kind of space.
A warm, familiar energy seems like it's inviting you closer. Perhaps Ashien will know more.
Hey, kid! You want a real adventure? Then, come here!
Haha, did you know? It's a tough world out there, and you have to be strong to protect what's important to you!
Oh, budding adventurer, you've got some good company.
You have a small but mighty friend right next to you. As you can see from me, Adventurer Pro Percy, we Amitoi are great adventurers. Our adventures are very special.
Haha, have you heard of the expedition? It's an adventure that only we Amitoi can take. I'm sure everyone is itching to join one, even if they don't say so.
Amitoi never return empty-handed from an adventure. Why not organize an expedition with your Amitoi?
The more Amitoi you send out on an expedition, the more rewarding it is. Let me, Adventurer Pro Percy, introduce you to some great companions to your expedition.
Haha. The first expedition. It brings back memories. Cheer your friends on.
Kid, can't you see the look in your companions' eyes says that they're hungry for adventure? Send them on an Amitoi expedition.
I see you've sent your expedition off well. Fear and excitement are the same for those who leave and those who wait for them.
Haha, your trusty companions remind me of the good old days.
Yes... I, Adventurer Pro Percy, had many companions, and one in particular stands out in my mind.
With him, I had nothing to fear in this harsh world. Even when the arrows rained down, we just laughed and ran.
We defeated all the enemies on the battlefield, but not without suffering some serious injuries... By then, we only had one healing potion left, so we...
(Wait with bated breath for the rest of the story.)
Oops, sorry, kid. I've been rambling on.
No, it's not about me. What really matters is...!
Shall we move on to our next place of romance? Somewhere with sweat, sand and passion.
Oh, hello! I saw you driving away those Goblins! You were amazing!
Thank you for helping me morph.
Haha, it's okay. I wanted to help, but I'm way too clumsy to do something like this. No matter how much I practice, I can't get the moves right!
Now that we've stopped the assault, I'm thinking of collecting ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mystic Globes^</c>.

Oh, didn't you know? A ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mystic Globe^</c> used to be Arkeum Legion's treasure box. But then the Steel Credit Union invented a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mystic Key^</c> to open the globe, turning them literally into a lucky box!
You might see them if you have a Mystic Key. The Arkeum Legion did their best to hide them, so who knows where you might find them!
Here, I'll give you one of mine. Consider it a token of thanks for preventing the attack. Now, search for a Mystic Globe.
Hm? Did you find a Mystic Globe?
Wow! How lucky! While you search for Mystic Globes, you may also find ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mystic Portals^</c>. They say these contain even more treasure.
Oh, I should go find one too!
There are more numbers than I thought.
Looks like we got rid of them all.
Well, you should raise the intensity of your training a little.
There is one thing we're testing at the top of the hill.
I'm not sure. It's still incomplete...
Not if they have any sense. Phew. I'm out of breath.
What to do... We've used all the Magic Traps.
We'd have been in quite a pickle if it hadn't been for you, adventurer.
It was a bit risky this time.
But where did that crowd come from?
We have to block the entrance somehow. We can't let that monster in.
Adventurer, you have to hang in there.
Ugh... No... There are too many enemies!
We can't let our guard down just yet!
We're not too late, are we?
Don't make me laugh! Just take care of yourself.
Hey, let's just give it a try!
Hey, adventurer! The shamans are using recovery skills!
Anvy, get behind me. I'll protect you.
All right, you want a fight, you've got a fight.
A dark power is on the rise.
How are there this many goblins?
You really took care of all those goblins? That's... amazing!
May godly blessings be with you.
Are they all gone? That's such a relief.
We stopped them, thanks to you. Thank you.
Hey, did you see my skills?
There can be only victory when fighting alongside the One-Eyed Hawk.
The goblins have been acting strange these days. The Shaman Goblins are frequenting the area and using suspicious magic I've never seen before.
Apparently, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>important documents^</c> have been placed in a Goblin Shamans' Chest. Could you look for something in there?
