Um... Can you please come this way?
Just a minute of your time, traveler.
Hey, the Starlight Observatory is short-staffed, so why don't you go there? I'll let Ilira know.
There is a document on the floor.
One-Eyed Hawk will be at a small Resistance Watch Guard Post to the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>southwest of the Urstella Fields Waypoint^</c>.

The Carmine Forest is filled with dangerous creatures, so please be careful. Oh, and I heard the Terrific Trio of the Resistance have arrived from Laslan. If you see them, they might be able to help you.
I'll do my best in my own way. And I'm going to listen to what the goblins have to say from now on.
There's an old heavy chest here. It's locked, but it doesn't look especially rare or valuable.
Part of the contract scroll's contents is written here. There seems to be more on the back.
The document's text cuts off. Find the direction it came from.
It's a chest with an arm sticking out. In its hand is the continuation of the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>document^</c> you picked up.
Hey, you! If you're there, open this ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>chest^</c>!
Whoah! That's better! I'm finally out.
What were you doing in there?
Ah, let me introduce myself. I'm one of the few ^<c=@Codex_AD_HN>Amitoi^</c> who can read!
Don't you know what an ^<c=@Codex_AD_HN>Amitoi^</c> is? Goodness... We were originally made as stuffed dolls, but thanks to the magic of the wizards, we became living magical beings!
I see. So, what were you doing inside the chest?
You don't seem all that surprised. Well, fine, whatever. Anyway, you know that document I was holding? Its contents are just so, so interesting.

That ^<c=@MK_UI_Contract>contract scroll^</c>, was it? Just reading it makes my heart race, and I can't help but want to take on that ^<c=@MK_UI_Contract>contract^</c> and set out on an ^<c=@Codex_AD_HN>adventure^</c>.
I have a feeling that you're the kind of person I've been waiting for. If you're going on an adventure, I'm coming with you! What do you say?
Alright! Come on, let's go! An adventure!

First, let's go find the ^<c=@Codex_AD_HN>Resistance Oath Stone^</c> mentioned in this contract. It seems anyone taking on this request is required to see it. I think it's in the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Memorial Hall^</c> right next to us.
We have a variety of contracts here. Would you like to take a look?
You're pretty tough, aren't you? I have the perfect contract for you.
It's better not to venture out into the woods carelessly in this weather. Still, take a contract in advance!
Look at you, working hard at this late hour! Why not take a contract while you're at it?
What's wrong? Was the contract you took earlier no good?
Good to see you again. Do you need something?
Goblins in Urstella Fields are notoriously lazy. Sometimes you'll even find them napping out there!
Carmine Forest may have spiders, but also Fanged Boars! Their meat is my favorite.
Goblins, undead, beasts... We have lots of contracts around here. But the more options you have, the harder it is to choose. Haha.
I heard some monsters only appear at night at the Shattered Temple. Have you seen them?
You're going to Syleus's Abyss? Alone? I don't have any, but you might be able to get a contract for that place if you find a Resistance Contract Scroll.
Do you have a knack for cooking? If so, you might be just what we're looking for.
It feels good to cook something tasty for someone else, don't you agree?
On rainy days like this, people crave warm, hearty dishes.
Some people look for food, even at this hour.
Hey, you're back! Want to see what contracts I have again?
It's good to see you again! Forget something?
Telling stories through food. That's the mission of us at the Dishelin Culinary Union.
Dishelin's magic ensures that the delivered dishes retain their freshness and flavor.
Plenty of hungry people have been offering contracts lately, so take a look!
Looking for a contract? There's one here that should put your culinary skills to work.
My specialty is hearty dishes made with my own herbs. What about you, adventurer?
You've probably been to every corner of this area. Why don't you go to Stonegard beyond the Nesting Grounds? It's completely different from this region.
If you go there, be sure to meet Grimo of Vienta Village in the center of Stonegard.
So, about the Allied Resistance Forces...
So, about the Allied Resistance Forces...
So, about the Allied Resistance Forces...
So, about the Allied Resistance Forces...
Hello! I'm Contract Manager Ilira of the Laslan Allied Resistance Forces. I handle various contracts I receive from clients.
It feels like only yesterday that we met, but you've grown so much. I'm in shock.
In this case, go to Starlight Observatory Ruins. Ilira will give you a new contract.
About Starlight Observatory Ruins Contract Manager
There's not a single place in Laslan where you don't have a friend now.
How about seeking some more difficult Resistance Contract Scrolls now?
If you want to complete contracts here, you'd better gain a little more experience. Go visit Olin in Canina Village.
What? The contracts here will be too difficult for you. You must go to Noss at Kastleton.
I feel like the contracts here will be boring to you. Why don't you try a new challenge?
Yohan, the Contract Manager at the Purelight Tower, is looking for skilled Resistance soldiers. Why don't you try there?
I think contracts here may be too much for you today. You'd better visit Olin at Canina Village.
I have been working to find keepsakes at the request of bereaved families.
But, while I was working here for a long time, I contracted some kind of terrible disease and grew rigid...
I want to continue looking for keepsakes as long as I can move. I know I shouldn't beg for such a thing, but can you help me?
Thank you so much! Please do your best for me.
Oh, brother! Can you help me?
I am the best gatherer in Solisium. I came here because mushrooms in the Carmine Forest are famous for their good taste.
But the spiders... There are too many spiders! I can't gather mushrooms because of the horrible spiders!
If you help me, I will go to a place with a lot of mushrooms. Brother can get some mushrooms too!
As expected, you are a good brother! Then let's go!
Huh? Adventure brother! Please help me!
I am a herb gatherer. I came here to find the Wild Herb that's good for goblin skin diseases.
But the trees hate me. They keep hitting me while I'm passing by!
I want brother to help me gather some Wild Herbs.
So kind, brother! Good, let's go!
A Resistance Contract? Hm... Not yet, you need more experience.
You'd like to take a contract? Then, please visit the Contract Manager in Kastleton first.
Ah, this is not going to work. I'm just going to go back to the village...
Ah, a keepsake is over there too.
Whew, I found them all with your help.
Thank you so much. I've put a small gift for you in this pouch, so be sure to take it.
This is not going to work! I'm leaving!
I can smell mushrooms nearby! This way!
Thanks for help brother. I gathered a lot of mushrooms! This is a small gift for you in the box, so take it!
What do I do? I need Wild Herbs!
I can't take this anymore! I'm leaving!
I can smell the Wild Herb from here!
Full of Wild Herbs! How nice!
Thanks for taking me here brother! This is a little something for you. Don't forget to take it!
Take a look at the contracts before you start your adventure. I assure you the rewards are worth it!
Welcome. I'm the Contract Manager from the Allied Resistance Forces. Want to take a look at the contracts?
Always something to do, even in the rain. Look at the contracts before you go.
Staying busy even at night? You should check out the contracts while you're here.
Adventuring alone? Or in a group? Either way, best to check for contracts.
I'm with the Contract Depot of the Allied Resistance. These are all legitimate.
I hate working in this rain. Make it worth it, and help with some contracts?
Goin' out at night? How brave! I have a contract that's perfect for you. Wanna take a look?
Welcome to the Laslan Watcher's Post, the fortress of the honorable Laslan Watch.
I work as a Contract Manager, but I have the heart of an adventurer since I work with the Resistance.
Gracious! The Contract Scrolls are getting wet!
Nighttime is always busier at the post. You should hurry and pick a contract.
Take care of yourself. Good luck.
You'll receive Contract rewards on the spot, no need to come back here to pick them up. Return when you're out of contracts.
Be careful out there. Make sure to come back if you need a contract.
Best of luck out there, Adventurer!
Come back if you need more contracts. I'll be here!
Are you leaving now? Good luck to you.
Take care of yourself. Let me know how you're doing when you visit the Laslan Watcher's Post again.
You're back. We've got some new contracts. Care to take a look?
Maybe you're not inspired by the contract you just took. I'll let you in on another one.
Was there a contract you wanted to see again? I can show it to you.
Something wrong with the contract you just took?
Welcome back. If you don't like the contract you just got, I have many more you can review.
I can't believe how strong you've become! Why not try going to the Starlight Observatory Ruins?
Why don't you try going to the Starlight Observatory Ruins? You'll find contracts that suit your skills.
Looks like you're waiting for a new adventure. You can also try getting a Resistance Contract Scroll.
If you're after a new contract, try getting a Resistance Contract Scroll.
Visit Vienta Village in the Stonegard dominion. They need all the help they can get out there.
Check out Vienta Village, in the Stonegard dominion. They'll have Contracts suited to your skills.
Go to the Purelight Tower. You'll find contracts that are better suited for your skills.
The wizards are looking for talented individuals like you. If you haven't planned your next journey yet, I'd suggest the Purelight Tower.
Did you know? Farm Harvesters won't attack you first at night.
Have you heard? Goblins loiter around the houses in the Golden Rye Pastures at night.
I heard the Tree Giants at the Purelight Hill become more aggressive when it's raining.
Be careful as you approach the chests that appear on the coast. You might get attacked by Chestaceans.
To get contracts in the Urstella Fields, you should be comfortable with Goblin Morphs.
Whether it's Mitran or Contaminated Mitran, there are many who want to kill them for a variety of reasons. If possible, try to avoid rainy days.
The Purelight Hill is known as the land of the Mitrans, but in fact, Fanged Boars settled here first. As such, they're an indigenous species.
The Guardian of the Forest lives up to their reputation in terms of strength, so don't try to fight them on your own.
The regenerative abilities of the Mitrans are enhanced when it's raining. When they glow green, that means they're recovering.
A lot of work has been invested into the purification of this land.
What kind of contract are you looking for? If there's something specific you want, you should read through all the details.
Remember that the undead in the Ruins of Turayne become faster and stronger at night. If you want to go there, I suggest you think twice.
Fonos orcs occasionally hold the Festival of Fire at night. Taking contracts during the festival would be highly effective.
You're ambitious, aren't you? That's good, but try not to spread yourself too thin with too much work.
Just let me know when you're ready. I have the perfect contract for you.
Are you in need of a contract? Come and have a look.
Have you eaten? You ought to carry some food with you.
These are the kinds of contracts we have here at the Purelight Tower.
Why fuss over whether it's a good contract or not? Just give it a try.
Let's find a contract to fit your skills.
Nights like these are perfect for staying up late, having a drink, and looking at the stars!
I'm glad you got here safely.
Knowing when to give up a contract also shows bravery.
Take your time. For someone like you, I have all the time in the world.
My name is Elter and I was sent from Venelux. My team is gathering Chaos Fragments from the undead to make Purification Fragments.
We're developing a new way to purify this land using Chaos Fragments gathered from the undead.
We reward people who help us collect Chaos Fragments. The best collector will be given a special reward.
Purge the undead from this place filled with the stench of death and collect the Chaos Fragments.
See? The stench of these Chaos Fragments... I don't even know if it's possible to purify them.
That's simply proof that they're full of dark magic. Once you filter out the darkness, they'll become Purification Fragments.
What is this strange light? It doesn't look like a Chaos Fragment...
Hey! Don't touch that! That's a Vengeful Spirit Core!
I finally found it! The Vengeful Spirit Core can be used to collect even more Chaos Fragments!
By the spirits... This magic...? How could anyone withstand such power?
There's no time to get distracted! We must gather more Chaos Fragments!
A Vengeful Spirit Core... Trying to use such a thing is simply reckless!
As long as you have a strong mind, you can withstand anything... Or do you doubt yourself?
The endless power from this magic...! I must try it, just once... Agh!
Look at all the Chaos Fragments! Hahaha... Give me all the Chaos Fragments!
I see you tried to tamper with the Vengeful Spirit Core... You must take care not to become a Dark Destroyer!
What is that red energy... A Dark Destroyer? A Dark Destroyer is here!
So, it happened... If he's turned into a Dark Destroyer, we're in imminent danger!
There's a Test Subject with a Vengeful Spirit Core...! Find it...! Heheheh...
You have to work harder, everyone. Only a large quantity of Chaos Fragments can purify this land.
Elter! The Dark Destroyer is attacking the adventurers and trying to steal the Chaos Fragments!
No need to fear the Destroyers. The Chaos Fragments they stole will be ours again.
Find the Chaos Fragments and take them to my assistants, the Elite Wizards. They will purify the Fragments.
Elter, what happens to the essence of the tainted water that becomes filtered out after Chaos Fragment purification?
The details of the process aren't important. First and foremost, we must focus on collecting as many Chaos Fragments as possible.
Approximately half of the allotted time has passed.
Don't give up. There are still a lot of Chaos Fragments to collect.
There's not much time left. Please do your best until the end.
More rewards will be given to the team that brings more ^<c=@MK_T_DE>Chaos Fragments^</c>.
These are the guilds who collected the most ^<c=@MK_T_DE>Chaos Fragments^</c>.
These participants collected the most ^<c=@MK_T_DE>Chaos Fragments^</c>.
This is as many Chaos Fragments as I can get... I don't think I can keep on going.
Try and use the Vengeful Spirit Core. You'll gain enough strength to collect even more Chaos Fragments.
Elter! We shouldn't use impure objects such as Vengeful Spirit Cores!
Collecting more Chaos Fragments is paramount. It's as simple as following my instructions.
It doesn't matter if they're Dark Destroyers. Don't let them stop you from collecting more Chaos Fragments.
More rewards will be given to those who bring more Chaos Fragments.
Four of Ahzreil's apprentices linger here as restless, vengeful spirits.
The Arkeum Dark Magic Legion appeared there a few days ago and created a Dark Rift.
To close the Dark Rift, we must form a Requiem of Light using Light Fragments.
Skeletons and Specters have Light Fragments as proof that they were once human. Please defeat them and collect the Light Fragments.
First, find the Soul Stones erected in the place where Ahzreil's four apprentices rest.
Old Vengeful Spirits like the four apprentices cannot find rest on their own, so help them finally find peace by using the Light Fragments.
You will be able to activate the Soul Stones with Light Fragments.
When you first activate a Soul Stone, more Requiem will be generated than the number of Light Fragments used.
Please fill the activated Soul Stone with Light Fragments until the ritual is complete.
When one Soul Stone is activated, the other Soul Stones will be silent.
The ritual of the activated Soul Stone must end in order to activate another Soul Stone.
You must collect Light Fragments to seal up the power of darkness.
Only Light Fragments can activate the Soul Stones and help put the four Vengeful Spirits to rest.
You can activate a Soul Stone now.
Activate a Soul Stone and start the ritual.
Once the ritual is over in one location, you can move and start another ritual elsewhere.
Activate another Soul Stone and begin the ritual for the Vengeful Spirits.
Remember that once a ritual begins in one location, you cannot activate any other Soul Stones.
That's it. We finally did something to stop the Dark Rift with the Requiem of Light.
I'm truly grateful. Your aid will not be forgotten.
I pray the Arkeum Dark Magic Legion does not attempt to awaken the souls of the four apprentices again.
I sincerely hope this won't happen again.
These people filled the Soul Stone with Light Fragments.
So, these are the guilds that have filled the ^<c=@MK_T_DE>Soul Stone^</c> with the most ^<c=@MK_T_DE>Light Fragments^</c>.
These adventurers started the Requiem of Light using many Light Fragments.
These are the ones who put the Vengeful Spirits to rest with a large number of Light Fragments.
These are the guilds that have helped most with pacifying the Vengeful Spirits.
These are the ones who worked hard to close the Dark Rift.
Did no one start the ritual yet? Quickly, gather Light Fragments and head to the Soul Stone.
The next Soul Stone is about to open. Get ready.
This ritual was quite disappointing. I suppose it can't go well every time.
When a Soul Stone is activated, monsters possessed by the specters sealed within will appear.
The Soul Stone and the specters are inseparable.
When all the specters have been defeated, the Requiem will be complete, and we can move on to the next Soul Stone.
It is up to you whether to fill the currently activated Soul Stone with Light Fragments, or to slay specters for the next Requiem.
Remember, this Requiem will end when all of the Specters are defeated, or they will disappear after 5 minutes.
The Ice Heart Soul Stone was activated!
It is the Soul Stone of Ahzreil's apprentice, Prizoneo.
Please fill it with Light Fragments, so that the Vengeful Spirit can find rest.
Please fill it with Light Fragments, so that the Vengeful Spirit can find rest.

The Vengeful Spirit of Prizoneo will soon find rest.

It is the Soul Stone of Ahzreil's apprentice, Minnow Parsons.

I, Lord Hobs of Laslan, hereby present to you the Wolf Hunting Contest!
Great honor and greater rewards await those who can bring in the most wolf tails.
I'm looking forward to seeing who the winners will be. Now, let the game commence!
Ah, the tail deliveries have already begun.
It's neck and neck. Everything is still up for grabs, so don't stop now!
There's still time to catch up, so press on!
Oh, the delivery for the Northern Campsite is already finished.
Oh, the delivery for the Western Lake Campsite is already finished.
Oh, the delivery for the Southern Lake Campsite is already finished.
Don't lose hope just yet! No one knows who the winner will be.
The title is still up for grabs! Don't give up!

If anyone finds this letter, please come to my rescue.

My ship has been wrecked and I'm stranded on a remote rocky island.
I'm surrounded by giant crabs,

It's too late now.
He has a note in his pocket.

Damn the black rain!
It broke my ship, along with the treasure!

Ugh... How much longer can I survive on this little rock?

Dear Einar,
please let me live so I can see my wife again.

Dear Harnie,

I've finally found the treasure in (smudged and hard to see)!
Now, all I have to do is get home and pamper you!

Kastleton is just around the corner.

There is someone named Harnie in Kastleton.

Ugh... I can't just jump off the cliff...
I'm researching the contaminated beings of Windhill Shores.
I've noticed an unknown contaminant on the floating plank in the sea, but I haven't been able to identify what it is.

Look around for anything else suspicious.

It's faded and must not be used anymore.

The wizard threw away this Rat Morph Potion.
Maybe this can be used to follow the cats.

Do you know anything about this magic circle?
I found it while patrolling, but it doesn't seem to be working now.
More magic circles like this? Those cursed Arkeum... What are they up to?
I saw a similar magic circle on the shores.
Adventurer, could you check the village for signs of Arkeum?
I'll follow you right after I report to my captain.
Sorry I'm late. I'm glad you're okay.
They must be Arkeum spies. I can't believe they snuck into the village!
This is what happened at the village...
We'd better step up our vigilance. Thank you so much for your help.
There is a blood stain on the table.
They don't even stir. They're already dead.
The Arkeum soldier they trusted would have been beyond the door they opened.
Stand in silence to honor the departed.
Oh man, my head is spinning... I can't tell which way is up and which way is down.
What? What about Room 202? I didn't spill anything. The mark on the table has nothing to do with me. (Hiccup)
Did you stay in Room 202 last night?
I entered the room to sleep off a few drinks, and noticed something on the table.
But I swear, I didn't do it! You've got to believe me, hic!
I'll enter the room and check the table.
Oh, my back. I have so much cleaning to do. Oh, hello. How can I help you?

As you can see, I clean mostly on the second floor, moving between the hallways and rooms.
Hm, I don't know. It's just that it's unusually cold when you enter Room 202, but then, I tend to feel very chilly all the time.
We had a guest in Room 202 just yesterday, and no problem. It was that drunken fellow down there.
Is everything okay at this inn?
Finally, you're here! I've been waiting for you.
Uh, no? I'm sorry. I thought you were here to solve a certain problem at my inn.
Have you heard of the Three Urban Legends of Kastleton? I'm not sure how our inns fit in there, but...
Guests keep complaining about hearing mysterious crying sounds in a room, but I don't see what the fuss is all about.
If you don't mind, could you look into it? You don't look like an ordinary adventurer. Please, you've got to help me.

You're not going to believe this but...
Shhh, the whole neighborhood can hear you!

I-I stayed at the Kastleton Inn a few nights ago and had a strange feeling when asleep.
So, I opened my eyes and... Ugh! I-I saw a ghost!
Yes, it's true! I saw it with my own eyes! Ugh, I'm still breaking out in a cold sweat just thinking about it.

We Amitoi are beings created by wizards.

When you do, show them the same kindness you showed me, and they will help you on your adventures.

If you want to be recognized as a true hunter, you have to pull this off, and it's not easy.
Would you care to give it a try? You can start by finding the Sheep Morphstone at the Western Campsite.

I met Neal in the abandoned house and...
I see. If I had known then that the gem was a fragment of the Star of Sylaveth, I would never have entrusted it to him...

Hurry and bring Neal here. Tell him not to worry. I won't reprimand him.
Why did you come alone? Where's Neal?

What? He was murdered by an Arkeum soldier? Good gods, in the end, we couldn't save Neal after all. The Star Fragments are dangerous.
He's... Take this Star Fragment first.
You too should be aware of the power of the Star Fragment. This one will soon be returned to the Resistance headquarters.
I can take things from here. Good job.
Aww... I don't want to die like this... (Coughing)
I should never have been so greedy...
Should I give it back now and ask for my life?
The energy from the Star Fragment flows in.
I'm dying because of this purple gem I have.
A long time ago, Chris entrusted me with this gem from Whisp Island. I got greedy and absconded with it... And it's been draining the life out of me ever since!

The number of zombies roaming the Ruins has been increasing lately.

If you don't mind, could you take care of the Zombies around the abandoned house over there?

Update on Rex Chimaerus Inhibitors

Last month, while researchers were harvesting mutant cells from Rex Chimaerus, the test subject suddenly became aggressive, causing damage to equipment and staff. In response, the Order has decided to place demonic beast inhibitors and locks on the top of the binding magic circle and inscribe a surveillance magic schema to effectively control the creature. If the magic schema detects any abnormal behavior from Rex Chimaerus, it will summon Launch Pitons that allow access to the locks. Once unlocked, the device will render the test subject helpless. We are grateful for the continued support of the Order.

We finally succeeded in reaching here under the contract with the Stonegard Traders' Guild. It is said that not only are huge ants living in the Ant Nest in the desert, but the size is comparable to that of human cities. In the Ant Nest, you can often find yellow clumps of food, and that's where ^<c=@Codex_ACH_HN>Honeypot Ants^</c> appear. It probably picks yellow food and fills its honey pot. As a member of the Einar Order, I am leaving a message here that may be helpful in the operation to wipe out the Sylavean Order. Three units have entered, but the size of this place is beyond imagination. While the operation was in trouble, fortunately we were able to use the Waypoint that appeared on each floor. The key to this cleanup operation was to destroy a special object called ^<c=@Codex_ACH_HN>Devil Monolith^</c>. The Sylavean Order is gathering dark energy through this to summon Specters. <np>The problem was that, when eliminating the Specters, the scattered dark energy would return to the monolith, summoning the Specters again, making it difficult to eradicate. However, I finally found out that when the power of dark energy beyond the capacity of the monolith is gathered by catching a huge number of Specters, a powerful Specter is summoned and the monolith is broken. Although it is dangerous and difficult, it is presumed that this is currently the best method. I think that the operation can proceed safely only when several units enter at once.

I'll go to check it out.

The Breezeline? Oh, there was quite a commotion when they built that thing. I still have vivid memories of it! It was Captain... umm... uh... It was some famous person who wanted to build it, I think?

The Breezeline? Oh, there was quite a commotion when they built that thing. It was Captain... oh, someone famous who wanted to build it, I think?
Oh don't worry! It was only a broken leg, nothing serious. Village folk are tough. Anyway, the Breezeline was the result of all that hard work.
Tell me about the area around the village.

North? Oh, where the mansions are? Don't get me started. That place used to be where all the nobles lived, but now? Tut-tut...

Here, try this one. How do bees brush their hair?
H-how did you know that one? Grr, let me try again!
How do bees brush their hair?
What? Ugh, you're good! Okay okay, I'll tell you.
W-what? You knew the answer! Not bad... Okay, I'll tell you, as promised.
You can find ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Melvin^</c> at the Wizards' Residence in the village. Wizards from Venelux always stay there.

Or... are you here for a riddle?
Ugh, I'm so booooored! Hey, are you the one who broke the pump?!

... They sea all, they know all.

Ah! How did you know? Hmph, spoilsport.
... They don't, due to their buzz cuts.
I can't quite think outside of the pond...
Ugh, what's taking Master so long? What should we do about the research journal?
Oh, hello. Have you come to see my ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>master^</c>? I'm sorry, but he's not here now.
Oh, I'm sorry!  So many people are looking for my master, so I just assumed... May I ask why you're looking for ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Janice^</c>...?
Oh, you're from the Resistance! Sorry... ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Janice^</c> is not here at the moment.
My master, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Theodor^</c>, would likely be able to get in touch with her, but unfortunately, he is currently absent...
Well... He should have been back by now, but he's late. He mentioned that he's heading towards the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Thorn Tree Mountains^</c> outside the village.
Oh, then you should take the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Breezeline^</c>. You can ask the Breezeline manager if he's seen my master.
If you mention a tall young wizard with a great beard in a Venelux robe... the manager will know who you're talking about.
My master hasn't returned. For now you should ask the Breezeline Manager above the elevator.
If you want to use the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Breezeline^</c>, please take the lift. If you're in the Resistance, it's free.
Want to take the Breezeline? The lift is in the building.
Hello! Would you like to use the Breezeline?
A tall, young wizard with a nice beard...? Oh, I think he's gone to take the Breezeline to the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Thorn Tree Mountains^</c>. Just take the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>lift to the right^</c>!
Did you find the Breezeline to Thorn Tree Mountains? Head inside the building and take the lift to the right.
This is the Breezeline to Thorn Tree Mountains.
Travelers heading to the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Thorn Tree Mountains^</c>, please use the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Breezeline^</c> on this side.
Are you taking the Breezeline? The gate to Thorn Tree Mountains is this way.
Oh, him? Definitely! He took the Breezeline out this way a while ago. Whenever he rides the Breezeline I always keep a close eye on him.
I was wrong to think he'd be any different today. As usual, he jumped off right before he got to the last stop!
Thankfully, he morphed into a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>bird^</c> as soon as he jumped off, but I'm always nervous about what he's going to do whenever he's on board.
Oh, I couldn't see that far. I suggest you go to that stop and ask around.

Oh, I couldn't see that far. I suggest you go to that stop and ask around.
This way is the Breezeline to the Shaderock Mountains. Watch your step.
Mm? How may I help you?
Did you see the wizard who morphed into a bird?
Did you see the wizard who morphed into a bird?
Did you see the wizard who morphed into a bird?
Did you see the wizard who morphed into a bird?
Did you see the wizard who morphed into a bird?
A ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>wizard^</c>? Well... Wouldn't the guard on duty over there know?
Ugh, I don't know how I'd get around this place without the Breezeline.
A ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>wizard^</c>? Hmm, I'm not sure. Heh, I'm also not sure where all the goblins in this mountain range are coming from...
You don't look familiar. Are you here to hunt?
Who? A ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>wizard^</c>? Nah, sorry. But hey, just look at this catch! It's so big it'll make a pretty penny, don't you think?
A ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>wizard^</c>? I'm sorry, I've only just taken over the shift. Please ask someone else.
Do you need help with something?

A white hat is on the ground.
It looks like the kind of hat a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>wizard^</c> would wear. The fact that it's so white bothers you.
Is it possible to find the owner of the hat using the power of the ^<c=@Codex_AD_HN>Star Fragment^</c>? Let's give it a try.
Let's use the power of the Star Fragment.
It's a notebook with a bunch of scribbled notes. "^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Theodor^</c>" is written inside the cover.
It's an empty trap. It doesn't look like a bird trap, and it would take a really stupid bird to get caught in it.

A ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>white bird^</c> is stuck in some ^<c=@MK_D_Quote>thorny vines^</c>.

Check the nearby ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>goblins^</c> to see if they have anything that you can use to ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>burn^</c> the vines with.

Just how long is this going to take?

Are you in a hurry?
A valued colleague of mine is in danger.
I see. We have to find Janice as soon as possible...
Brothers, this flame is a blessing from our god!
Don't you dare steal our flame!

"^<c=@MK_D_Quote>To recharge the wind relic, I need to activate the magic circle located in the Thorn Tree Mountains. While getting there is not an issue, to activate the circle, I need to gather some wind element.^</c>"

"^<c=@MK_D_Quote>The Bladewind Flowers that bloom in the mountains contain a lot of wind element, so I will only need to gather a few of them... But bees love that flower. I should put on some repellents before I go.^</c>"
The crying white bird has been stung by a bee.
Judging by the dead bee, it put up a ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>good fight^</c>.
The white bird keeps looking at the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>flower on the opposite cliff^</c>.
It must want the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>flower on the opposite side^</c>.
Attention! The frozen golems are about to go on a rampage. Take your positions to fight them off!
There's a scrawled research note on the desk. It was probably written by Theodor.
There's a research note on the desk in a familiar handwriting. This must be the note Melvin was talking about. It's marked with bookmarks throughout.

"^<c=@MK_D_Quote>To gather flame elements, I need to get to the Flame Control Magic Circle in the Guardian's Graveyard. The graveyard is where the relic of the seven wizards who sealed away Deluzhnoa are buried.^</c>"
"^<c=@MK_D_Quote>There are several safety mechanisms to prevent people from easily accessing the magic circle. Oh well, as Venelux's 293rd valedictorian, it should pose no problem to me.^</c>"

"^<c=@MK_D_Quote>I ran into a slight problem while gathering water element.
When Deluzhnoa was released last time, the Water Control Magic Circle was damaged. If I want to recharge the water relic, I need to use a more complicated method.^</c>"

"^<c=@MK_D_Quote>When Deluzhnoa's power is unleashed, Quietis's Demesne can completely freeze over.

"^<c=@MK_D_Quote>And if I use it at the Water Control Magic Circle... Yes, that's an ingenious idea.

Have you taken a look at Master's records?

The Guardian's Graveyard is near ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Crystal Lake^</c> in Quietis's Demesne. The entrance is hidden under a hill, so take a close look.
The Guardian's Graveyard is located near Crystal Lake in Quietis's Demesne, and the ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>fire circle^</c> is inside it.
I wonder when my master will be back?
Ugh, we have to take care of it, but you're stuck in this shape now. What do we do?
Ugh, this whole process is giving me a headache... Oh, I'm sorry. I know you're in a hurry.
Surely you've heard of Deluzhnoa? The monster who was sealed by the Archwizard Hale Verpheus and Venelux wizards ages ago?
But the Arkeum Legion broke that seal a few years ago. Because of that, Talandre was locked down for a while. Thanks to Janice's help, it was sealed again.
Unfortunately, the seal is unstable. And my master is in charge of reinforcing the seal every once in a while. It's a very important task.
But look at what happened to him. If the seal isn't reinforced in time, something terrible will happen.
How do you reinforce the seal?
See the four relics next to me? The four elements—fire, water, wind, and earth—need to be filled into each relic in order to perform the reinforcement ritual.
Fortunately, master managed to fill half of it... Can you help in filling the remaining relics with the corresponding elements?
Really?! Oh Thank you! Here are the relics... I'm sure my master will recover by then!
Master left a note on the table. It goes over how to contain elements in those relics. Take a look.
Master's note on the desk explains how to contain elements in the relics.
The corpse of an Arkeum Soldier. The bones are crushed, which suggests instant death.
Someone outside of Venelux has a relic...
Master, surely you can get a cup of water by yourself.
What would our guest think looking at you like this?
Did you come back already? How did it go with filling the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Fire Relic^</c>?
Huh? ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Hale Verpheus^</c>'s ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Defender^</c>? And ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Hale Verpheus^</c> himself as well?
I'm glad you made it out alive. You even managed to charge the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Fire Relic^</c>, too. Excellent!
Now you have to fill the ^<c=@MK_D_Quote>water relic^</c>. Do you remember how to do that?
When it freezes, it forms ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Ice Crystals^</c>. When you break them, small shards will stick to you. You can strengthen their power by defeating Water Golems while they're on you.
When they're fully strengthened, go to the Water Control Magic Circle to energize the relic. The circle is located above a big hand-shaped statue called Quietis's Scream.
However... it's a bit tricky, so you will have to visit Joaquin at the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Guardian's Shrine^</c>.
Joaquin is one of Master's colleagues from Venelux, so I'm sure he will help you.
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Ice Crystals^</c> will appear on its own if you wait for Deluzhnoa's power to spread in Quietis's Demesne.
Now that the adventurer is here, I'll prepare for the ritual.

Here in ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Quietis's Demesne^</c>, ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Deluzhnoa^</c>'s influence causes periodic outbreaks of intense ^<c=@MK_D_Quote>cold^</c>. Let's time our departure accordingly.
Ah, it's about time. Adventurer, please follow me.
Feel that chill in the air? That's Deluzhnoa's energy.
If left unchecked, it will destroy the ecosystem here. But we need this frigid energy to fill the water relic...
Those wizards are still hard at work, I see. Deluzhnoa has caused everyone a lot of trouble.
I'm sure they'd appreciate your help later. For now, though, let's focus on the task at hand.
Adventurer, that's the ice crystal. Destroying it will release the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>water essence^</c> trapped inside and splash it onto you.
If you defeat the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>frozen water golems^</c> while the water essence is on you, it will strengthen and grow.
When it's filled, come to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Quietis's Head^</c>. I'll go ahead and prepare the magic circle.
First, I'll show you how to destroy the ice crystal, which you can do with a simple attack.
See? Once it's broken, fight the water golems with the essence on you.
Now, I'm off to Quietis's Head. I'll see you soon!
Everyone! Frozen water Golems are raging out of control! Everyone, hold your positions!
This happens every time. Damn the Arkeum, why did they break the seal?
It angers me to think of all the wizards who died because of them.
It would have been worse if Janice didn't stop them.

There's a unique ancient magic circle there. Use the water essence that you've strengthened there, and the relic will be filled.

You're not hearing a word I say...
There you are! I see you already charged the ^<c=@MK_D_Quote>Water Element^</c>.
Wow! That's amazing! So fast! If it were my Master, it would have taken... Ahem, nevermind!

Hey! Can you hear me? Why am I not getting through...
Hmm, that's weird... Why can't I reach her?
You can help us with the ritual? Wow, thank you!
Janice...? Please pick up. (Sigh) Why is it so hard to reach her...?
Woah! My goodness! I-it was you? Hahaha...
Have you returned already? Oh, I'm so grateful... In the meantime, I managed to regain my normal state as well.
Once I had returned to my normal state, I tried to reach out... But strangely, it was as if my attempt was being repelled by magic.
So, you don't know where she is?
Yes, for now. But I'll make sure to get in touch, so please wait a little. Ha... haha...
Well... Ooh, it happens that there are three people in this room!
You need three people to control the relics for ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>reinforcing^</c> the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>seal^</c>. I was going to call other wizards to help, but...

Really? Hahaha, thank you so very much! It would have been disastrous if not for you. If I failed to reinforce the seal, Janice would have pulverized me... n-not.
Okay! First, come fully prepared and come to the Deluzhnoa Temple's ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Hidden Seal Room^</c>. I will provide you with the directions.
Thank you so much. Now, I'll see you in the temple. In the Hidden Seal Room in Deluzhnoa Temple!
Of course, Master! I bet I know the sequence better than you do.
The water element resonates with Deluzhnoa! The rest of the elements harmonize to strengthen the seal!
Oh, no! No, no, no! ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>! Help me!
Yes. At least your combat spells didn't get rusty.
Alright. Each person takes a relic. ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>, please stand in front of the wind relic over there.
Melvin, you ready? Let's begin the elemental activation!
Oh, it's that so. Alright, what is it?
Okay, then. The ritual to control these relics is...
Gah! We'll have to deal with the golems first!
It can't be helped! Watch and learn, Melvin!
Such confidence! We'll see about that!
Whew! See? Now, who's your master?
What do you mean, "at least?" I'm your master...
Master! Are you trying to jinx us?!
Master though is amazing! I still have plenty to learn from you.
What was that? And what's this mist...?
Ah, I knew it. I just knew something would come up!
You've got legendary bad luck Master! Is it contagious?
Damn! More of them! Oh well, come on then, do your worst!
Stop your worrying! I could handle this in my sleep!
Phew... That should be the last of them.
Now, back to the relics! Melvin, stand in front of yours.
Heh, once upon a time  I was even considered for the position of Archwizard! No monster can match my...
B-bad luck? Who's been saying that?! Oh when I find them...
Finally, a chance to try out my secret weapon!
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>, watch out! That one looks different from the others!
Stood up too fast?! You were completely out cold!

I'm a little lightheaded. I must've stood up too fast.
Wh-why are you so...? Oh, I see, you were worried about me, weren't you?
Oh, Melvin, I had no idea you cared so much about me. Haha. Alright, let's finalize this ritual.
Master, shouldn't we start the purification?
Look how perfect this seal is, Melvin. Now that's impressive!
Oh, we'll have to wait until our guest here departs.
Thank you so much, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>! I hate to think what would have happened if you hadn't been there.

I'm sure other wizards would have helped.
Oh, the people at the Guardian's Shrine? Haha... Well, my Master's misfortune is quite infamous... so they wouldn't have come with us.

Indeed! If we didn't prepare the ritual in time and the seal weakened... I can't even imagine.

The purification censor is in the Guardian's Shrine. It's pretty big, so you'll know it when you see it.
It appears Master has acquired some information! You should go talk to him.
I wonder where Janice is. I hope Clay is alright...
Are you all purified? I hurriedly made my way here to deliver some news.
Did you get in touch with Janice?
I wasn't able to reach her, but I did manage to detect her approximate location!
She's in the west, at the Forest of the Great Tree. I couldn't reach her, but using tracking magic, I discovered her traces led to the forest.
Oh, considering my unsuccessful attempts to reach her, it's unlikely that you'll find her even if you go there. The forest is vast.
Moreover, the forest is teeming with huge ogres, so it imperative for you to enhance your skills before embarking on that journey.
I will continue trying to contact Janice. If there is any progress, I will be sure to inform you first.
First, focus on improving your combat skills ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>, trust me. Haha.
Ukarak, oh man... when will I ever clear by debts?

When that monster went on a rampage, village was shut down. I lost my business, smithy and all. I've been trying to get out of debt ever since.
Working the sauna is just keeping me afloat, barely helping with the debt I owe. Argh, only if I had that treasure...
Life can be tough. What happened?

But when I went to retrieve the treasure, some blasted graverobbers had already cleared everything out! They got there before me and left nothing behind! That treasure was my only way out of this debt!

H-huh? You're offering help?! Someone saw them running to the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Aylmar Falls^</c> just south of the village! They must have a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>hideout^</c> tucked away somewhere near the waterfalls! That's all I know.
You'd really get my family's ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>treasure^</c> back? With it, I could clear my debts and open my workshop again! Help me with this, and I'll be truly grateful!

^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Quietis^</c> was a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Titan^</c> himself, and this was a massive weapon made by a Titan... Some say it's just a legend passed down through generations, but I don't think so.

When I do, I'll be sure to include your name. Thank you so much for joining me in ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>documenting this and spreading history^</c>!
I hope to see you elsewhere someday. By then I'll be recording something else!
There are many things in the world that shouldn't be forgotten.
Gah! Everyone says they can't do it! What do I do?
Oh, thank goodness! You're a Resistance Soldier, right? Can you take a minute and help me with this?

The Resistance contacted us, saying that ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Arkeum spies^</c> have been hiding in our village lately. They asked us to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>set up a checkpoint^</c> and capture them.
But the receptionists are too scared to do it - afraid they'll get hurt during the inspection. Even with soldiers protecting them, they refuse and say they'll call in sick.
The Resistance said they don't have enough manpower to send anyone for the inspections, but since you're one of them, why not help us out? Consider it a part-time job - we'll repay you generously.

Whew, thank you! If they realize what you're doing, they'll run away. You'll have to pretend to be an employee here! Here, change into these clothes and go to the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>checkpoint^</c> on ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>that platform^</c>.
There, you'll find a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>wanted list^</c> on the desk with the spies' descriptions to help you identify them. Now, good luck!
Did you need to use the restroom? Just go up to the checkpoint on the upper platform.
Are you here to help? Start at that checkpoint over there.
You did a great job! You've saved us a lot of trouble. I don't know who would have done it if it wasn't for you.
Oh, it's not a big deal.
Well, maybe it's not a big deal to the members of the Resistance like you, who fight terrifying monsters all the time, but it is a big deal to mere villagers like us.
Thank you for your help on this matter. Here's a gift for you. Thank you for supporting the Breezeline!
That troublemaker! I won't let him get away this time, but first, I need to find him...
Ah, could you spare a moment? I really need to ask you for a favor.
I'm really sorry, I don't know anyone else to ask. I have a younger brother named ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Malioh^</c>, and he's a real troublemaker.
My mom is frantic because he hasn't come home, and it's getting late. She wants me to find him, but I can't leave my guard post right now.

I was wondering if you could find him and bring him back for me. I think he probably went to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Cherahnimo^</c>'s place in the apartment building over there, since he always goes there to beg him for stories.
Thank you so much! My mother is so worried. I won't forget it if you find him.
I bet he's gone to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Cherahnimo^</c>'s in the ^</c>apartment building^<c=@MK_D_Place> over there. Please find him.
What is it? I've got nothing you want.
Do you know where Malioh is?
What? He still hasn't come home? Oh no, did he really go there...?
Life can be tough. What happened?

To tell you the truth, I used to be in the ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Arkeum Legion^</c>. I live in this village now, but I witnessed many horrible things during my time in the Legion before I ended up like this.
And ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Malioh^</c> always wants to hear about them, as if he thinks they were great adventures.
Eventually, I grew tired of it, so I told him to find the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>journal^</c> I once kept but had thrown away, as I didn't want to talk about my troubled past.
Well... there's a story. When I deserted the Arkeum, the people of this village were kind enough to take me in, but I couldn't tell anyone about my past.
I wrote it down, thinking it would help me feel better, but it only brought the memories back, so I threw the journal in the trash.

Later, I found one of the pages in the corner of the village, where children were playing with it. My journal must have been torn, rolled up, and ended up in their hands, so I'm sure you can find it somewhere in the village.
I'll see what I can do.
I'll see what I can do.
I'm sorry for the trouble. If you do find Malioh, please tell him to head straight home without delay.
The pages of my journal should be somewhere in the village, if you look for them.
I told him he shouldn't go out alone. I don't know.
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Malioh^</c>? I have, but I don't know where he is. I told him not to go out.
What do you mean because of you?

He was looking for Mr. Cherahnimo's journal, so I told him that my brother, who works at the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Eastern Observation Post^</c>, had seen pages flying around. He said he was going to find them.
I told him not to go, that it's dangerous outside the village, but he won't listen to me. Even my mom says he's as stubborn as a mule.
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Malioh^</c>? I bet he went to the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Eastern Observation Post^</c> to look for pages of some book. Tsk, he never listens to me.
Aww, help. I'm surrounded by ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>wolves^</c> and ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>lycans^</c>.
Did my brother send you? Phew, thank you! I was just trying to find something when all these wolves and lycans showed up.
Well, I didn't see them until I got here. Anyway, can't you make them go away? I want to go to the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Eastern Guard Post^</c> over there. I'll run on my own!
I'll take care of them. Go to the guard post.
Whoa, you're an adventurer, right? I think you're ten times as strong as my brother. Hehe, thanks!
What are you talking about? I still haven't found all the pages! I've got only three so far. I'm not leaving until I've found the rest!
I've been so careful to get this far! If I go home, my mom won't let me leave the house for a week.
So, you're Fabio's little brother, Malioh. You're the talk of the neighborhood.
I know the story behind those pages. I'll tell you. They're in a hard-to-find place, even for veteran adventurers.
You followed this troublemaker all the way here? You're so kind.
Have you seen the rest of the journal?
I have. One of my soldiers picked the pages up, and we read them together. Problem is, some ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>lycans^</c> absconded with them.
I'm guessing that's because they contained information on ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Kowazan's weaknesses^</c>. He's the lycan's chief. I haven't seen them since, so they must be in the lycans' den.
Well, ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Kowazan^</c> met a ^<c=@Codex_AD_HN>witch^</c>, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>abandoned his territory, and fled^</c>, even sacrificing his own soldiers to shield his escape.

I don't know why they took those pages, but since there hasn't been any news of ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Kowazan^</c> since then, I'm guessing they either tried to hide them for their chief or use them to blackmail him and it backfired.
Well, forget about that. He's probably at home waiting. Go back and tell ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Fabio^</c> you found him. I'll send the kid home with a soldier who has finished his shift.
Ah, you're back! Did you find ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Malioh^</c>?
I found him at the Eastern Observation Post.
Say what? Wow, that rascal went all the way there? What was he thinking?
He was looking for Cherahnimo's journal.
What? Really? Gosh, why does he like such weird stuff? Kowazan's witch has to be ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Calanthia^</c>. They say she was a terrifying witch.

In a war that took place ten years ago, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Roen^</c> of the ^<c=@Codex_AD_HN>Order of the Swan^</c> defeated ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Calanthia^</c>. And that very same Roen now serves as the Lord of Belphoret.
Well, no. Not unless you were in that war. I was a kid, but I was interested in that sort of thing - wait, I sound just like Malioh!
Anyway, Calanthia's old ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>wanted poster^</c> is still plastered around. Some people, like Cherahnimo, are still scared that the witch might be alive and well.
If you're interested, go take a look. But I doubt she'll ever come back, no matter how terrifying a witch she was.
^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Calanthia^</c>'s old wanted poster is over here. Let's take a look.
Thank you for finding my brother.
What else can I do to have fun?
Malioh never learns, no matter how much trouble he gets into.
A ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>wanted poster^</c> depicting ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Calanthia^</c>. It's old and faded.
Take a step back in surprise.
That strange expression and eerie laughter must have been your imagination. Now that you look at it again, it's just a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>faded wanted poster^</c>.
"^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Reville Lupius^</c> was slain by ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Clay^</c> and ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Kesion^</c> in the Battle of Belphoret Castle." Is that correct?
"^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Roen Aron^</c> of the Resistance and ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Calanthia^</c> of the Arkeum Legion share a Sylaveth curse as a pair." Is that correct?
Dear Adventurer, I am Canaan of Laslan. The winds have carried word of your great exploits far and wide, and so I take up my pen to ask a favor of you.

If you have the time, could you please come to the ^<c=@Codex_SPINOFF>inn^</c> at the ^<c=@Codex_SPINOFF>plaza in Kastleton^</c>? I would truly, deeply appreciate your assistance with this. I’ll be there, waiting for you. -^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Your Artist, Canaan^</c>-
You see... True art comes from the anticipation...
You are... ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>? Ah, I can tell just by looking at you. Are you here because of my letter?
Did you need something from me?
Ah, quick as a rabbit, you are. Very well, I shall cut to the chase. I should like to borrow your abilities, specifically your extraordinary ability to create detailed records.
Have you heard of the name ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Kordak^</c>? It just so happens I, too, am one who walks the world like them, recording history with the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Moment Recorder^</c>.

Their most recent work was utterly brilliant... beautiful beyond words. The moment I saw it... Oh, how my heart sang. And the name written there alongside their own... was ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>yours^</c>.

Oh, if I only had one wish, it would be to record history with someone of that caliber... A lifelong desire bloomed within me that day. To think that day would come so soon. Shall I be glad? Shall I be sad?
Would you mind getting to the point?

Why of course. There exists a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>ruin^</c> in ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Laslan^</c> that I have wanted to record. But alas! The ruins are so dangerous that they will not let ordinary citizens such as I into them. Who are they? The Laslan Guard, of course.
Though I am glad that the lord is in good health and the region has been safe against the Arkeum attacks, the situation for me has been... difficult. And then, as if by fate, I remembered you.
Where is this place you want me to record?

Oh... Your ability to commit to a task so quickly is an art form in of itself. There is no need to worry. I shall mark it prominently on your map. Could you kindly show me that beautiful ability of yours once again? I shall await your return.
The place I have marked is dangerous, yes, but if it's you... I am most certain you shall be successful. My humble gratitude.
You have returned! Ah, the very definition of pain was this wait! Please, show me immediately!
I'll show you what I recorded.
Upon my word... You have met my expectations to a T. How can I express my gratitude? This is the place in my dreams.
Very long ago, Laslan belonged not to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Solisium^</c>, but to another kingdom, another monarch. This ancient monarch built countless temples in his lifetime, to gods unknown.
This is why Laslan has so many ancient ruins and temples to this day, and more are being discovered. The location I requested for you to record is also one such location.

It is most unfortunate that most of these beautiful ruins have become home to the ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Undead^</c>. Ironic, is it not? That these places of worship should turn into dens for beasts and the Undead.

There is one legend, in fact, of the last king ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Cornelius^</c>. Instead of building his own tomb, he had a mausoleum built for his loyal soldiers, and requested to be laid to rest amongst them.
It is said that when Cornelius lost his life, the king of the invading army was so moved by his devotion that he ordered a tomb for Cornelius to be built. Beautiful story, is it not?

It is folk like me who have resolved to pass down these stories and legends to the future generations. With this in mind, I hope you're willing to work with me again in the future, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>!
Let us do our best as fellow artists to record history together! Haha!
Greetings! Remember me? It's Ollis from the ^<c=@Codex_SPINOFF>Sanctuary Oasis^</c>! I've run into a bit of trouble, and honestly... you're really the only one I can trust to help me out.
If you have time, could you come to the ^<c=@Codex_SPINOFF>Sanctuary Oasis^</c>? Think of it as rescuing someone in need! Please, I'm counting on you! -^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Ollis^</c>-
Hello! I wasn't sure if you'd actually come, but... thank you very much for coming!

Something has come up that needs your urgent attention... As you know, every ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Venelux Investigator^</c> has their designated area and, as such, it's hard for me to go out and deal with this myself... Much to my frustration.

But if I just ignore it, I'm worried that this will blow up, and the guilds have asked me to resolve it in any way possible. And I thought you were just the right person! You can do this, right? Surely, no one else is better suited.
What do I need to do?

There's been a rumor lately that an ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>uncanny noise^</c> is coming from the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Manawastes^</c>. Some are saying it's a creaking noise, while others are reporting the noise of running water... And there have been quite a few reports, too.

Unfortunately, the sound seems to be coming from somewhere ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>underground^</c>, so it's hard to pinpoint the source's exact location. I would need to walk around until I hear it for myself, but I haven't the time...

Of course! There's a merchant that's been complaining about the noise giving him a headache. You should go look for him; his name is ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Rodrigo^</c>. It seems he tried looking into this himself but he's just about given up.
Please look for the merchant Rodrigo. Thank you so much!
Ugh, my head... What am I supposed to do now?
What is it? I'm feeling terribly unwell today, so unless it's urgent, please come back another time.
Ah! You mean that wizard! Finally, someone reliable. I don't know how many days it's been since I've had a proper night's sleep, all because of that ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>accursed noise^</c>!

I hired an adventurer to investigate the situation, but they were chased off by a monster, leaving everything behind! Then they had the gall to say all that's left is to find the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>journal with the location written in it^</c>.

They said the last place they camped was near the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Manawastes Waypoint^</c>. Perhaps they left it there? You'd think an adventurer would... Ugh, my apologies. This is not the time to vent.
In any case, I implore that you find that journal and resolve this. Perhaps I'm just a light sleeper, but it's been excruciating to not be able to get a proper night's sleep.
Please go to the ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Manawastes Waypoint^</c> and find the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>adventurer's camp^</c>.
It's an abandoned adventurer's backpack. It holds essential items for travel. This must be what they dropped while fleeing.
Among the miscellaneous travel items, there appears to be a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>journal detailing the expedition^</c>.
Looks like you've arrived at the location marked on the map.
Looks like you've arrived at the location marked on the map.
Looks like you've arrived at the location marked on the map.
You observe the surroundings and listen for a moment, but nothing stands out. Time to try another location.
You hear the wind, but nothing seems out of the ordinary. Let's check the other places.

From the gaping hole in the ground you can hear ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>deep bellowing winds^</c>, with a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>faint stream of mana^</c> seeping out. It feels as though something special may lie beneath.
What appears to be a Guardian's Pledge lies on the ground.
The time has come... The time we've so long been waiting for!
Please stop, master... Please... What are you trying to do?!
Did you not promise? Huh? That you would help me obtain this power.
But if it defies me until the very end, you must fulfill that promise by relinquishing your power to me instead!
How could you... I trusted you like I would trust my own father!
You were only a tool for me from the beginning! Why else would I ever raise a Dark Elf child in the first place? Hehehe...
Now, your power is mine! Become a Guardian's Pledge for me!
It would be best for you to give up now!
No...! Was it... All in vain...?!
A shadow's emerging... from that monolith!
You must shield yourself, then destroy the monolith!
Yes, that's right. I grew up in a setting not too different from here, in an underground village. But I lost my family through war.
The person who found me and raised me was... none other than the man you just saw... I thought of him as my father and... my master...
Though I could not… defeat him as you did, I did fight to the very end. I defeated every one of the minions he summoned, and… in the end, I killed my master… with my own... hands.
But I lost my life as well. Through the Magic Circle my master created, I became a Guardian's Pledge. Now that he is gone, my life holds no meaning, and I have no one left to serve.
Why don't you come with me?
You wish to borrow my... power? Why...?
I'm fighting against people of the same kind.
I see. So this world is still...
Alright. I'll go with you. In order to stop those who oppress and steal from the weak... all for nothing but their own selfish greed.
Very well... I'll lend my power to you.
You're back! So, how did it go?
There shouldn't be any more trouble now.
Oh, thank you, thank you! Maybe I can finally get a full night's sleep. If you don't mind me asking... What did you find?
It's probably better if you don't know.
Is that so? Ah, ha ha! Of course no, no need for me to know the cause, no! As long as the problem's resolved! If I can just sleep properly... I'm more than grateful!
Is that so? Ah, well... It's not really important what caused it, right? I mean... What is important is that I finally get a good night's sleep. Thank you. Thank you again!
If we meet again, I'll make sure to give you a discount! Thank you!
Haha! Now where should I go to create my next record?
Clear signs of a camp remain here.
Miscellaneous items and baggage remain as if their owner left in a hurry. They must belong to the adventurer who fled.
A moss-covered, timeworn lantern is glowing.
Massive tree trunks are blocking the path.
The lantern, though it seems to have gone unused for ages, is still glowing.
Could it be an object enchanted with special magic? For now, you should look around more.
There's a sheer cliff at one side of the cave, and below it, water can be seen flowing.
It looks like you can't go any farther from here.
A girl who looks to be in her teens is lying on the ground, gasping for breath.
It seems it will take some time before she regains consciousness. Try examining the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Guardian's Pledge^</c> that separated from her.
A faint trace of mana can still be felt flowing along the trunks.
Let's use the power of the Star Fragment to find out what happened here.
This seems to be the location Canaan marked on the map.
You set up the Moment Recorder borrowed from Canaan.
Broken rocks are clustered together unnaturally.

These don't look like ordinary rocks. They seem to be ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Broken Golem Fragments^</c>. Did those golems cause the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Weird Sound^</c> from underground...? If so, who shattered them?
There's a book that looks quite old.
It's filled with unknown symbols. You can't make out a single thing.
A mysterious structure entwined with tree roots stands here, its unusual shape suggesting a symbol of some kind.
The ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>faint magical energy^</c> that was seeping from the cracks in the earth lingers within this structure.
Let's use the power of the Star Fragment to find out what happened here.
Get on top of the giant orb and dodge the attack!
Now, on to the last part. As you go about your business, you may encounter Explorer Oremongs who suddenly ask for your help.
When that happens, hurry over to rescue them, and they'll let you buy an Oremong's Exploration Chest. They'll be selling other valuable items, too!

Greetings, adventurer! My name is ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Nikolaj^</c>, and I am a scholar conducting research in Stonegard. I've been eager to speak with you about the Moment Recorder that has been the talk of the Historical Society lately.
I also have a favor to ask. If you happen to have the time, please visit ^<c=@Codex_SPINOFF>Vienta Village^</c>. – From a humble and earnest scholar –
The schema should be fine... right? Whew, I'm nervous.
Oh, hello there! You must be ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>, right?
Oh, it's an honor! You really came! Haha, meeting someone so well-known makes me somewhat nervous. I'm ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Nikolaj^</c>, a scholar—please, just call me Niko.
There's no need to be nervous.
Haha, how kind of you! Thank you for coming all this way. I heard you recently helped with recording some meaningful historical evidence, and that's something truly valued.
As it happens, I've been researching ways to make that very ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Moment Recorder^</c> even more useful. If you can believe such a thing is possible.

Would you mind using the one I've installed at the designated site and then bringing back the record sheet afterward? I've installed a small ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>magic schema^</c> to it so, now, it has a new function.
Thank you so much! If there are any monsters or bandits around, you'll need to set it up yourself. Deal with them swiftly and then use the Moment Recorder. Hehehe... I can't wait to see the results!
I'm so anxious to find out if the new model of the Moment Recorder actually works...
This seems to be the place Niko specified.
You set up the new Moment Recorder borrowed from Niko.

Vienta Port was the first harbor established by humans who ventured into Stonegard. The land of Stonegard is surrounded by towering mountains to the west and deep forests ruled by lycans to the north.
Thus, their ancestors reached the once-fertile lands of Stonegard by sea and named the port Vienta after the gentle wind that guided them to the vast grasslands.

The settlers of Vienta gained fertile soil but soon faced relentless attacks from the monsters roaming the plains. To defend the village, they built a tall tower on a nearby hill to protect themselves.

Each day, people climbed the tower to watch for danger and shout warnings to others. Later, Vienta Village entered into a trade pact with Avella, who gifted them a massive bell to serve as a new warning signal.
Then, one day, a cursed rain began to fall over Stonegard's once-prosperous plains. Trees and grass decayed, animals turned into twisted monsters, and drinkable water vanished.
In order to stop the corruption from spreading, the wizards had to drive great magical wedges into Stonegard's water veins. This restored access to water, but turned the plains into a parched desert.

Archwizard Kal Taras discovered that Skultus, the Grand Elder of Sylaveth, had cast the cursed rain upon Stonegard. Kal Taras pursued Skultus and finally confronted the wicked wizard in a fierce battle.

Their magical duel raged for days, shaking all of Stonegard. When the magical storm finally subsided, the cursed rain ceased as well. The people of Stonegard built a memorial to honor Kal Taras's deeds for eternity.
The Lord of Stonegard asked how he could possibly repay Kal Taras for vanquishing Skultus. In response, Kal Taras pleaded that no force of darkness ever be allowed to take root in Stonegard again.

In accordance with his wish, the Lord purged the followers of Sylaveth. To seal the temple where the followers had conducted their vile experiments, the Lord built a great fortress atop it, which became what is now known as Stonegard Castle.
It was peculiar for it to have a voice.
Haha, I see! Did it record well? What did you think of the content?
I'm relieved to hear that! I've been thinking about how I could help more people learn about our history for quite some time. After all, books aren't always easy for everyone to access.
And relying on bards doesn't quite work, either. They focus more on telling entertaining stories than preserving historical truth. That's what gave me this idea!

What if people could see the very scenes of history before their eyes, and hear the explanations directly from a scholar right there on the spot? If this works, far more people would remember our past, wouldn't they?
Haha, really? Oh my, just being able to share the story of ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Kal Taras^</c>, the hero I most admire, makes me so happy!
Now, I'll need to organize and record the other stories I want to share. There are just so many, and it's actually much harder than I thought to keep them brief.
If I ever become well-known, I'll be sure to make your name known alongside mine. Thank you so much for your help, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>!
Hmm, what should I tell next? The tale of George Wyvern, the notorious thief of his age? Or perhaps the story of Archwizard Soren Warnach...

Hello hello, Adventurer! I'm sending this parrot mail because I have a favor to ask of you. A very, very important one! And it's top secret, so please keep it between the two of us. Let's meet without drawing attention!

I'll be waiting under the Startree in ^<c=@Codex_SPINOFF>Kastleton Square^</c>! The best place to hide is always among a crowd, don't you think? And around this time, it's sure to be packed with people! - ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Elliah, Solisium Housing Association, Kastleton^</c> -
When, oh when, will you come?
You're here! You're really here, Adventurer! I'm so so glad to see you! How's your home coming along? Are you decorating it nicely?

You're here! You're really here, Adventurer! I'm so so glad to see you! I sent you that letter because I have something super important to ask! You're so popular and amazing these days, so I just knew you were perfect for this!

Now, now, you do know what time of year it is, don't you? Yup yup, that's right—it's the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Startree Solstice^</c>! It's that magical season when children who've been good all year are rewarded with gifts from the Fairy herself!

I know, I know, it's usually the parents who prepare the gifts. They find out what their kids like, wrap the presents, and tell them they came ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>straight from the Fairy^</c>. It's all part of being grown-up!

Here, now here's the thing. As you know, there are so many children who've lost their parents because of the war. Some are far from their families, too. Now you understand. That's why the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Resistance^</c> is holding a special event to deliver gifts to those children.
That's right, right? Laslan's safer than most other areas, so we have many refugee children here as well. And of course, every one of them deserves a gift of their own, don't you think?
So please, please, I need your help, Adventurer! If the adults around ask what they want, the kids will figure out right away! And if the Resistance shows up in uniform, they'll get scared!

Vienta Port was the first harbor established by humans who ventured into Stonegard.
The land of Stonegard is surrounded by towering mountains to the west and deep forests ruled by lycans to the north.
Thus, their ancestors reached the once-fertile lands of Stonegard by sea,
and named the port Vienta after the gentle wind that guided them to the vast grasslands.
The settlers of Vienta gained fertile soil but soon faced relentless attacks from the monsters roaming the plains.
To defend the village, they built a tall tower on a nearby hill to protect themselves.
Each day, people climbed the tower to watch for danger and shout warnings to others.
Later, Vienta Village entered into a trade pact with Avella, who gifted them a massive bell to serve as a new warning signal.
Then, one day, a cursed rain began to fall over Stonegard's once-prosperous plains.
Trees and grass decayed, animals turned into twisted monsters, and drinkable water vanished.
In order to stop the corruption from spreading, the wizards had to drive great magical wedges into Stonegard's water veins.
This restored access to water, but turned the plains into a parched desert.
Archwizard Kal Taras discovered that Skultus, the Grand Elder of Sylaveth, had cast the cursed rain upon Stonegard.
Kal Taras pursued Skultus and finally confronted the wicked wizard in a fierce battle.
Their magical duel raged for days, shaking all of Stonegard. When the magical storm finally subsided, the cursed rain ceased as well.
The people of Stonegard built a memorial to honor Kal Taras's deeds for eternity.
The Lord of Stonegard asked how he could possibly repay Kal Taras for vanquishing Skultus.
In response, Kal Taras pleaded that no force of darkness ever be allowed to take root in Stonegard again.
In accordance with his wish, the Lord purged the followers of Sylaveth.
To seal the temple where the followers had conducted their vile experiments, the Lord built a great fortress atop it, which became what is now known as Stonegard Castle.

A letter... Can I still deliver it...?
Is this how I disappear... quietly, without anyone noticing? It's a bit sad...
Wait, why is this person still here? Could it be...
Can you hear my voice too?
Oh dear, you can only say yes.
Oh, sorry. You kept staring, so I was a bit... startled, I guess. Maybe scared, too... Or I thought maybe you could only say yes, so I...

Yes, and you're a messenger, aren't you?
A messenger! You knew! That's right. I've finally found the owner of this letter. Here's the letter!

TL has already celebrated its 2nd anniversary.
Perhaps because it received so much love,
I had a child after the 1st anniversary.
I had another child after the 2nd anniversary.
3rd anniversary, 4th anniversary... TL must go on... but it would be troublesome if they keep coming...

- Designer pondering the future
It was a difficult duty, but thankfully I completed it safely. I'm relieved.
Looking like this, I thought I'd quietly slip away without anyone noticing.
Will you pass on to the afterlife now?
I'm not a real ghost! I'm just going back to where I came from.
Looks like you haven't received all the letters yet. Head over there, why don't you?
I'll take my time and enjoy the scenery as I go.
Would you like to read the letter again?
P-person... Looking for... for someone... Ugh...

Y-you will? Thank you! No one would listen to me... It's been so hard...
Are you a messenger with a letter?

And your appearance is different than usual?
Oh my! How did you... know that? I'm getting chills...
And you're trying to deliver a letter to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>?
Are you... a god? You know everything!

Title: Birthday Punches
Sender: Healer Kim
I've been really into Housing lately.
I've been chopping so many trees, my forearms might've gotten even thicker.
So, whose back should I smack?
I'm glad I delivered the letter. Talking to people... It's been so hard. Everyone keeps glancing at me... like they're avoiding me...

Did you come back to check the letter? Or, to scratch... my back...?
Ah! Attention! No problems! Thank you!

Hi!

I'm pretty much TL's mascot at this point!

Bye!
