Hm, I could tell from the spider webs all over your shoes. Has Rutaine already finished his investigation?
Hm? Can I help you? Do you have business here?
What? He discovered an ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>order to kidnap children^</c>? Dear Gods! No wonder we were unable to find any traces, no matter how hard we searched...
Hang on... Hmm, now that you mention it, something did feel off back there. I'd better investigate again.
Wait, what things are you talking about?
I saw some ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Wrecked Carriages^</c> here and there across the Nesting Grounds. They seemed strange, but I didn't notice anything particular...
But what if the kidnappers did that on purpose so there wouldn't be any clues left...?
That's what happened. I'll check again for even the smallest trace they might have left behind to tell us who did this or where they went.

Hoho, alright, then! You seem to know what you're doing. I'll go and investigate over this way, so could you take a look at the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Abandoned Carriage^</c> and the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Terror Bird nest^</c> over there?
Alright, I'll go and track down the kidnappers. If you find anything, come back over here. Let's share what we find.
What's wrong? You're not sure where to look? I marked it on your map, so use that. Ah, don't forget to check the Terror Bird nest, too.
Quick now, we must find the Arkeum's hideout and rescue the kidnapped children.
Ha, I knew from the moment I saw you that there was fight in you! I didn't expect to end up owing you my life, though.
So that all this wasn't in vain, I'm going to make sure that the Arkeum's plot never comes to fruition. Don't worry!
There don't seem to be any clues here. But as Robert said, the evidence may be concealed.
The carriage seat is loose. When you shake it, the inside is hollow, and there's a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>document hidden inside^</c>.
"Kastleton" is written at the very top, and there are people's names listed underneath. Are these the names of ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Kastleton inhabitants^</c>?
There don't seem to be any clues here. But as Robert said, the evidence may be concealed.
The bottom of the carriage is slightly raised. When you shake it, you find a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>ledger hidden^</c> in it.
"Vienta" is written at the very top, and there are people's names listed underneath. Are these the names of ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Vienta Village^</c> inhabitants, as Rutaine said?
A board on the seat seems loose. When you shake the board, there's an empty space inside, and there's a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>scroll hidden^</c> in it.
"Golden Rye" is written at the end of the scroll. There are people's names written at the bottom, and they seem to be residents of the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Golden Rye Pastures^</c>.

There's a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>piece of a broken sword^</c> in the Terror Bird's corpse. It looks like the Terror Bird that attacked the carriage returned to its nest with the sword stuck in it and eventually died.
Perhaps Robert will know who owned the carriage if you show the engravings on the blade to him.
This is the Terror Bird's corpse. There's nothing else special about it.
An ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>arrow^</c>, which seems to be one of Robert's, is stuck in the cart. After looking for a hidden document, there doesn't seem to be one hidden in the cart.

A trace of footprints is here, but they are faint. Someone deliberately attempted to erase them. Robert's ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>footprints^</c> appear to follow the fainter ones, leading from the cart to the north hill.
These are detailed orders to conduct the current invasion operation of the Arkeum Legion secretly so the Resistance doesn't catch on.
It is a registry of children sent to the Arkeum Legion hideout using the Magic Circle at the back.
Under the name of Zaroth, Arkeum Infiltration Unit Captain, it says that ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>"Calanthia's Plan"^</c> must succeed for Kazar.
These are instructions to discreetly collect as many children as possible at the assembly area, to determine which children possess ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mauvessence^</c> and should be kidnapped.
There's a Magic Circle with an unknown purpose drawn on the ground. Tread with caution.
A complex schema is drawn on the ground. It looks like the Magic Circle from the ledger.
Given that there are small footprints here and there in the Magic Circle, it must have been used to move the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>kidnapped children^</c>.
There are large footprints that appear to be Robert's which overlap the children's footprints. Robert must have already been here.
It's the wrecked carriage you saw earlier. Fortunately, the kidnapped children are safe.
It's a wrecked carriage. It appears to have been destroyed in a Terror Bird attack.
It's the abandoned carriage you saw earlier. The same thing shouldn't happen again now that the Terrific Trio is guarding this place.
It's an abandoned carriage. The wheel is broken. Is that why it was abandoned?
It's the broken carriage you saw earlier. There won't be any issues now.
It's a broken carriage. What happened to the people who were on it?
They're orders for the Arkeum Legion. Luckily you were able to prevent the nightmare of the past from reoccurring.
It's a paper with something written on it. These are orders for someone.
It's a ledger from the Arkeum Legion. It's fortunate that no more names were added after Sophia took charge of public order.
There's a pile of books of unknown purpose. They have lists of people's names circled or erased.
It's the cart used to kidnap the children. Hopefully it won't be used again.
It's an abandoned cart. It's unclear why it was abandoned.
It's the Magic Circle used to transport the kids. It no longer seems to work.
It's an old flag. It has the mark of the Solisium Royal Legions Academy's marine department.
It appears to be the flag they received from DaVinci in their training days. It has the mark of the Solisium Royal Legions Academy's marine department.
It's thanks to you that I surv- Actually, no, I had it all under control. But why did you come alone?
Phew... someone worries too much. Are reinforcements coming? Then, go save the children, quickly.
Be careful. I'm sure there are still some soldiers inside. Well, you can hide behind me if you like.
Who goes there! Have you come here with a death wish?
Damn, there are lots of them! This should be fun!
Adventurer, just focus and fight. I'll support you!
Robert, you fool! Rushing in recklessly again with no regard for what's around you!
We'd better tidy things up here a bit first. Let's go!
Haha! You're a sight for sore eyes! Now that ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>DaVinci^</c> is here, I can take a breather!
They're here! The children are locked up!
Bring it on, curs of Kazar!
Stay focused! Sophia, you must rescue the children immediately!
Rutaine, please hurry and open it. Who knows what they've been up to in the meantime.
I need to focus on my magic. Wait... done.
I want an update on the situation.
I'm glad it's not too late. That Robert, really...
We meet again. Thank you for helping me out in this dangerous place.
There's nothing to fear now that you brought backup with you. Let's go rescue the children!
There's nothing to fear now that you brought backup with you. Let's go rescue the children!
My name is DaVinci, and I'm the leader of the Resistance. It doesn't seem like we've got much time for small talk.
We are in haste to rescue the children.
Not only do we need to rescue the kids, but we also have to hurry to find the culprit.
Would you mind lending us your strength for a little longer?
I'll do just that for as long as possible.
Thank you. I'd love to chat longer, but we're out of time for now. Let's set off.
We'll take care of the children. But I'm worried we can't find the mastermind.
It was worth the rush. I mean, I was nervous.
We've saved all the children, but it isn't over yet. These were all lower rank soliders we just fought. Their commander must be around here somewhere.
Understood. Sophia will leave with the children in tow.
I'll take responsibility for the children. Don't worry.
Ugh... I'm a little anxious. We'll look over here, and you please search inside there.
Those dirty Arkeum rats. I'll look inside the passages here. You go over there.
What's that energy? There seems to be something ahead. Be on guard.
That can't have been an easy fight. You okay?
Not an issue for me, I'm fine.
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>, countless children were saved thanks to you. You prevented untold, irrevocable harm. Thank you.
This isn't the end. Arkeum remains a threat.
Many have gathered under the banner of the Resistance to stop them. There are others like you who are brave enough to risk their lives.
I was only doing what had to be done.
There's no need to be humble. Word is spreading of your exploits in Laslan. I've heard much about you.
Not long ago, someone with a Star Fragment appeared in Kastleton seeking help. And that someone then began helping others after their own problem was solved. Was that you?
Bearers of the Star Fragments are suffering in many ways, just as you and the kidnapped children have experienced. Even so, the power of the Fragments has great potential.
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>, if you join us, it may be possible to realize that potential. What do you say?
There is a pool of blood on the floor.
Of course, the Terrific Trio aren't famous for nothing. All three are wonderful, even if they are young.
Are those people... from the famous Resistance?
It was really scary, but I didn't cry.
Oh, you caught me. You must be pretty good, if you managed to notice me watching. I am Baize, from the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Endless Collectors Association^</c>.
Our organization is collecting every kind of ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>equipment^</c> there is. In the beginning, we only collected tools crafted by the most decorated craft masters.
But we soon realized that no matter how insignificant the equipment, each has a piece of its crafters' soul in it. That's why we decided to collect everything in the world.
We invented the Lithograph Book to help make that a little easier. With a tool like this one, anyone can lend a hand in collecting equipment. What do you say? Do you want to try it out?
Sure! We'll accept anything. We don't care if it's new or old. It's even fine if you don't have the equipment on hand just yet. You're welcome anytime!
Happy to have help from a capable adventurer like you. Thank you in advance!
When you have any unused equipment, check your ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Lithograph Book^</c>!
I know people won't understand our noble goal... Anyways, we don't mind if the equipment you hand in is new or a used one.
You seem like a capable adventurer, I look forward to your help. Thank you very much in advance!
I'll take you all with me!
Is he trying to bring down the whole place?!
I'll try to stop him! Watch for my attack!
Zaroth, this won't end the way you want!
(Sigh)... Kazar's popularity is growing once more.
To think he'd remain loyal to Kazar even as he was being abandoned...
Oh no, could I have forgotten it?
Oh, hello. What are you doing here?
Well, I was thinking of making some accessories while I'm here. But I left the materials at home. Drat, I was looking forward to making an entry in my ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Lithograph Book^</c>.
Huh? You don't know what the Lithograph Book is? You can put equipment you don't use into the book, and receive various ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Upgrade Materials^</c>.
I heard that merchants from a faraway continent created this book to collect equipment in Solisium. Just a rumor, though.
I feel like someone is watching me... Could it be one of my fans? This is so tiresome!
That's strange. Someone was looking at me...
Hm. Have you finished investigating the area? Tell me what you found.
These ledgers... These look like children's names. Look, this ledger says "Vienta," and ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Lucille^</c>'s name is checked off.
That's the name of the child we're looking for. But there are other names that have been checked off here, too. Then, she isn't the only child they've kidnapped...
Hm, you're very thorough! A ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>sword^</c> stuck in the corpse of a Terror Bird... Hm? There was a pattern like this on the sword?
Damn it! That's used by the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Arkeum Legion^</c>. Could they be responsible for all these kidnappings?
We need to act fast. I discovered a wrecked cart, in which I found a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>piece of a partly burnt map^</c>. You know what that means, right?
I'm going after those scoundrels, so please take this map piece to Sophia in ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Vienta^</c>. She'll know what to do with it.
There seems to be no end to the incidents. It's time that the Resistance must stand together even more firmly.
What is it? I'm in the middle of an important mission, so unless it's urgent, please come to me about it another time.
Robert? He should be in the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Nesting Grounds^</c> investigating the missing child case right now... What did he say?
I found this clue and here's the situation...
Damn it! So, it wasn't a simple missing child case after all. One moment, I found a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>piece of a map^</c> while searching around here, too. If we put these two together...
Oh dear, this shows a staging area of the Arkeum Legion! I will inform Captain DaVinci immediately and we will stage a rescue! Thank you for your help. I'd better contact Robert and Rutaine, too...
What? He went to the staging area alone? That fool! Who knows how many Arkeum soldiers will be there?!
I'm sorry to ask more of you, but could you hurry to the place on the map and help Robert? Knowing him, he might have jumped in already, though.
Going alone may well get you killed. I will report to Captain DaVinci as quickly as possible and lead reinforcements there.
Thank you so much! Looking at the map, the place is over a stone bridge on the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>north side of the Nesting Grounds^</c>. I'll mark the exact location on your map.
What needs to be done again?
Go to the place over the stone bridge on the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>north side of the Nesting Grounds^</c> that I marked on your map, help Robert. He may have already jumped into action, so please hurry!
Thanks to you, we were able to save the children and that fool, Robert. I thought my heart would drop right out of my... Ahem, n-never mind.
I heard that the one you and Captain DaVinci defeated was the Arkeum Legion Captain for this area. I'm glad we don't have to worry about any more big threats for the time being.
You're back. We've brought all the children back safely and came back here after discussing what to do with the hideout. You aren't hurt, I hope?
They are really frightened but everyone is fine. Nothing but a few minor injuries. It's all thanks to you and Robert taking action so quickly.
By the way, the kidnapping orders have the title of "^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Calanthia's Plan^</c>"... Calanthia is the name of an Arkeum witch who was well-known up until a few years ago.

There were rumors that she had died, but I don't know what really happened. Looking at the order, it seems they're gathering children with the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Mauvessence^</c> and trying to extract it from them.
When I was a child, I endured something similar.
You too? No wonder Captain DaVinci seemed to be talking to you about it especially. I've also heard of that power, but I had no idea the Arkeum were so obsessed with it.

Captain DaVinci personally accepted you into the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Resistance^</c>, so please feel free to ask for help if you ever feel that you may be in danger, too. The Resistance was created to fight the Arkeum Legion.
It seems you respect the captain.
The truth is, the captain saved our lives when we were young - Rutaine, Robert, and I. We owe our lives to him, and we respect and admire him more than anyone else.
When he saved us, I swore... that when I grew up, the three of us would form a guild and become people who could be of service to him.
Captain DaVinci also encouraged us by gifting us the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>flag^</c> he kept with him from when he was a trainee so long ago. His support made us the force we are today.
We intend to keep a close eye on the Arkeum soldiers' movements. Of course, we will also try to grow the guild and be of even greater service to the Resistance.
Haha, well, thank you. But after experiencing what happened this time, I feel like the three of us alone aren't enough. I felt it even more deeply with you helping us.

I think it's time for our guild to let go of the name "The Terrific Trio." We are so much stronger when we stand together than when we stand alone. Our guild is greater than the sum of its members, just like Captain DaVinci's Resistance.
What exactly is your relationship with Rutaine and Robert?
Rutaine is my younger brother and Robert is a friend I've known since childhood. We grew up together and now we've formed a guild.
As we took on contracts together, large and small, we've become quite famous throughout the Resistance. People call us "The Terrific Trio."
As more and more people ask for our help, it's been hard for the three of us alone to handle. Thanks to you, we managed this time as well.
In fact, we were originally stationed in ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Laslan^</c>, but we've been sent here to deal with an incident.

The man we admire, Captain DaVinci, is leader of the Resistance forces in ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Laslan^</c>, while the Resistance forces in ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Stonegard^</c>, which includes Vienta Village, are led by Jacque Hander.
The Resistance steps up during emergencies, no matter which region requires aid. Guilds may also shift focus from one region to another as needed. At such times, the Guild Base can be helpful indeed.
Oh, you've never used the Guild Base? I see. Well, there's a Guild Base here in Vienta Village.
It seems you have already joined a guild, so why don't you take this opportunity to use it?
Well, if you would like to know more about Guild Bases, why don't you try visiting ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Vienta's Guild Merchant^</c>, Soleil, for some more useful details.
There must already be several guilds with their eyes on you. Don't tell me you didn't know?
Oh, Rutaine wants to see you. He'll be waiting for you in Carmine Forest.
What kind of guild activities are there in Vienta?
Sophia personally sent you... You must be close with the Terrific Trio.
Can you tell me more about guilds?
Let me know if you need anything!
Oh, I do yammer on. Let me explain about the Guild Base. What would you like to know?
The Guild Base is exclusive for highly active guilds. Any guild can use it under the right conditions.
In the Guild Base, you can go on Guild Raids or test your skills with others at the Sparring Ground.
It's also useful since there's a guild-exclusive Sundries Merchant, Storage Manager, and merchants that accept Guild Coins.
How do I get into the Guild Base?
To find the Guild Base, go to the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Artisan Plaza^</c> here in Vienta Village. You'll find a door that leads there.
If you get lost, just check your map. Set the Guild Base in the Artisan Plaza as your destination.
So, there are merchants at the Guild Base?
Merchants like me trade in Guild Coins, but there are also special merchants who only provide goods to the Guild Leader and Guild Advisors.
Many items can be useful during Castle Siege, so please tell your Guild Leader or Advisors to try them.
I think I've become familiar with guild activities. Lots to do!
Your standing in your guild has risen, adventurer. If you keep working hard in your guild's activities, you can earn Guild Coins based on your contribution each week.
Anything else you'd like to ask?
Where exactly can one use Guild Coins?
With Guild Coins, you can buy some nice items from Guild Merchants like me, so I recommend taking a look.
I think that's enough talk for one day. Send my regards to Sophia. I'll be cheering you on, adventurer.
You've been kind to tutor me in guild ways.
No problem. Sophia introduced you to me herself, so it was my pleasure. Please come by anytime.
If you have time, could you go see Rutaine in Carmine Forest? I think he has a favor to ask of you.
It looks like you've already found a guild that matches your ideals. To tell you the truth, I would have liked to have you in our guild, but I'm glad that you already have such great comrades.
I appreciate all this interest, but I'm going to have to turn down this offer.
Don't say that. Just knowing that you're part of the Resistance is enough for me.
I suppose we're rivals now. Our guild won't be left behind.
It's more than an honor to be your rival.
Rather, we are honored. We'll be walking separate paths for now, but I look forward to the day that we face the Arkeum together again on the battlefield.
The Terrific Trio will always be cheering you on your path.
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>, you're here! Thank you for coming! Thanks to you, everything worked out. I'm in your debt.
Hello, how can I be of service?
Oh, you see... Do you remember the Mana Recording Device we set up to monitor Morokai? When I came back from looking for the children, I felt a suspicious energy from it.

I explored the area, and there are strange entities called ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Soul Arbiters^</c> appearing in the forest lately. If you defeat one, a small flame spirit will emerge and lead you to another area.

I think they lead toward ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Syleus's Abyss^</c>. Anyway, we don't know what else will happen in the forest if we just leave them be. The problem is, it's hard for me to explore the area alone.
Thank you so much! Sophia and Robert couldn't help me because they're busy...
What do you need me to do?

Again, when you eliminate one of the Soul Arbiters that appear in the forest, a small ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>flame spirit^</c> will appear. Please follow it and find out the cause of the suspicious energy.
According to local guards, you can hear a terrible scream when several Soul Arbiters gather in one place. Maybe that has something to do with this energy?
Oh, and when you enter ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Syleus's Abyss^</c>, please be sure to do so in a group. It's a dangerous place to be alone.
Follow the little ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>flame spirit^</c> that emerges when you defeat a Soul Arbiter, and find out what's causing them. Good luck.
Welcome back. Did you find anything?
I came upon a spirit named Circe.
I see. ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Circe^</c>... I've heard tales of her before. She was said to have used dark magic to control spirits, so the townsfolk got spooked and had her banished.
No one has seen or heard of her since then, but I never thought she'd end up in Syleus's Abyss... By the way, did anything weird happen there?
According to the spellbook of Hale Verpheus, a unique phenomenon called the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Abyssal Contract^</c> occurs in places dominated by darkness.
It is said that hunting monsters outside such realms like Syleus's Abyss accumulates a special energy, which then manifests itself upon entering said realms.
Apparently, this sort of thing only happens to Star Fragment-bearers and it can greatly increase their strength and skills. If so, perhaps you...
Yes, yes I think I've experienced something like that!
See what happens the next time you go into a dark place like that. Perhaps you can use this phenomenon to your advantage.
Anyway, thank you for your help with the investigation. We need to look more closely at the relationship between Circe and Syleus.
How did you follow me here? Where's Sophia?
Phew, luckily they weren't much of a challenge.
This isn't over... We have to find Zaroth.
Robert! Rutaine! We need to find their ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Commander^</c>!
We need to find the mastermind behind all this!
You've done rather well to get this far!
So this is where you were, ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>Zaroth^</c>!
Today's the day I take your head!
Death is the only path for those who interfere with the will of Kazar!
There's no place for the likes of you in Laslan!
Keep your guard up! He's tougher than he looks!
Please take the map to Sophia! Hurry! I'll go to the location on the map and do what I can to protect the children!
Blasted Arkeum, they kept children in such a foul place!
The children must be deeper in!
How's your Lithograph Book going? Do you need my help?
I'm not sure. But I heard that merchants from a faraway continent created this book to collect equipment in Solisium.
Some adventurers claim that they actually saw the merchants. But I say rumors are rumors, until they are actually proven.
I feel like someone is watching me... Could it be one of my fans? Haha, it's a joke!
Why did they make the Lithograph Book?
There are millions of equipment in the world, and our group alone won't be able to collect them all.
So we made Lithograph Books to have some help from adventurers. They will be rewarded for helping us as well.
I've always had an interest in the Terrific Trio. You must be special if Sophia personally guided you.
Please help Robert until we arrive.
The flag DaVinci gifted us has been raised above the barracks, where it will be visible from the square.
Ah, it's nice to see you again. Are you here to ask me something?
Blasted Arkeum, to do this to children...
Oh, I forgot to tell you. Rutaine wants to see you.
Hi, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>! I hope you're doing well! I have something to ask you.
It's about ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Clay^</c>. If you're free, could you stop by ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Kastleton^</c>?
I'll be waiting! Please stop by. - ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Soiri^</c>
Then, the head of the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Order of the Swan^</c> is ^<c=@Codex_AD_HN>Roen^</c>...?
Oh, my friends and I are going to represent Kastleton at the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Belphoret Reclamation Festival^</c>!
What kind of event is that?
Oh, it's to celebrate driving the Arkeum out of Belphoret Castle! Each town selects representatives to put on a show.
Some representatives sing, others do elaborate dances.
We're doing a play about the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Order of the Swan^</c>, the knights who fought valiantly for ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Belphoret Castle^</c>!
I've done a lot of research, but there's still so much I don't know.
^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Clay^</c> was there that day, and since you're close with him, so I thought I'd ask you, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>.
Um, if it isn't any trouble... I'd love to meet Clay? In person? Sorry I know everyone's busy, maybe that's too much...
Clay has traveled to Nix and is far away.
Ah... I see... Mm, then... could you just borrow his book from the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Purelight Tower^</c> library for me?
I tried to borrow it myself, but they wouldn't let me because I'm not a student. But Clay's book would be really helpful for my performance!
Really? Thank you! In the meantime, I'll work on what I can! I can't wait!
The book is titled "^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>The Order of the Swan and the Reclamation of Belphoret^</c>!"
Did you forget? It's a long title: "^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>The Order of the Swan and the Reclamation of Belphoret^</c>!"
(Sigh) I'm not even close to being done. This is going to take ages on my own...
I'm sorry, we're unable to lend books right now. We're short staffed and still recovering from Arkeum's attack.
Many of the books here ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>radiate mana^</c>, so I had been treating them with an ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>anti-magic solution^</c> to prevent any accidents when they attacked.
Now that we're finally able to take stock, I have to ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>re-treat^</c> all the books. It's tedious work...
You're part of the Resistance, can you help? It's simple work, and I could use a hand.
Thank you for your help. All you have to do is spray some of that ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>anti-magic solution^</c> on any books that radiate mana.
Just spray that anti-magic solution onto any books radiating mana.
Spraying it might ^<c=@MK_UI_Contract>agitate^</c> the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>books^</c>, so be careful. Um, you'll know what I mean when you get there.
Just apply this anti-magic spray onto any books radiating mana.
Look over there! A book is flying away!
Look, a book is flying around!
I wish my broom could fly like that!
Oh, you're quite the efficient worker.
You must be a librarian at heart. Considering a career change?
I'm actually here to borrow a book.
Of course. It'd be my pleasure to lend you one of our books.

Hmm, you remind me of someone... A while back, ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Clay^</c> visited here with a ^<c=@Codex_AD_HN>Resistance soldier^</c>, one who'd been appointed by ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>DaVinci^</c> himself. You look similar...
Wait a moment... That was you, wasn't it! You're the famed "^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>{gva_PcName}^</c>" who defended Purelight Tower and saved Clay!

My father always wanted our family to live together in a safe place.
I'm going to rebuild our family home, a place with so many happy memories. Hopefully with my brother's help, despite our falling out.

Seeing that the scary guy that Uncle Quentin warned about doesn't even show his face, maybe we can do some more exploration! The end!

Best you have a companion should death scare you.
I see your will is as sharp as ever, futile as it may be.
However, a true warrior craves for more.
Fight or get eaten! Awaken the beast within and fight!
Come forth! I shall test your mettle myself!
My warriors, give them the true taste of the hellish depths below!
The Earthen God has blessed you in my stead.
Is this what you call fervor?
Ice weeps with your every step over the Sacred Grove's Land. I hear the valley below the waterfall is even more dangerous...
Yeah, it’s a Lycanthrope den now.
The waterfall hides the entrance to the beastmen's temple. I heard men with bull heads are guarding it.
Have you been to the Nixbury River by chance? The frozen river makes quite a view.
Aren't you brave. You went sightseeing in that den of beastmen?
What about the Frozen Swamp of Silence? I hear there's a gigantic wall of ice near Permafrost Lake.
Ah, I know that place. The Northern Lights rush below the frozen lake, yes?
Well aren't you brave. You know the lake houses dragon bones, right?
Indeed. Truth be told, the live and well snowfield apes and monsters are more terrifying than dead dragons.
And the Scale of Judgement... Who could've made something so big?
I've been to the Scars of Sacrifice. They say Shermir's magic still lingers.
You must be new to Nix! Why, it's the Archwizard who sacrificed himself and froze the entire land!
Ah, the one who sealed the Diabolica rift. But I heard the magic turned the villagers to Liches.
True. The land's still suffering from his sacrifice.
Hey, have you seen the giant sitting in the mountains?
Ah, you mean the Tumgir Ruins? It's the remains of a giant felled by a meteor.
Ugh... I'm afraid that giant's going to open its eyes and start walking around at any moment.
You never heard this from me, but... I heard the Arkeum Legion is trying to bring it back.
Bastards... Wasn't taking over the Argent Justice and making an outpost enough?
You ever been to the Snowfield of Chaos? It's almost... too quiet.
I've passed the Forgotten Monastery. Not a soul there, but you can see light at night.
Did you see the Tree of Spirits in the middle? I wouldn't touch it. Looks ominous.
Did you see the carcass at the Blackswords' port? Those bastards worship it like an idol.
A crazy hag was spotted again at the Whiteroof Grove. Must be the Baba Yaga.
Lives up to its name, huh. I heard snow fiends wander the place.
I hear they bear arms too. I hope I don't run into them alone.
I guess I have no choice... but to fight for my own survival.
...I hear Nix has places that look the same but are different depending on the phase. Not everything is as it seems, apparently.
I hear a special scroll can change the phase.
Hmm. Must be monsters in there too, right? I should check it out.
I heard strange scrolls are going around Nix. They say it has special powers.
I hear some scrolls specialize in offense. Could be a game changer, don't you think?
I hear some scrolls specialize in defense. Useful for catching enemies off guard.
Those scrolls could save a few lives!
Did you know? I hear Nix has scrolls that help you find hidden treasures.
So I've heard! I heard some scrolls let you pull pranks. I'd love to see that.
Hey, have you seen ice rocks here and there? I think they hold something, but they won't budge at all.
Light up a nearby monster and draw it in. You could also morph into a torch and melt it.
I hear the frozen lake has a spot you can melt, is it true?
Yeah, and it's a nice ice fishing spot. Except the holes freeze back right away.
Can't be helped, I suppose. You could melt it again or look for a new spot.
In Nix, you step on more than just snow and ice. Treasure may be underneath, too.
Wait, you knew as well? You can see cracks if you look closely.
Even a local Snobble knows it. I search for them by listening to the earth.
You have sharp ears. Well, I suppose the risk is minimal, but... do be careful. You never know what's under there.
Can't hurt to try. Who knows, I might hit the jackpot!
Shermir's Armillary Sphere has stopped again. When are the hammersmiths getting here?
Every nail must be fixed to reignite the Brazier. A Firehammer could make quick work of it.
I should've lifted the seal earlier. Now I have to handle them all before the Sanctuary falls.
Sometimes the monsters have different looks in their eyes. They say it draws you into its spirit when you talk to it.
Yeah. I hear you can talk it into giving you currency or following you.
Hmm... Still, what good is communicating with a monster, when you'll end up fighting it again?
Heh, meteors fly with the Northern Lights in Nix’s night sky. And fallen meteors leave precious Stardust Crystals behind.
True. But be careful. Meteors can hurt you or even pin you down if they hit you directly.
Stardust Crystals eventually fade away. If you can dodge the meteors and gather the crystals, you've hit tonight's jackpot.
The night feels different. I hear the monsters at Nix get even more ferocious.
Yeah. They fight with more rage and emit a red aura. Let's keep our guards up.
Let's be careful. Night hunting will be a whole different challenge.
Look at that vast field of snow. I can see Nix in its entirety from here.
Indeed. A wingsuit would take me anywhere in no time.
It's intimidating at first, but once you get used to it, there's nothing like it.
Have you seen the Milky Way over there?
Milky Way? You mean the path of light?
The Border Zone. A neutral post, deep underground.
It appears quiet, but it's always bustling on the inside, just like its black market.
So, you can take the balloons near the giant magic crystal for evacuations? I'd love to meet the genius who came up with that idea.
It's an interesting idea. But I hope I never experience it while I'm here.
...Snow again. It never stops, does it?
Ugh, can't help it. We're in Nix.
If I was the enemy, I'd wait for an ambush on a quiet day like this. I should stay on guard.
Huh, another headache for us. Give me a break.
Did you know? Snow can be conjured out of the blue.
Huh? Are you saying one person conjured all this snow?
Indeed. The spell is supposed to bring rain, but I heard it makes it snow in Nix.
It was sunny a second ago, and now... The world's turned white.
Eh, I guess some adventurer cast a spell or something.
You mean... An adventurer made it snow like this?
Yeah, the spell is supposed to summon the rain. Too bad Nix is freezing.
...The sky became dark all of a sudden. What's going on?
Wait, is that a magical eclipse? Not everyone can cover the entire sun, I'll admit that.
You have to be pretty skilled to be able to do that in the middle of Nix. I'd better stay on guard.
It's pitch black all of a sudden... Someone must have covered the sun on purpose.
Wow, I've never seen that in real life before. Is that the rumored eclipse magic?
It means someone powerful has arrived. We'd better watch out.
My hands may freeze, but I won't stop playing. It's proof that I'm alive.
Hm... This song evokes the smell of blood on an old battlefield. It will stay with you for a while.
Alright, listen! I'll play something wilder than the blizzard.
That's it for today. Well, did that get your heart pumping?
I'll play something better next time... if we can get back together alive, that is.
Bah, I missed a beat. They've crawled all the way to the square!
Pick up your instrument! We must drive them out first!
Don't reveal your hands so easily. Your faces are too telling.
Ughhh... I just need to win this game. I can feel it. This time, it's for real!
No one who said that ever survived.
Hold on. That card... You didn't just switch it, did you?
Heheh... I saw it. I saw your hand trembling!
Enough, you guys. If you fight, I'm just going to call it quits.
...Come on, have another drink and loosen up.
Why would I? This game is as good as won! Heheh...
Both of you, shut up and show me what you've got.
...Who knew I'd get used to sleeping on this nasty floor one day?
Yes, that's where you belong. The lowest of the low.
Hey, hey! Open this door! The lowest of the low?! You take that back!
You... You'll pay for this one day... Just you wait!
Hey, jailor! What is all this? Will you be held responsible if I die?
Why should I? And besides, you're not dying because of that.
Hmph. At least give us more broth.
Tch. Know your place. Here, the rules are absolute.
Rules, rules...! I'll break your rules one day!
Here we go again... The debris is gathering. Get ready.
Ugh, this power... Look! Vegamont is rising!
We must hold them off before they strike again. Hurry!
My word, the whole mass of ice is...!
Its size never fails to surprise me. This won't be easy.
Vegamont is taking its first step. Everyone, to your positions!
Do not approach. Its moving parts contain poison that is lethal upon contact.
Read its movements. It won't stray from its predetermined path.
Vegamont has stopped! It no longer emits any poisonous energy!
Climb Vegamont and destroy Vegaruss, it's core!
Look out! It'll crush you to a pulp!
It's halted. Everyone, brace for Vegamont's attack!
Look out! Vegamont is summoning lightning bolts!
The lightning bolts calls minions from other realms. Deal with them first!
There! Strike the knee joint where its magic is drained!
Shoot at its seams with the Ballista! They're the only areas that matter!
Your aim must be true. We've only got one chance!
You have the Ice Golem's heart! Morph into a giant battle carrier!
A giant battle carrier can lift adventurers higher with concentrated magic!
The Milky Way is open! Now we can strike from above!
The magic is instable... It could fade away anytime! Hurry!
The Border Zone's balloon is ready. Get onboard quickly!
Board only if you must! We have a limited number of seats!
Speak to the mobility wizards! They'll take you to the ballista!
Climb up the chain! You must destroy Vegaruss, it's core!
Watch out! Vegamont is gathering poison in its central tunnel!
Get out of there now, or you'll suffocate!
Wait, what is that? No, it's the Desert...
Hmm... I'm not entirely sure, but I think it's unconscious, Sienna.
No time for that. That's what Vegamont truly is! Now is the only chance to stop it!
Darn, Vegamont's main body is emitting cold energy!
Strike Vegaruss on its shoulder to make it emit heat! Go to the shoulder platform to thaw the body!
Once you've warmed up, finish Vegamont's main body!
Hold on! I'll take you all to someplace safe!
I'll deal with this! Hurry, into the Magic Circle!
Hurry! We're teleporting to a safe place!
Hurry! Escape Vegamont's collision zone! Watch where it's falling!
Good job. You stopped Vegamont's march.
Phew, we did it. Is everyone alright?
Get the injured first. Everyone, back to the Border Zone!
Damn, we couldn't stop Vegamont. It'll explode soon.
Everyone stand back! This whole area will be swept!
I think Vegamont is about to move!
The ground is shaking... Vegamont is about to move!
You can climb Vegamont's fixed leg!
Climb on Vegamont's fixed leg when it's moving!
Vegamont has stopped! Now climb up and destroy Vegaruss!
Vegamont has stopped! Now's our chance! Focus!
I hope the damage isn't too bad this time...
Line your spears up! Vegamont is coming!
Everyone, clear away from Vegamont's foot, now!
Hold on! Just a little longer!
Out of the way! It's falling!
Get the wooden barricade back up!
Stay away! I want to live!
Is it... over? Is it over?
It's not coming back, is it?
No… I don't want to fade away…
Hey, pipsqueak! Come lend me a hand, will you?
Hahaha! Get ready for a bloodbath!
Heh, I'll leave the fixin' to you for now!
Ha ha! Not too bad for a landlubber!
Hmm… let's see how long you last.
Go on, struggle all you want!
The slow ones go straight to the sharks!
Hahaha! Look at the state of you!
You actually held out? Hey, runt, not bad!
Why not join my crew? What say you? You'd be honored, no doubt!
Forget the Resistance. Come be a pirate instead!
...Hic! Yo ho ho and a bottle of rum!
Cheating is an art until you get caught.
Eh... I need to place the nail again.
Now if I do this here... and then...
I miss drinking in the high waves...
C'mon now! Let's make it more interesting!
Hehe, don't let them steal my cauldron!
Hehe, oh Tree of Spirits, a curse upon them!
Ah! Do I have to kill that wretch?
Come, I shall salt your bloody wounds!
Yes, its light takes you to faraway Territories.
The very air you breathe will freeze!
Did you think... I'd falter so easily?
How dare you invade our harbor!
Come on, try and catch me!

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can designate an enemy target to grant the effect, or it may be granted to yourself or your allies.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Ground/Directional Skills require selecting a direction first.
 ^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> You can set skills to show the area of effect upon pressing the button and use the skill on releasing the button in [Settings] - [Character] - [Easy Directional / Ground Targeting Skills].
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> You can set skills to be cast towards the target in [Settings] - [Character] - [Attack] - [Auto-Lock Ground/Directional Skills on Target].

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Passive Skills are skills that take effect only when registered in the Passive Skill quick slot.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> These can only be registered in the Passive Skill quick slot when the corresponding weapon type is equipped.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> When equipping a weapon and keeping it holstered, the effects of a quick slot Passive Skill will still apply.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> A Passive Skill for an unequipped weapon will not be applied even if it is registered in a quick slot.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The number of Passive Skill quick slots increases as a character levels up.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A skill that activates based on your current equipment.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can view them in the ^<keyicon=K> Skill windows after equipping a certain piece.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Defense Skills are skills that allow you to defend against attacks.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Each weapon type has its own unique Defense Skill.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Defense Skills consume Stamina instead of Mana.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When you succesfully defend against a Fury Attack, special effects occur depending on the weapon type.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Some attacks cannot be stopped by Defense Skills.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A Fury Attack is an enemy's most powerful attack.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Using a Defense Skill at the right time allows you to block Fury Attacks.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When you defend against a Fury Attack, special effects occur depending on the weapon type.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Astral Vision is a feature that shows nearby targets in a sorted list.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Search nearby targets around your mouse cursor location using the ^<keyicon=R> button or around character location using ^<keyicon=LeftAlt> + ^<keyicon=R> buttons. They will be displayed in a list.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Auto Astral Vision can be set to periodically search for targets.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Astral Vision settings can be configured to set the targets that are included in the list.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> An Amitoi follows the character and reacts to their mood, behavior, and environment to help in various ways.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can perform an Amitoi's actions in the Communication menu opened by clicking the Amitoi button.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Weapon Mastery is a feature that grants additional effects based on the Weapon Mastery EXP you gain on your equipped items.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can activate various effects based on your combat style by using Weapon Mastery Points.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Weapon Mastery EXP can be acquired by spending Abyssal Contract Tokens to hunt in field dungeons, or through Training Dew items earned as a reward for completing content.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Weapon Mastery Points can be spent to Activate Masteries, which provide additional effects.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Weapon Mastery effects only apply to one weapon type and do not apply to other weapon types.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Activated Masteries can be reset for a price.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Upon reset, the spent Weapon Mastery Points will be refunded.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Morphs are specialized transformations for animal-like movement.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can select a Designated Morph for each type in the Morph screen.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Morphing will transform you into the Designated Morph depending on the situation.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Obtain Growth Points when you obtain a Morph.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Obtaining Growth Points of the same category increases its Growth Level. You also receive certain effects depending on the Growth Level.
  ^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Growth Level effects are only received when you are in the respective Morph Form.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Shapeshift is a Morph that only changes the player character's appearance.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> From the Morph Screen, select any Morph from the Special tab and click on Instant Morph to transform into that form.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> While Shapeshifted, attacking or interacting will cancel the morph.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> While Shapeshifted, your character's name is changed, and monsters of the same type as your morph will ignore you.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> While Shapeshifted, Amitoi are disabled automatically.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Summon Guardian is an ability that allows you to inhabit the shape of a Guardian for a short time.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Select and Assign a Guardian from the Guardians list to prepare it for use.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> After specifying which Guardian to summon, press the ^<keyicon=C> button to summon it in the world.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Each Guardian has its own set of unique effects.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Upon using Summon Guardian, your appearance instantly changes to that of the Guardian. You will receive all effects unique to the summoned Guardian.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When your character reaches 0 Health, you're dead.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When you're dead, you may receive a death penalty based on the content you're participating in and the nature of the area.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The penalty you receive upon death will result in a resurrection wait time.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> If your death penalty is cumulative, it can increase your resurrection wait time.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Even with a death penalty, you won't experience a resurrection wait when participating in content or areas that aren't penalized.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Depending on the death penalty you receive, you'll enter either the Death Aftereffect or Serious Death Aftereffect state.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can heal Death Aftereffect for free through the Einar Priestess in town.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can heal Serious Death Aftereffect for a fee through the Einar Priestess in town. You can also treat it for a fee while dead.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Healing Serious Death Aftereffect while dead shortens your resurrection wait time.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Healing Serious Death Aftereffect is free for a certain number of times per day, after which it costs a certain amount of ^<imgf=Adena> Sollant and ^<imgf=LostandFoundCoin> Recovery Coins.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Amitoi use ^<imgf=IMG_Heal_Leaf> World Tree Leaves to heal the player.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> You can set the Health amount to trigger Amitoi Recovery actions in [Settings] - [Gameplay] - [Character] - [Amitoi Recovery].
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can unlock various additional effects through the Amitoi Lithograph Book.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Click the Territory Info icon for each region to see the available monsters and droppable items in that region.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Personal Pins you place can be shared with other players.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Check the Timetable for the various events that happen all across Solisium.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Through the event icon on the Timetable, detailed information about each event can be viewed.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Register or disable events on the Schedule Notifications HUD using the Timetable Notification Settings.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Toggle Overlay Map with the ^<keyicon=LeftAlt> + ^<keyicon=M> buttons or the button to the right of the Mini Map.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Overlay Map is a translucent map that displays only the paths and icons of the region in the center of the screen.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Mini Map shows the surrounding terrain and icons around your character.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Icons at the top provide information about your character's location, local characteristics, weather, wind direction, wind speed, and time.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can adjust the transparency of your Mini Map to suit your preferences in Settings.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Mini Map shows the surrounding terrain and icons around your character.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can adjust the transparency of your Mini Map to suit your preferences in Settings.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> This function allows you to achieve a common objective with all players from the same server or with your guild members to earn rewards.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When Milestones are achieved or the Milestone progression time runs out, the server's designated game content will be revealed.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Each Milestone chapter and goal take place within a time limit.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Upon achieving the objective within the time limit, users will acquire a reward.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Milestone chapter ends when the final record is over, and the end date will be recorded.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01>If there is time remaining after completing the chapter, users will have to wait until time is up.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> ^<imgf=MkU_Waypoint> Waypoints are means of transportation placed in major world bases and Territories.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> To use a Waypoint, first interact with it to unlock the Waypoint.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Unlocked Waypoints can be interacted with on the Map, and players can pay a fee to teleport to any Waypoint location.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> ^<imgf=IMG_Dungeon_WayPoint_Normal> Dungeon Waypoints are means of transportation placed in Territories within the dungeon.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Interacting with a Dungeon Waypoint allows you to move to a different floor within the same dungeon for a fee.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Dungeons are more challenging than other hunting areas of the same level, so joining a party with other players is recommended.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> While a dungeon is a Peace Zone during the day, it turns into a War Zone at night, allowing for PvP combat.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Each dungeon may become inaccessible depending on the world's current status.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Certain dungeons are made up of multiple floors, which can be quickly navigated using ^<imgf=IMG_Dungeon_WayPoint_Normal> Dungeon Waypoints within.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Using Abyssal Contract Tokens allow players to increase the efficiency while hunting in dungeons.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Abyssal Contract Tokens can be acquired by completing Dynamic Events or Resistance Contracts.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When you reach the maximum amount of Abyssal Contract Tokens, you cannot gain more.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Hunting in dungeons applies the Abyssal Contract effect, which consumes Abyssal Contract Tokens. Token consumption increases the amount of EXP and Sollant Bonus and gives players a higher chance of acquiring dungeon-only items.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Region Properties show the characteristics of the current Region, and they play a critical role in showing PvP possibility and death penalties.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Region Properties can be viewed on the Mini Map, along with the Territory Name.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Region Properties may change depending on the content that occurs in that content area.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Guilds are groups that gather together with a shared vision and objectives, spearheaded by a guild leader.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can complete guild-exclusive content and compete with other guilds to progress your guild level and to receive various benefits.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Rewards are received when content is completed by the player or other guild members.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Additional rewards can be received using Treasure Chest points, which are earned whenever you obtain guild rewards with your guild members.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Guild-exclusive skills are helpful for empowering a guild member and other content.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Unlocking new skills or improving existing ones is based on the guild's level.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Only the Guild Leader, Advisors, and Guardians may use these skills. Skills will consume guild resources.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can assign the relationships with other guilds on the same server.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Friendly guilds cannot attack each other, but they can take on large-scale content together, such as Castle Siege, and share in the benefits of victory.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When guild members defeat a boss and obtain items, or when profits are obtained from Castle Siege and Tax Delivery, they are all stored by the guild.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Items stored by the guild can be sold within the guild or in the Auction House by its Leader or Advisors.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Profits obtained from selling items and currency from Castle Siege or Tax Delivery can be shared among guild members.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Profits obtained from selling items and currency from Castle Siege or Tax Delivery can be shared among guild members.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> After distribution, details can be reviewed by members.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Guild Raids are where you and your guild members defeat a boss in a guild area.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can defeat the boss based on the weekly remaining boss defeat count to acquire a reward.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Guild Raids can be accessed in Guild Base, and Legion can be accessed in Legion Base.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Items acquired after defeating the boss can be distributed using Guild Distribution.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Each Raid is unlocked based on Milestone progression and Guild Level.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A Guild Raid can be unlocked by Guild Leader and Guild Advisors.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> One Guild Raid can be accessed at a time. If no one is in combat, you can change raids.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Upon changing the raid, all guild members within the zone will be transferred to the Guild Base.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Everyone in the area will be moved to the Guild Base after defeating the boss.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> If you leave or get booted from the guild during the Guild Raid, you will be forced out of the Guild Base.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> During a Guild Raid, upon dying during a fight against the boss, you can resurrect based on the designated number of Star Returns for that raid.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Resurrection during combat will cost 1 Star Return, and you will be able to continue your raid by resurrecting in the same area until all Star Returns are used.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Star Return count will be given when the fight with the boss begins, and it disappears when the battle ends.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Codex records your activity in and teaches you about Solisium.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> It is divided into different sections - Adventure Codex, Exploration Codex, Extra Codex, and Collection Codex.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Adventure Codex records everything that a player experiences during their adventure in Solisium, including resolving conflicts and information from meeting various people.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Small stories are compiled together into a larger epic.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Adventure objectives will be shown in the world as ^<imgf=IMG_Tutorial_Target> icons.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> To complete the objectives, defeat certain enemies, perform certain actions, or talk to certain characters indicated with the icon.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Investigate
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> You can seek clues when investigating an item.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Click and drag to rotate the item.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Use the mouse wheel to zoom in and out to observe the item.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Press and hold where the cursor changes to a ^<imgf=IMG_Inspection_Cursor_Operation> shape to trigger an investigative action.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Exploration codex allows players to complete various objectives in each Territory. This exploration required provides a background story and regional information about the Territory's incidents.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Check the Exploration Codex once you unlock a new region by either using the Territory's Waypoint or entering into the region.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> It is possible to progress some objectives before unlocking a region and those records are saved. View the objectives after unlocking the region to review progress.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Exploration objectives will be shown in the world as ^<imgf=IMG_Marker_CodexExploration_Normal> icons.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Collection Codex allows players to gather the fragmented stories from all across Solisium in one volume.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The scraps of stories you encounter throughout your adventure will be stored in the Codex like a book and will always be available to review.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Leveling Log guides you through the content and features that open when the character is a particular Level.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Duties are assigned specific to the player's Level, and upon completion, rewards can be acquired.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Badges at the top of the Leveling Log screen for each Level provide information about the requests and stats available at that Level.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Leveling Log Pass must be purchased to activate.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When Leveling Log Pass is activated, additional Level Up rewards can be received for each Level.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Battle Pass allows players to complete daily, weekly, and Premium tasks to acquire points as well as rewards.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Acquiring points will increase the level of the Battle Pass, allowing players to gain rewards based on the level.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can purchase additional points to increase your Battle Pass Level.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Players cannot collect a reward that has already been collected once.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Star Crystals are currency used to purchase items in the battle pass point shop.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Players may earn crystals as rewards or as additional xp is claimed once the battle pass is completed.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Star Crystals expire at the end of each battle pass season.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> At the end of the Battle Pass season, Star Crystals are turned into Quality Recovery Crystals.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Obtaining a Premium Pass Ticket activates the Premium Pass.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Special Premium tasks can be completed in addition to the normal Battle Pass.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Premium Pass rewards can be received when completing additional Premium tasks.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Taedal's Tower is a single-player mode that challenges you to complete a special achievement on every floor.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You must complete the current floor before advancing to the next.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> After a player enters the tower, they can view the objectives in the guide on the right-hand side of the screen.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> After the challenge begins and a certain time has passed, the Monsters will become enraged and stronger.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When completing the floor's objective, rewards are immediately received and the gate to the next floor will be activated.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When you use a Mystic Key on a Mystic Globe, there is a chance for a Mystic Portal to appear on the field.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The area where the Mystic Portal is located can be viewed on the World Map or the Mini Map.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When getting close to a Mystic Portal, the deployed Amitoi will warn about it.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Mystic Portals disappear after a certain time.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Mystic Globes are treasure baubles hidden throughout the world.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> In order to find Mystic Globes and receive the reward, you need ^<imgf=IMG_TreasureBox_Key> Mystic Keys.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Mystic Keys can be obtained from Contract Coin Merchants or as a Guild Contract Special Reward.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When in possession of a Mystic Key, the location of Mystic Globes can be seen on the Mini Map.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A transport golem that carries a massive box filled with taxes.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When a Titan Cargo leaves a designated area or disappears from the world, it returns to its Sealstone.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A Field Boss is a strong monster that appears in specific areas of the world on the field. Players must cooperate with other players to defeat it rather than attempting to fight it alone.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Defeating a Field Boss will produce a large reward and each Field Boss may drop exclusive items.
	^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Conquest Rewards from Field Bosses that appear at the same time cannot be acquired together.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Any Field Boss Contributions will be reduced when dying during combat.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> If undefeated, the Field Boss will disappear after a period of time.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Defeating an Archboss will produce a reward and drop items.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Before the Archboss spawns, a standby timer will begin.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Archboss event is either a ^<imgf=IMG_ZONE_WAR> War or ^<imgf=IMG_ZONE_PEACE> Peace event.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Rewards will be distributed based on Archboss Contributions.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Any Archboss Contributions will be reduced when dying during combat.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> If undefeated, the Archboss will despawn after a period of time.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> An Archboss has destroyable parts, and upon destruction, the respective part will be dropped as an item.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Dynamic Events that have unique features and rules are held periodically in each region.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Check the event schedule for each region in [Map] - [Timetable].
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Multiple players and guilds can participate and compete to acquire rewards.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Peace
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> This type of Dynamic Event takes place in a Peace Zone.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Players cannot fight each other and Ranking rewards are determined on an individual basis.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Co-Op 
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> This type of Dynamic Event takes place in a Peace Zone.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Players cannot fight each other and participating players can cooperate with each other to increase their reward tiers.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Dominion Event
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> This type of Dynamic Event takes place in a Dominion Event Zone.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> You will be randomly assigned to a team when you join the Dynamic Event.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Players from different teams can fight each other and Ranking rewards are determined on team rankings and individual rankings within the team.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Guild
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> This type of Dynamic Event takes place in a War Zone.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Players can fight against each other and Ranking rewards are determined on a guild basis.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The dimensional circle is a special dungeon. Form a party with other players to take on powerful monsters in the dungeon.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Each dimensional circle dungeon has a character level requirement that restricts access.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Each dungeon's progression is shared with party members.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> One Boonstone exists in each Territory. They are one of the Holdstones that a guild can possess.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The guild that acquires a Boonstone through a Boonstone Guild Battle will receive various benefits.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The number of Boonstones the guild can possess depends on the guild's level.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> At a designated time after the matchmaking is revealed, the Guild Battle begins. During this time, the Territory with the Boonstone becomes a battlefield for the Guild Battle.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Boonstone Guild Battle Area is a ^<imgf=IMG_ZONE_WAR> War Zone that allows players to battle other players from opposing guilds.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> When a player from a non-participating guild enters the Guild Battle area, they will enter Spectator Mode.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> In Spectator Mode, they are not visible to other characters and cannot interact.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When a Guild Battle begins, the Boonstone's protection becomes disabled, making it vulnerable to capture.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Guild Leaders, Guild Advisors, and Guild Guardians can interact with the Boonstone to register their guild as the Capturing Guild.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> A guild currently trying to capture a Boonstone is called a Capturing Guild.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> If another guild successfully interacts with the Boonstone before the capture time is up, the Capturing Guild will be changed. Capturing succeeds if no other guild interacts with the Boonstone before capture time runs out.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> If the Guild Battle time finishes during capture time, the Guild Battle time is extended for the remainder of the capture time.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> When the Guild Battle is over, the Boonstone enters a protected state and cannot be captured until the next Guild Battle.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Tax Delivery is a guild event where the legion must transport taxes collected in their dominion to the castle.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Tax Delivery takes place at the designated date and time, and the schedule cannot be changed or canceled.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Tax Delivery begins once a player of Guild Guardian position or higher in the legion morphs into Titan Cargo using the Titan Cargo Sealstone.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When the legion's Titan Cargo reaches the Tax Collector in the castle within the time limit, Tax Delivery is successfully completed and the Dominion's tax is transferred to the castle.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> If another guild destroys the Titan Cargo, the Tax Delivery fails. The transported tax is divided based on the attacker's contributions to the destruction of the Titan Cargo.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> If the Titan Cargo survives but does not reach the destination within the time limit, the tax is returned to the dominion.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> During Castle Siege, guild members of Guild Guardian or higher positions can morph into a Siege Golem if the guild occupies the Siege ruins.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Siege Golem morph is automatically reverted after a certain time.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> The morph can be removed through the ^<imgf=IMG_SigeGolem_Release_Normal> button located below Character Info.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Castle Siege is large-scale guild content for taking over a castle through the Capture the Throne process.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> To take over a castle, players will use Siege Golems, environmental factors, territory occupation, and other tactics.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The guild that controls the castle is recognized as a legion and collects the taxes accumulated at the castle.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> During Castle Siege, your allies' costumes will be changed to blue, enemies will be red, and the Captured Guild will be gold.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Each Boonstone grants a buff that increases the stats of the capturing guild's members.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Benefits are based on the length of possession and consist of acquiring Guild Activity Points and Guild Resources.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When a Boonstone is in your guild's protection or capture status you can use the Boonstone icon on the Map to teleport to that Boonstone location.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> One Riftstone is placed in every Territory where Field Boss is located. Riftstones are one of the Holdstones that a Guild can possess.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A Guild that gains possession of a Riftstone through a Riftstone Guild Battle will have various benefits.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The number of Riftstones the guild can possess depends on its level.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> At a designated time after the matchmaking is revealed, the Guild Battle begins. During this time, the Territory with the Riftstone becomes a battlefield for the Guild Battle.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Riftstone Guild Battle Area is a ^<imgf=IMG_ZONE_WAR> War Zone that allows players to battle other players from opposing guilds.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> When a player from a non-participating guild enters the Guild Battle area, they enter the Spectator Mode.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> In the Spectator Mode, they are not visible to other characters and cannot interact other than moving.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When a Guild Battle begins, the Riftstone's protection becomes disabled, making it vulnerable to capture.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Guild Leaders, Guild Advisors, and Guild Guardians can interact with the Riftstone to register their guild as the Capturing Guild.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> The guild currently trying to capture a Riftstone is called a Capturing Guild. 
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01>The first guild to reach 100% on the capture progression bar will possess the Riftstone.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Capture progression increases when a guild has the most surviving members within the capturing area. At the same time, the opposing guild's progression will decrease.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> If a guild's population accounts for more than 66% of players in the capturing area, their progression will increase faster, and the other guild's progression will decrease faster.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> If a guild's progression bar reaches 0%, that guild will be disqualified and fail to capture the Riftstone.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> When the Guild Battle is over, the Riftstone enters a protected state, and cannot be captured until the next Guild Battle.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Each Riftstone grants an effect that increases the stats of the capturing guild's members.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Benefits are based on the length of the possession and consist of acquiring Guild Activity Points and Guild Resources.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When a Riftstone is in your guild's protection or capture status you can interact with it to enter the Dimensional Space of the Field Boss connected to the Riftstone.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When a Riftstone is in your guild's protection or capture status, you can use the Riftstone icon on the Map to teleport to that Riftstone location.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> This space is exclusive to the guild members that possess the Riftstone. The only being that lives here is the Field Boss that is linked to the Riftstone.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The guild that possesses the Riftstone can defeat the Field Boss in this space and acquire various rewards, apart from the Field Boss Event.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Dimension's Field Boss has the same ability as the Field Boss in the world with the same rewards.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Dimension's Field Boss will spawn every day at a certain time.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> If possession of the Riftstone was gained after defeating the Dimension's Field Boss, you must wait until a certain time to defeat the Field Boss.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Resistance events are ranked content that involves all players on the server.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A single Resistance event lasts for 3d, and your final ranking is calculated based on your scores from all 3d.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> During a Resistance event, enter and be ranked in a Dynamic Event to earn points toward your Resistance Event ranking.
	^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The 2 highest scoring Dynamic Events you join each day will be reflected on your ranking.
	^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Peaceful Dynamic Events are worth fewer points than Dominion Event Zone Events.
	^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Guild Dynamic Events do not count.
	^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You will not receive any points if you log out without claiming a reward.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Even if you are not get ranked in a Resistance event, you can still receive individual rewards based on the number of points you have earned.
		^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Rewards will remain available for 2d after the Resistance event ends.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Relationships menu allows you to add friends or register targets that you should be aware of.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Check information of registered players including their login status and guild affiliation.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Differentiate targets in Astral Vision using relationship settings.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Use a player's Character Card to register a relationship.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Kill Records is a statistic set that records battles with other players.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Kill Records will record the battle result, time, and the score.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Kill Records can save information for up to 30 days. When the record count exceeds 1,000, older records will be deleted first.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Score results will vary depending on the level difference between players.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Ranking is a function that allows you to check ranks of the characters created on the same server.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Current Rankings are finalized in real time at midnight nightly.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> For Current Rankings, except for Growth Rankings, the current day's score is reflected at 100% and the cumulative score through the previous day is reflected at 90%.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The first place finisher in the Current Ranking receives a Transcendence Skill that can change the environment. Growth Ranking does not have a Transcendence Skill prize.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A function that allows you to register items or skills onto a quick slot.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can register the other equipped weapon set's skills onto the quick slot. When you use those skills, you will use them with that weapon set and continue combat with your original weapon.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Chat is used to communicate with other players via text.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The chat box is contracted when the player is not chatting. When a chat box is opened to enter text or when reviewing the chat, it will expand into chat mode for better communication.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can use the Chat tabs to separate chats.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can open different Chat viewers to check multiple chats at the same time.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Type /help or /? in the chat box to see the various types of chat commands and their usage.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Change chat-related settings in Chat Settings. Custom settings can be set for each type of chat.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A direct Group Chat can be made to talk with specific players in a separate chatroom.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The player that creates the chatroom becomes the owner and can invite or expel members.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Form a party to cooperate with other players.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A party can have up to 6 members and the party members' character status can be seen by all members.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Members in the same party will appear differently from other players. Party members' locations will appear on the World Map and Mini Map.
