^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A Guild Contract is a guild-shared contract that all guild members work together to fulfill.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> By fulfilling a Guild Contract, you and your entire guild can acquire Guild Coins and various items as rewards.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Objectives are displayed as ^<imgf=IMG_Marker_Guild_Normal> icons in the world.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Only Territory contracts are available at first, but as your Guild Level grows, Dynamic Event and dungeon contracts will become available.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When a Guild Contract is completed, Guild rewards are issued to the guild immediately.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Rewards issued to guild members are divided into Basic, Contribution, and Special rewards.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Basic rewards are issued to all guild members upon completion of the Guild Contract.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Contribution rewards are issued based on Contributions to the Guild Contract.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> In the Guild Contract Details window, you can view the list of guild members on the Guild Contract and their Contributions.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Special rewards have a chance of being issued to one of the contributing guild members upon completion of a Guild Contract.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can check the items that your guild has acquired, sell or transfer them to guild members, or sell them at the Auction House.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> In Guild Settings, you can change items to not be added to your guild or select the grades of items that will be added to it.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Activity Ranking
   ^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Characters are ranked based on the number of ^<imgf=ActiveRankPoint> Activity Points they earn by progressing through the game's available content.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Kill Ranking

   ^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Read more about how to earn Kill Points in the Help tooltip in the Kill Ranking window.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Guild Ranking

   ^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Guild Content Points can be acquired from cooperative content such as resource donations, Holdstone holding time, and Guild Raids.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Growth Ranking

The Greatsword is a well-balanced weapon style that allows for devastating combo attacks paired with high health pools. With its long reach and earth-shattering area damage, it will help you break through enemy defenses and shake up the battle field.

The Sword and Shield combination grants you high defense and unique methods of crowd control. Take control of the battle field by drawing enemies to you, protecting your allies, and pulling or pushing enemies to keep them exactly where you want them.
The Daggers fighting style specializes in stealth and disrupting enemies with Poison damage. It helps you quickly sneak up behind enemies, deal continuous Poison damage, and deliver deadly blows.

The Longbow specializes in long-range sniping, immobilizing enemies from a distance and dealing increased damage from afar. It can also be used to speed up the healing of party members, making it a great support for allies.

Crossbows enable you to fight in style, with fast movement and a relentless pace of attack. They Mark enemies so you can unleash a merciless barrage on the weakened foe, taking them down in an instant.

The Staff puts the very elements of creation at your fingertips. With it, you can unleash explosive magical attacks that deal significant damage and use area magic to turn the tide of battle, even when surrounded by multiple enemies.

The Wand is a support weapon that helps you heal and buff your allies. In addition to ensuring your party's survival, you can cast Curse magic to weaken enemies and maximize the damage dealt by your allies. It is especially useful in boss raids and group encounters.

The Lv. 50 dimensional circle is divided into ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>1-Star^</c> and ^<c=@Notification_Highlight>2-Star levels^</c>.

In the arena, a 3-person party fights another 3-person party in a designated space.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Friendly: You can play against anyone you wish.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> No more than 2 weapons of the same type are allowed per team in a match.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You must reach Level 50 to enter the Arena.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You can play solo, or you can organize a party of 3 to take on the challenge as a party.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The location of the match will be randomly selected from 3 locations: Challenger's Battlefield, Twisted Laboratory, or Toxic Arena.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Challenger's Battlefield
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> A massive amphitheater floating in the sky.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Twisted Laboratory
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> In the Twisted Laboratory, the columns in certain locations disappear over time, and the water level rises.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> If you touch the water, you will take damage.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Toxic Arena
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> During the match, deadly Poisonous Zones are activated at set intervals.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Normal
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Your matchmaking score determines your opponents with automatic matchmaking. Your matchmaking and ranking scores are not affected.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01>Ranked
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> This mode affects your ranking score based on the outcome of the match.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> At the start of the season, the first 5 matches' results will determine the initial score weighting.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Friendly

　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Only the party leader of a party can invite another party leader. Once the party leader and members accept, they'll be taken to the arena.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Battlefield Token
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Players who enter the arena start with 2 tokens each.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Battlefield Tokens increase when you defeat an opponent, and decrease when you're defeated.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01>You can possess up to 7 Battlefield Tokens. (Battle Hunter mode only)
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Hype Effect
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> When you defeat enemies and have a certain number of Battlefield Tokens, you'll become hyped, which increases the damage you take from enemies and decreases incoming healing.
    　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Hype effect intensifies as the number of tokens increases, up to 3 times.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Manage your Battlefield Tokens effectively to increase the points you earn every 30s.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Forced Move

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Auto-Resurrection

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Score
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> After the start of the battle, points are awarded every 30s based on the number of Battlefield Tokens your team has. (Battle Point mode only)
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Bonus kill points are awarded for each enemy you defeat that has Battlefield Tokens, and defeating enemies with many Battlefield Tokens can result in high kill points.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Once matchmaking is successful, you can choose to accept or decline entry.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> If you fail to accept after a successful matchmaking, you will be unable to register for another match for a set period of time. (Matchmaking Penalty)

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The duration of the Matchmaking Penalty increases based on the number of penalties accumulated during the week.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> If a character leaves the Battlegrounds before the game ends after accepting and joining through successful matchmaking, they will receive a Desertion Penalty
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Leaving results in a significant reduction to Ranked Points and applies a Matchmaking Penalty.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Matchmaking Penalty duration also increases based on the number of weekly accumulated penalties caused by desertion.
^<c=@Msg_Warning>※ Moving to the Character Selection screen after entering the Battlegrounds is considered desertion.^</c>

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> If a character enters the Battlegrounds after successful matchmaking but makes no contribution to their team until the game ends, they will receive an AFK Penalty.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The duration of the Matchmaking Penalty also increases based on the number of weekly accumulated penalties caused by AFK behavior.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> High-ranking Characters who do not participate in the Battlegrounds for a set period of time will receive an Inactivity Penalty.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Abysstones are found within dungeons and are one of the Holdstones that a guild can possess.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A guild that gains possession of an Abysstone through an Abysstone Guild Battle will have various benefits for the duration of their possession.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The number of Abysstones the guild can possess depends on its level.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> An Abysstone Guild Battle is a large-scale guild content where guilds fight for ownership of an Abysstone.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Unlike Boonstones or Riftstones, no declaration is required. Players can begin an Abysstone Guild Battle at any time by imprinting their guild's flag onto an Abysstone.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Imprinting requires a Guild Flag, which can be purchased from the Guild Supplies Shop.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Imprinting is only possible while the stone is in Peace status or Conquest status, and cannot be done when it is under Protection Status.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Once the Abysstone Guild Battle begins, the area surrounding the Abysstone becomes a Guild Battle Zone.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> The Abysstone Guild Battle Zone is where combat between members of participating guilds is enabled, and it is designated as a ^<imgf=IMG_ZONE_WAR> War Zone.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> When the Guild Battle starts, the Abysstone enters a Conquest status. During this time, other guilds may also register as Capturing Guilds by imprinting their guild's flag.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Imprinting can only be performed by the Guild Leader, Advisors, or the Guardians of a guild.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> The first guild to reach 100% on the Conquest Gauge successfully claims ownership.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> The Conquest Gauge increases for the guild with the most surviving members in the Conquest Zone, while it decreases for others.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Only members of the Occupying Guild or Capturing Guilds are counted toward this gauge.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> If one guild exceeds 66% of the surviving members in the Zone, their gauge fills faster while other guilds' gauges deplete more quickly.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Any guild whose Conquest Gauge reaches 0% is eliminated.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> If all Capturing Guilds fail, the Occupying Guild retains control and the Guild Battle ends in their victory.
^<c=@Msg_Warning>※ Unlike Boonstones and Riftstones, once a Guild Battle ends, the Abysstone enters a Successful Protection Status, preventing further imprinting for a set duration.^</c>

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A Guild Battle is currently in progress for ownership of the Abysstone.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> A guild that succeeds in imprinting during the battle can be registered as a Capturing Guild.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Friendly guilds of the Occupying Guild cannot be registered as a Capturing Guild.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> You cannot imprint the Abysstone at the moment.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> After a Guild Battle ends, the Abysstone is placed under protection for a set duration.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> The guild that owns the Abysstone can also spend guild resources to place it under protection for a set duration.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Each Abysstone grants an effect that increases the stats of the guild's members.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Benefits are based on the length of possession and consist of acquiring Guild Activity Points and Guild Resources.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> If a friendly guild owns an Abysstone with set effects, the amount of guild resources acquired increases.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Additional beneficial effects are applied to guild members within dungeons that contain an Abysstone.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> The Tower of Greed is a gameplay mode where 1-6 players can freely form a party and conquer dungeons that differ on each floor.
^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Party Matchmaking allows 3 players to be grouped into one party and enter together.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Tower Zones
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> The Tower consists of 5 zones: Awakening, Dawn, Dusk, Twilight, and Abyss, totaling 50 Floors.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Each zone has a different floor composition.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Tower Floors
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Each floor consists of a boundary and a tower. Players form parties at the boundary and enter the tower through the shining rift.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> To conquer each floor, you must withstand the Greed required for that floor, which is contained in the Orb of Greed.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> If you cannot contain the required amount of Greed in the Orb of Greed, you will fail to enter.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> While playing, you may occasionally encounter a dimensional rift that lets you skip multiple floors.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Orb of Greed
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> The Orb of Greed is where Greed accumulates from rewards obtained in the Tower of Greed.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Greed increases from Breakthrough Rewards automatically obtained upon conquering each floor, and from Greed Rewards that can be optionally obtained.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Players can control accumulating Greed by imprinting or purifying the Orb of Greed.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Imprint
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Players can imprint the Orb of Greed to increase the orb's gauge depth.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Imprinting consumes designated materials and currency, and has a maximum limit.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Purify
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Players can purify the Orb of Greed to remove accumulated Greed.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> When purifying, players can reset their progress to a selected zone, with progress resetting to 1F of that zone. Upon resetting, obtained rewards will not be reset.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Purification can only be used once per day and resets at a designated time each day.

^<imgf=IMG_Help_Dot_Markup_01> Seasons
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> The Tower of Greed is a seasonal content. Rewards obtained during a season cannot be obtained again during that season.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> When a season ends, your zone and floor record, imprinting status of the Orb of Greed, and reward acquisition status will be reset.
　^<imgf=IMG_Help_Arrow_Markup_01> Any rewards you have acquired that are not time-limited will not disappear.

In my dream... Only I know ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>how to defeat^</c> Iskale. And after that battle, an age of peace returns to Kastleton.

I'm not sure why Hamel chose me... I just know that it is my duty.

I ask you once more. Please make sure that the children make it to the ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>village^</c> safely. And...

^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>{0}^</c>! Please protect the children until the end!

You're a stubborn one, aren't you? And yet... it was that stubbornness of yours which got you to kill Havres, so I won't blame you.
Foolish human... Now that you're no longer of any use to us, I'll relieve you of that ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Star Fragment^</c>!
What was his name again...? Ezekiel? I dispatched that fool a long time ago!

I'm here to borrow a Guardian's Pledge.
Ahahahahaha! You're a cheeky one, who do you think I am? I'm ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Jacque Hander^</c>! Are you here for a duel? I'll give you anything if you vanquish me!

What? Sophia? So that's why you needed the Slayer's Pledge! If only she'd come on as a staff officer when I suggested it, this never would have happened! Her talents are too precious to let go to waste under that staid, DaVinci!
If it was strong enough to vanquish Sophia, this Vampire must be powerful! Even with the Guardian's Pledge, you're gambling with your life. Will you still do it?
I'm more than determined to rescue Sophia.
Ahahahahaha! I like your boldness! Good! I'll give you the ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Guardian's Pledge of Ezekiel^</c>, the legendary Vampire Slayer!

Ezekiel's Pledge was found in the ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Temple of Sylaveth^</c>. You should go there first! Maybe the Guardian will show you around. Now, hurry! End that creature's life!

Thanks for all this, I'll take my leave now.

(Gasps) Don't say that! Every time you say that I...

I was surprised in the beginning, but I'm used to it now.
Do you know where Janice is, Master? Can you tell me, or I mean... Can you show me with gestures?

I see. We have to find ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Janice^</c> as soon as possible...
I haven't seen you around before. So what brings you here?

I see... Clay sent you to me because of my research. The truth is, my sister Adriana also suffers from bouts of mana frenzy. I've been searching for a ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>cure^</c>.

If you're suffering from the effects of mana frenzy as well, a ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Mana Calming Potion^</c> can alleviate your symptoms. I'd brew one for you, but I just used my last batch of ingredients. And unfortunately, I must stay here for the time being...

A ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Goblin Agitator^</c> is leading the ritual. We'll need to figure out the meaning of the final sentence.

Good job! ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>"Front paws to the spider and tail towards the star..."^</c>

Go to the ^<c=@MK_C_Place>Starlight Observatory Ruins^</c> and let the Guard know about the ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>goblins' attack plan^</c>. In the meantime, I'll gather some troops.
Time is of the essence, hurry! I'll meet you there.
You must get out of here! Please.
You must get out of here! Please.
Clay... Searching... Searching... Standing by... Danger... Standing by...
I hope whoever I spoke to arrives soon... Oh, yes? Can I help you?

Oh, goodness! It's a pleasure to meet you. I am Rutaine. You really came. What a relief!

Right beside Laslan is a dominion called Stonegard. The biggest town there is called ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Vienta^</c>.

A monster known as Morokai lives in this ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Carmine Forest^</c>. If the child did come all the way out here, she's in grave danger.

You're back already? I hope you didn't run into any trouble.
Here are the Mana Recording Devices.
Thank you! I'll check these for any sign of the child. Please wait a moment.
Hm... There's no trace of the child on this device, either. This... isn't good...
In Morokai's hideout, I found a crumpled letter that says ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>"Abduct children."^</c>
In any case, it seems the child is not missing, but rather kidnapped. If she's not in the forest, they might have taken her somewhere else... Oh, I must let my comrades know...
Where have your comrades gone off to?
Oh, you can deliver a message for me? Thank you! This way I can continue my search in the north side of the forest.
A comrade of mine, Robert, is currently searching for any traces of the child in the ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Nesting Grounds^</c>. Please pass this new information on to him.
Hm? Can I help you? Do you have business here?
Hm, I could tell from the spider webs all over your shoes. Has Rutaine already finished his investigation?
What? He discovered an ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>order to kidnap^</c> children? Dear Gods! No wonder we were unable to find any traces, no matter how hard we searched...
Hang on... Hmm, now that you mention it, something did feel off back there. I'd better investigate again.

I saw some ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Wrecked Carriages^</c> here and there across the Nesting Grounds. They seemed strange, but I didn't notice anything particular...

That's what happened. I'll check again for even the smallest trace they might have left behind to tell us who did this or where they went.

Hoho, alright, then! You seem to know what you're doing. I'll go and investigate over this way, so could you take a look at the ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Abandoned Carriage^</c> and the ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Terror Bird nest^</c> over there?
I'll lend you my sight and my strength.
Alright, I'll go and track down the kidnappers. If you find anything, come back over here. Let's share what we find.
Hm. Have you finished investigating the area? Tell me what you found.
These ledgers... These look like children's names. Look, this ledger says "^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Vienta^</c>," and Lucille's name is checked off.
That's the name of the child we're looking for. But there are other names that have been checked off here, too. Then, she isn't the only child they've kidnapped...
Hm, you're very thorough! A ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>sword stuck in the corpse of a Terror Bird^</c>... Hm? There was a pattern like this on the sword?
Damn it! That's used by the ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Arkeum Legion^</c>. Could they be responsible for all these kidnappings?
We need to act fast. I discovered a wrecked cart, in which I found a ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>piece of a partly burnt map^</c>. You know what that means, right?
I'm going after those scoundrels, so please take this map piece to Sophia in ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Vienta^</c>. She'll know what to do with it.
It's thanks to you that I surv- Actually, no, I had it all under control. But why did you come alone?
Phew... someone worries too much. Are reinforcements coming? Then, go save the children, quickly.
Be careful. I'm sure there are still some soldiers inside. Well, you can hide behind me if you like.
There's ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>Obsidian^</c> embedded in the magic device binding Clay. This mineral is only mined north of Talandre.

A chain which suppresses mana... It's definitely the work of a dwarf.
Obsidian was used in creating the Magic Circle. It's a valuable mineral mined at the Black Anvil Forge.
But that's strange. The Black Anvil dwarves hate humans. They would never cooperate with Arkeum's plan.
But the evidence is solid. Clay must be held captive somewhere in the Black Anvil Forge.
We can't save him right now.

The smoke that was being injected into Clay is a mysterious substance called the ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>red fog^</c>. It's also the reason I came here into the ^<c=@Codex_AD_HN>Holy Tree's Sanctuary^</c>.
The red fog erodes and corrupts living organisms. I'm doing what I can to stop it, but the Great Sage Tree is still dying. Even the World Tree and its great Star Fragment can't purify this energy.
We need a counter measure for the red fog if we're to save Clay.
The ^<c=@MK_D_Place>Swamp of Silence^</c> is west of the Forest of the Great Tree. The red fog comes from there.
There's a scholar who researches the fog. We will be able to find a solution if we know what the fog is, and where it's coming from.
Please head for the Swamp of Silence and cure the Great Sage Tree and find a way to save Clay.
It's completely blocked off here. What about elsewhere?
I wonder how anything passes through here... Was there anything out of the ordinary?
Hmm... You said there were two footholds? Then let's take a closer look with this.
Ah, it's finally solved. A dwarf has to step on the left foothold and a Golem the right.
Then I'll go for the left foothold. You should Morph into a Golem and get on top of the right foothold.
Alright then. How do you like it?
Oh... that's an acquired taste. What glass do you want it served in?
That, so? I think I get it now... Now, for the final question. How many ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>ice cubes^</c> do you need?
How many ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>ice cubes^</c> do you want?
Now, you'll have no choice but to answer my questions with the truth. Who in the world are you?
Are you awake? Forgive me, it looks like I misjudged you. But when you're a ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>spy^</c>, it's better to be too cautious than not cautious enough.
I laced your drink with a special concoction of mine. It's harmless now that it's worn off. Now, you said you want to meet ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>Canary^</c>?
How is that you can communicate with the bird?
You think you can ask about Janice's whereabouts?
Just how long is this going to take?
Explain that Clay is in danger.
Do you happen to know Clay's whereabouts?
We need to go right now.
Whoa, okay let's give you some space.
I'm surprised to find you alive out here.
How's the pain in your arm?
I will boost the ^<c=@MK_D_Dialogue>berry^</c>'s power with my magic and purify the ^<c=@MK_UI_Siege_Enemy>red fog^</c>.
Grandma... went to where mom is?
(Touch your chin as if deep in thought)
(Touch your chin) Sparkling water with three drops of milk.
I've come in search of Canary.
I need to speak with Canary, it's urgent.
Ugh... I need to talk to a canary, I think?
I need help searching for Clay.
I was told Canary could help me find Clay.
I need... some clay? No, I need to find Clay!
There was a dwarf and golem!
The enemy withdrew after you took out King Verte. I'm glad you weren't seriously injured.
The enemy withdrew after you took out King Verte. I'm glad you weren't seriously injured.
Oh, right! From that time when we barely escaped from the chapel in one piece. I almost didn't recognize you, haha.
But what are we to do about your power...? At this rate, you may be chased off like before, or even lose your life to a mana ^<c=@MK_C_Dialogue>frenzy^</c>.

People are thankful for the help, but everyone wishes this Ossic would hurry up a little.

A lighthearted adventuring companion. Blooming Spring Pippin's positivity can make even the most arduous adventures fun. Its bright and contagious smile makes everyone forget their worries, just for a while.
An Amitoi that resembles a penguin. Despite its drowsy appearance, it's actually quite energetic. It's still learning to walk, so it takes careful steps as it moves along.
An Amitoi that resembles a penguin. Its face turns yellow when it's happy, and its face is always yellow when traveling! Its ribbon keeps its feathers back while it dances.

An Amitoi that resembles a penguin. Its a fun-loving Amitoi that dreams of setting the dance world on fire with its one-of-a-kind dance moves. Its secret is the fashionable short-sleeved shirt that shows off its arms while it moves.

An Amitoi that resembles a penguin. Unlike other penguins, it dislikes chilly weather. Fuzzy Percy prefers wearing cozy clothes and relaxing in hot springs. The only snow it likes is in the form of a tasty snow cone on a hot day.

An Amitoi that resembles a penguin. It wrote a song about its love of a good adventure, but the accompanying dance isn't done yet. It is determined to finish the choreography before the end of its latest adventure.

Winter Festival Percy is a jolly fellow eagerly awaiting winter's biggest celebration. Percy wears cozy red clothing said to be worn by a mythical gift-giving being. Percy wants to be on the nice list, but can't resist a good snowball fight.
Buzzing Percy loves honey so much that it infiltrated a bee hive with a clever disguise. Sadly, after eating an entire hive of honey, now it's too plump to get the outfit off. It regrets nothing.

A frivolous fennec fox Amitoi. When it's not napping, it likes to kick up sandstorms wherever it goes. It loves following adventurers through the desert, gleefully sowing sandy chaos wherever it goes.
A cheerful fennec fox Amitoi. Its motto is "No Worries"! It skips along, believing the world is chock-full of happiness and joyful happenings. It always looks on the bright side of things.

A scarf-wearing fennec fox Amitoi. It's a fashionista that claims its red muffler is the crown jewel of its perfect ensemble. It dreams of traveling the world, spreading its chic fashion sense to adventurers everywhere.

A fennec fox Amitoi wearing a bell on its collar. While it can't remember much of its previous owner, it does remember how truly happy it was when it was gifted the bell. It keeps wearing the bell in hopes of one day meeting that owner again.

The leader of the fennec fox Amitoi. A charismatic but dominant leader, it commands Shaccoons in every region and can leave even the boldest Shaccoon quaking in fear. Despite its fearsome reputation, it lets down its guard around its favorite adventurer.

A fennec fox Amitoi wearing antlers. It wears them to honor a legendary reindeer that could fly above the clouds and light up the night sky with a shining red nose. Sadly, the antlers can't make this Shaccoon fly, but it still tries its best by leaping up as high as it can. The cold winter air did turn its nose red though.

A nicely dressed desert fox Amitoi. Its custom-made monocle never falls from its head, even as it scurries across the dunes. Believing that a cool Amitoi makes a cool adventurer, it strives to dress neatly and speak eloquently for its adventurer.

A pebble-shaped Amitoi that came all the way to Solisium from Trutizan. They say it's been alive for over 30,000 years, but it still acts like a little baby. Be careful if you take it swimming, this little Amitoi will sink like a rock!

A rough toddler-aged Gneiss who loves pranks. It picks targets at random to be subject to its tricks. While some of its pranks can be mean-spirited, it just wants attention. If its mischief is ignored, it will just pout and roll back to its adventurer's side.

A rugged adolescent Gneiss. It wants to be the most jagged rock of all time, but all its sharper edges have smoothed out due to all its rolling. It goes wherever it wishes, bumping into everything along the way. When will it ever grow up?

A young Gneiss that's been rolling around for a long time. It's still looking for its place in the world, but is enjoying meeting all kinds of friends on its adventures. Although it may seem gruff at first, it's loyal to its partner.

With its bizarre mushroom hat, Free-Spirited Gneiss is very open minded. After traveling around the world, it is enthusiastically eccentric and still eager to explore. Worldly as it is, this Gneiss is also wise enough to know a rolling stone gathers no moss. It'll settle down... someday.

A Gneiss fresh from a flowery garden. It accidentally got itself stuck in a flower bed while rolling around. That's when it learned to take some time to smell the roses (literally). Now this Gneiss adorns itself with flowery accessories, spreading its nature-loving ways wherever it goes.

A rebellious, head-banging Gneiss who rocks the underground scene. This stone-cold party animal has been metamorphically transformed into the ultimate mosh pit master. With its crystal-clear vision for throwing the most groundbreaking bash ever, Punk Rock Gneiss is ready to make the earth move! (Warning: May cause seismic activity on the dance floor.)

A naive and clumsy Amitoi from the Snow Kingdom. It's trying to learn to count on its hands, but it can only count up to three. Someday, if it manages to count up to five, it wants to help the adventurer in five different ways.

A naive and clumsy Amitoi from the Snow Kingdom. It loves to play hide-and-seek in the falling snow. Its brilliant strategy: covering its face to make itself "invisible"! Unfortunately, its body doesn't blend in with its surroundings.

A naive and clumsy Amitoi from the Snow Kingdom. Despite its sweet nature, it tries its best to defend its adventurer by swinging its round fists. It still has a lot to learn, but this clever Amitoi has an excellent memory.

A naive and clumsy Amitoi from the Snow Kingdom. It takes the saying "best friends forever" very, very seriously. A loyal bodyguard, this Yeddy will always defend its adventurer with its stalwart button shield.
A naive and clumsy Amitoi from the Snow Kingdom. It rehearses its own coronation with the hand-crafted horns on its head. Its round little fingers are surprisingly dexterous at handcrafting.

This Yeddy wanted to visit a friend across the sea, but it didn't know how to swim! Thanks to its cool new shark outfit, now the sea is its playground. It's on its own adventure to finally visit its faraway friend, but is happy to make new friends along the way.

A naive and clumsy Amitoi from the Snow Kingdom. Even after years of felling trees with a single chop of its trusty axe, its hands remain soft and callous-free. Everyone wants to know how, but this hard-working Yeddy never reveals its secrets.

An Amitoi with a beautiful jewel. It claims to be an immortal sage that has lived for thousands of years... but can't prove it. It's on a quest to retrieve its lost bag full of all its clothing and is eager for all the help it can get.

An Amitoi with a beautiful jewel. As its memory fades, it's embarking on a quest to find all the lost memories of its long immortal life. Despite writing nearly nonstop on its journey, there's no word on when (or if) its book will ever be finished, much less published.

An Amitoi with a beautiful jewel. It has read every adventure book it could find. When it met the adventurer, it finally mustered the courage to tag along and have an adventure of its own. With knowledge gleaned from hundreds of books, it eagerly provides helpful stories whenever it can.
An Amitoi with a beautiful jewel. It boasts a bold blue hat from its former magician master. A bit of a studious shut-in, it never leaves home without it (if it leaves home at all).

An Amitoi with a beautiful jewel. They say the red eye can see the future, and the other eye can see the past. Unfortunately, that means it can't see the present, so it relies on the adventurer. In return, it gives advise to its adventurer whenever it can.

This travel-loving Glynt is wearing a traditional child's garb it picked up on its travels. This Glynt loves it enough to wear it all the time, even on its adventures. This worldly trend setter loves when others ask where it got its clothes from.

This Glynt knows everything... except for all things it doesn't. This sleuth loves to break down its mystery-solving process, but it's so long-winded no one wants to listen. Still, there's no denying it's very good at finding misplaced items, big and small.

A lighthearted adventuring companion. Budding Pippin is an extremely popular Amitoi because of its bubbly personality and infectious optimism. They can make even the shortest trip an exciting adventure.

A lighthearted adventuring companion. Shocked Pippin's sweet fragrance makes everyone smile, and making others smile makes this Amitoi smile. Someday, it dreams of blooming into a full flower so it can spread even more cheer.

This warm-hearted Pippin always listened to its friends' worries and gave them heartfelt advice. Whenever its friends expressed their gratitude for Pippin's help, this earnest and modest Amitoi blushed so much its leaves turned bright red, matching a beautiful autumn forest. Colorful Leaf Pippin now travels with adventurers and continues listening to the concerns of others, even if it still struggles to take a compliment to heart.

A lighthearted adventuring companion. Sunny Pippin's splendid sunflower blooms with its love of adventure. The flower is always facing towards its adventurer, radiating pure joy. When you see this Pippin's flower, you can't help but smile too.
A needlework Amitoi made of cloth and wood. It may be a little rough around the edges, but its colorful flowers and bluebird nest betray its caring, dependable nature.
A needlework Amitoi made of cloth and wood. This Amitoi may act like a rude sailor, but it's loyal to its crew and captain. Its head is adorned with little ocean treasures like starfish and coral.
A needlework Amitoi made of cloth and wood. Its shy, cool indifference hides its true feelings. Its head is adorned with red maple leaves and an adorable squirrel holding an acorn.

Fishing Hawthorne loves fishing. Hawthorne rarely catches anything, but it certainly looks like a perfectly seasoned fisherman. It's always prepared for anything and never goes anywhere without its safety vest. Safety first, right?
An Amitoi that resembles a bat. Prankster Joker loves to eat sweet treats and play tricks. It spends all its time pulling pranks.

An Amitoi that resembles a bat. It's usually lazy and wastes time doing nothing. However, when it comes to pulling pranks, it shows a passion like no other. In fact, it already has some tricks planned for later today...
An Amitoi that resembles a bat. Underneath its devious smile is a loyal, loving friend. Its kind heart doesn't stop it from making a little mischief though.

An Amitoi that resembles a bat. Long ago, its horns started turning black when eating sweets, then white when eating sour food. With its mismatched horns and high energy, this sweet-and-sour Amitoi is a fun-loving (if mischievous) friend.
An Amitoi that resembles a bat. The strongest of the Jokers. When it sets its heart on a goal, it'll stop at nothing to reach it. This Joker is an unstoppable prankster, so keep your guard up!

This Amitoi is a good chess player. So good, in fact, that now no one dares challenge it to a match. Now plays against itself or watches others play. It can't help but give advice to the losing side, often helping them win against even the toughest opponents. Because of this habit, people like to call this Joker the "Underdog Coach".

Rookie Trainee Ossic is still not used to the battlefield. It considers protecting an adventurer the greatest honor, but it knows it still has a long way to go. This little trooper sees traveling with an adventurer as part of its basic training.

Officer Ossic has a keen battle sense and is quick to warn troops of danger. It trains nonstop alongside the adventurer wherever they may go together. It is ever vigilant, never neglecting its duty as a guard.
The reliable Red Knight Ossic knows the true meaning of honor. One could never meet a more stalwart comrade on the battlefield. It has its inner demons, but it is working hard to move forward.
Obsidian Knight Ossic wears a splendid helm. The battlefield is the true domain of this Amitoi. When enemies see its iconic helm on the field, they know the battle is already lost.
Imperator Ossic is a noble commander and the bravest comrade an adventurer could ask for. With its mighty stone axe and nerves of steel, this Amitoi has never known defeat.

An Amitoi with a glorious golden helmet. Once a mere cadet, this Ossic becomes a brave soldier when it wears its helm. Its extremely brave, but not very knowledgeable about the battlefield. As the lowest ranking soldier, it doesn't get deployed often and instead spends its time polishing its helm.

Cupid Ossic brings two people together in love. When it senses love, the compass on its wrist shows the direction. It then flutters away on its cute little wings and shoots a heart-shaped arrow at the target, which never misses. It continues to travel at its adventurer's side to spread more love.

A sweet and good-hearted ogre Amitoi. Always hungry, it constantly asks everyone it meets for food. If you give it something to eat, it does a little dance to show its gratitude... before asking for seconds.

A sweet and good-hearted ogre Amitoi. It camouflages itself by wearing a leaf on its head while hiding in the bushes. It loves to jump out and surprise others. Just play along, even if you already knew where it was hiding.
A sweet and good-hearted ogre Amitoi. It is mesmerized by all things shiny and polished. If this Amitoi visits an accessory shop, it may never want to leave!

A traveler from the east gifted this Thwump a top and a whip. Whirly Thwump has been practicing hard to become the king of the tops. When a top starts to spin, Thwump spins along with it, declaring "I'll spin forever"! The dizziness always gets the best of it in the end, though.

This Thwump just hatched from its egg, waking up in an empty nest. With no parents in sight, this brave little Thwump began a quest to find its parents on its own. If you ever see someone with purple plumes and wings, Lanlan Thwump will want to meet them!
The smallest golem-type Amitoi. This little Talem is unable to speak, so it blinks its eyes instead to express its feelings.

Modeled after the Giant Golem Talus, this golem Amitoi has cannon ball shoulders and is made of solid rock. Though it proudly struts around, puffing out its mighty chest to intimidate others, it's actually harmless. It has a tendency to show off by randomly telling its companion any information it knows.

Modeled after the Giant Golem Talus, a little sprout grew out of this golem Amitoi. It swings its gigantic rock fists, but the little sprouts make it too adorable to be truly threatening. It's sweet and caring, trying to help others whenever it can.

As this golem Amitoi moves, spiraling vines sway elegantly around its craggy stone body. Despite being rock solid as a golem, its sensitive nature causes it to get upset easily. When left alone, it will seeks out any useful info it can to help its adventurer.

This craggy golem Amitoi loves plants so much it's nearly covered in them. This green-thumbed Talem is a lover not a fighter, only using its enormous arms and terrifying teeth for harmless play. It aspires to have the plants growing out of its body be as lush and diverse as a real jungle.

This Amitoi froze itself after one too many ice cream cones. It now dreams of opening an ice cream shop to share its love of the sweet icy treat with everyone. It's on a journey to learn ice magic to make the perfect ice cream!

This seaside golem Amitoi has become smooth and briny after a long time at the seashore. It brings along its ocean friends and treasures wherever it goes. Someday, it hopes to see the end of the sea with Mr. Starfish and Ms. Conch.
Thieving Nick dreams of becoming a legend. Although it's just a rookie, it still looks down on other new travelers. It doles out grumpy advice to the few adventurers it respects.

Snatching Nick wants to become a master at everything. This ambitious Amitoi wants to become the best at everything from hunting, to gathering, to adventuring. It's a little grouchy, but deep down it wants to become the best in order to help others.

The legendary Phantom Thief Nick. Since it's skilled enough to steal anything it desires, this disciplined Amitoi only steals items that are a true challenge. It has a restrained expression, but the gleam in its eye betrays its keen senses and love of a good heist.

Righteous Thief Nick is the stuff of legends. This stoic Amitoi vowed to never speak, believing actions are louder than words. It even drew a new smile its face to show others that it means no harm. This Nick is always looking to give away its ill-gotten loot for a good cause.

The legend, Bandit King Nick. It exudes the presence of a master thief who steals without a second thought. It eagerly trains its adventurer as its apprentice. A harsh teacher, its openness to teach belies its ruthless philosophy.

This Nick originally disguised itself to infiltrate a bandit camp and steal all their treasure. It ended up enjoying the free-spirited bandit lifestyle and ended up joining them instead. Nick is still conflicted on what to do next. Maybe it'll make up its mind when this latest adventure is over.
Fighter Dentwerp is a proud and mighty warrior. It may be a bit brash and aggressive, but it's also fair and plays by the rules. Even when fighting, it's strict about taking breaks.

Brawler Captain Dentwerp has a feisty and prideful nature. It's named after the terrifying Adentus it resembles. It's a bit quarrelsome, but has a righteous heart. It's immediately recognizable thanks to its long pointed teeth, branch-like hair, and green skin.

Loyal Fist Dentwerp has a feisty and prideful nature. It cannot tolerate injustice and values camaraderie above all else. It always wears its favorite bandana. Despite decorating itself in skulls, it's not a very intimidating Amitoi.

Steel Fist Dentwerp has a feisty and prideful nature. It's very competitive and its fist is hard as steel. Some fear it due to its resemblance to Adentus, but despite it's hardcore appearance, it's actually the most gentle out of all the Dentwerps.

Punching Champion Dentwerp has a feisty and prideful nature. It never backs down from a fight and thinks of itself as an extremely powerful warrior. It has a dashing tuft of gray hair and wears spiked pauldrons fastened together with chains.

This Punky Dentworth is a proud brawler. It was once the kingpin of the underworld, but left behind that life to pursue a music career. This Amitoi never goes anywhere without its trusty guitar and studded leather vest.
An Amitoi that resembles Grand Aelon. It's been spending more time admiring its reflection in the river, appreciating its newly grown leaves.
An Amitoi that resembles Grand Aelon. It's very proud of its charming leaf ears. Its leaves are still very fragile though, so it gets upset when others touch them.
An Amitoi that resembles Grand Aelon. It carefully carries a miniature forest wherever it goes. To keep its little forest healthy, it waters it every morning with crystal-clear water.

An Amitoi that resembles Grand Aelon. A tree on its back wished to see snow for the first time. The power of the tree's wish became a mystical light that illuminates Grover's horns, guiding it on its adventures.
An Amitoi that resembles Grand Aelon. This forest-loving Grover became an official forest guard. The stress from its new position has turned the leaves on its head yellow.

This Grover's decorations grew bigger and bigger as it prepped for a grand winter festival. It put a giant shining star on its head so its friends can always find it, even on the darkest of winter nights.

When this Amitoi fell in love, a flower bloomed on its head. As its love grew, more flowers bloomed, and now this Grover just can't hide its feelings any longer. It can't wait to confess its love! Even if the flowers wither, its love will never fade.
An Amitoi that resembles an imp. Its teary expression tricks others into letting their guard down. Thanks to those big, sorrowful eyes, it's never lost a duel.
An Amitoi that resembles an imp. It considers the adventurer as its newest minion. Its fang necklace may look intimidating, but its actually this Figment's own teeth it lost as it grew up.

An Amitoi that resembles an imp. Although many assume it's angry because of its bright red body, it's actually quite silly and sweet. Its body was just stained red after it fell into its favorite dish, Spicy Quillix Stew, while trying to sneak a taste.

An Amitoi that resembles an imp. It left Diabolica to learn ice magic. Unfortunately, in its attempts to teach itself, it turned itself an icy blue. It's making the most of its accidental color change by trying out new styles and fashions.

An Amitoi that resembles an imp. Demon King Figment is the definition of strength. It travels with the adventurer, excited to see if the adventurer will cause any mischief and reveling in any chaos that ensues.

Figment, determined to be the scariest Amitoi at the Haunted Harvest, missed its chance to buy its costume.
By the time it got to the costume market, all that was left were crafting supplies. But Figment made it work.
It completely wrapped itself in bandages, creating a costume like nothing else at the festival.
Proud of its ingenuity with unconventional materials, this Figment is delighted to show off its costume all year round.

Quiet Izzy enjoys the company of reindeer. Tired of wandering the snowfields all alone, this lonely Amitoi yearned for traveling companions. It made itself an antler to blend in with its new family. Quiet Izzy is quite adaptable and loves animals.

White Sage Izzy loves nothing more than meditating in the snow fields. Its time spent in the bitter cold gave it surprising survival knowledge and endurance. Though it tries to share its knowledge, its advice is usually phrased like a riddle.

Harvest Moon Izzy fell in love with the moon in the night sky. One day, this Amitoi decided to set off on a grand journey to meet the moon. On the way, it befriended a small cloud and an unripe persimmon. The trio have grown a lot on their adventure together. Izzy's heartfelt devotion has transformed its body to resemble the very moon it hopes to meet someday. The small cloud grew, and the unripe persimmon ripened.
Harvest Moon Izzy and its companions continue their journey alongside their newest friend, an adventurer.

Gneiss became a huge snowman after having a wild snowball fight with friends. It was hit by a few too many snowballs and froze solid! Its friends gave Gneiss their hat and scarf to warm it up. Touched by their gifts, Gneiss proudly wears their presents wherever it goes, no matter the weather.
A cute and boisterous Amitoi. The light makes its eyes stand out even more, especially in the dark. This Skelti is dangerously adorable... and it knows it.

Scuba Skelti loves the mysterious undersea world. Its heart quickens with joy at the sight of vibrant corals and schools of tiny fish. When a hulking, fearsome fish drifts into view, Skelti slips away without a sound. The small harpoon it carries isn’t for battle. It's simply a tool for collecting the ocean’s trash.

This Spiky Anise is a terrible liar because its horns grow every time it tells a fib. Rumor has it this Amitoi files its horns to hide the growth. It will deny this... Which just makes the horns grow more.

A Chattery Anise. Well, actually it's this Amitoi's hat that does the actual talking. Anise first wore this hat to get better at small talk, but the hat's constant chattering is starting to give it headaches.

Seedling Anise is always busy in the springtime, racing to bring forth bright green sprouts. It works harder than anyone else to make sure it doesn't miss the best time, but when asked if it's hard, it always says no.

A werewolf Amitoi who used to sail the ocean with sailors. It has ventured through the frigid waters of the arctics and huge waves of the tropics. Now satisfied with its adventures on the seas, it's time for some adventures on the land. It met the adventurer while leaving its ship, and began to travel together.
A werewolf Amitoi, who always protects its friends. It decided to become stronger to protect its weaker friends. After training with heavy iron chains, it came to have a rock hard body.

Lifeguard Wolfie stands as the stalwart guardian of the beach. Once saved from drowning by an adventurer, it was inspired to serve as a lifeguard. Wolfie insists on proper warm-ups before every swim, and those who dare defy the beach safety rules are swiftly met with the sharp blast of a giant whistle from beneath a red hat.

The Gardener Koble is a passionate landscaper. It's trying to revive the old garden it inherited, but monsters keep ruining its plants. Gardener Koble has joined the adventurer to raise funds and become strong enough to fend off pests in its new garden.

This Storage Designer Koble dreams of making the perfect warehouse. Only the best goblin architect is allowed build a warehouse, and this Koble is up to the task. This Koble wants to make a space worthy of its amazing adventurer friend. It's already hard at work planning out its next masterpiece.

A cute ghost Amitoi wearing a huge sheet. It's always in deep thought and bumps into everything, leaving its hat crumpled. What does it ponder, you ask? How to give a good scare to its friends, of course!

Jolty Roger once commanded the wild seas. One day, as a storm raged and waves the size of houses engulfed its ship, it blacked out and awoke to find himself alone and shipwrecked. Now, all Jolt has left is its old pirate hat. Jolt embarks on an adventure to find the perfect feather to adorn its precious hat.
A cute ghost Amitoi wearing a huge sheet. It's very loud and enjoys attention. It often pops up when it thinks things are too quiet and then flies around laughing loudly.
A cute ghost Amitoi wearing a huge sheet. It's very loud and enjoys attention. It often pops up when it thinks things are too quiet and then flies around laughing loudly.

A Thorny Torbbit travelling the desert. Its horny shell sewn on its back helps it endure the rough sands. It lost one of the eyes during its journey, replacing it with a shiny button it found on the road. It seems to like the new look.

A Shiny Torbbit travelling the desert. Its eyes shimmer brightly when something piques its curiosity. In fact, its eyes shine so bright it can see at night. It loves to share helpful stories of all its seen to its adventurer.

Despite its tough looks, Hocky is a big softie at heart and quite shy. The first thing it does each morning is fix up its hair. Because it's so shy, it refuses to go outside without first hiding its face completely. Recently, it's not been satisfied with its new blond hair, so it's spending quite a lot of time in front of the mirror.

Despite its tough looks, Hocky is a big softie at heart and quite shy. It likes to sing and dance, though prefers to do it when nobody's watching. One time, a friend saw this artistic side of Hocky and gifted it a purple bouquet of flowers, which Hocky uses to decorate its body. To this day, Hocky practices an incredible dance, even if it may never be brave enough to perform it for others.
A shy Shaikal. It's pretty skittish, startling at the slightest sound and immediately hiding. If it's feeling ignored, it will poke its head out to timidly get your attention.

A dazzling Shaiki. This fastidious Amitoi is bright enough to get any job done with precision and aplomb. You may call it a little persnickety, but it prefers the word meticulous. It likes things done exactly right.

Izzy, ever the awkwardly well-meaning companion, wanted to wear a special costume to blend in at the Haunted Harvest. It asked one of its fiery friends to help it make a costume that glows brighter than all the Jack-o'-Lanterns. The costume is pretty toasty, but Izzy loves all the attention.

A basilisk Amitoi, who always moves in a straight line. It didn't want to get lost in the dizzying world, so it kept its eyes open. When it wasn't sure if the path it was on was the right one, it decided to keep going straight. Alone, it only goes straight, but not when following its Adventurer.

A vampire Amitoi that has a luxurious villa. It once lost everything to a deceitful aristocrat, but the adventurer helped the Amitoi to regain its lost wealth. However, all these regained wealth made the Amitoi arrogant and pompous. Since then, it has been following the adventurer to visit other nobles to acquire their culture and etiquettes.

Dreamy Quillo that captures happiness in its sparkling eyes. Dreamy Quillo's crystal eyes have the ability to capture the happiest moments in them. The fireworks it watched with the Adventurer were its happiest memory, so it now holds them in its eyes. What happy memory will it capture next?

An Amitoi that always looks on the bright side.
This optimistic friend is always looking forward to another day.
Its smile and cheer are contagious, and you'll hear nothing but laughter in its wake.

A dark Amitoi that dreams of conquering the world.
The problem is: its face is just too darn cute to intimidate anyone. To remedy this, it searched far and wide for armor befitting of a conquering commander in its size. Now with its wicked horned helm obscuring its adorable expression, this ambitious little Amitoi is finally ready to begin its great global conquest.

An Amitoi that wants to darken the world.
Shadow Mayhem believes that the current world is too bright, making people unable to see the true nature of things. It wants to use the magic from its horn to darken the world, but it's not strong enough. It's been wandering around to gain more magic power.

An Amitoi that is done wandering and is ready for a new adventure. In its time of loneliness and misery, it met Adventurer Pro Percy and discovered the romance and excitement of adventure. Following the advice that a true adventure requires good company, it's been waiting for a good companion. Now, it's about to embark on the adventure long dreamed of.
A happy adventurer has colored this Wolfie with the color of the sea. This happy Wolfie makes a lot of friends wherever it goes, and play with them at the sea until the sun sets.
A sweet adventurer has colored this Wolfie with the color of the spring. Even its chain is covered in blooms. Wolfie's biggest hobby is to wait for flowers bloom under the warm spring sun.

Dragaryle Darkitty was born at the ruin of an old castle. Made of the Ancient Dragon's bones, it was supposed to guard the castle forever; but a kind adventurer has freed it from the shackles and now it's flying around freely with its stone wings.

Radeth Scorchie was born from a ruin of a castle that was covered in flame and ice. It naturally obtained fiery temper and ice cold attitude to survive from such environment. People call it the 'Scorchie who doesn't care for fire or water' with respect.

An Amitoi that was modelled after Vengeance that nearly destroyed the world. It has a halo with a sophisticated gold ring and purple gems. Carly is proud of its beautiful appearance, but sometimes finds itself overwhelmed with uncontrollable dark anger.

An Amitoi related to Figment. Unlike the mischievous Figment, this one is earnest and hardworking. Driven by a desire to fix everything, they became a repair expert, but frequent mistakes prevent its skills from matching its passion. Nevertheless, it travels the world every day searching for things to repair.

A black-robed, broom-riding Witch Skelti. It loves cleanliness and always carries a broom with it to clean up trash and leaves on the side of the road. Even those that initially thought it creepy eventually join it in cleaning up.

A noble-born vampire Amitoi who owns vast estates, yet walks the mortal world with unexpected compassion. Though distrust nearly drove it from the kingdom, its long history of honorable dealings and the testimonies of those it has aided secured its place. It could have remained comfortably in its estate, but now that it has the strength to help others, it has chosen to travel with adventurers for a while, lending a hand to those in need.

A veteran site manager in charge of countless landmark projects—from the Venelux Dormitories to the Steel Trust Union Research Institute. Known for its "safety first" mantra, it watches over construction sites with the gaze of a hawk, scrutinizing the tools and health of workers on site. Break times are sacred; shortcuts are heresy. With Dentwerp in charge, even the most ambitious structures rise flawlessly—and without a single accident.

Echo Hazly is a bashful creature who loves deep mountain valleys. While Hazly spends its downtime joyfully exploring the ravines, the moment an echoing cry for help rings out, it is the first to arrive. Though it quickly disappears after lending a hand, the echoes of gratitude from those it helped carry far across the valley and are sure to reach Hazly's ears.

Cheeky Hatchi adores old temples and abandoned castles. Passionate about preserving the beautiful scars left by time, it will bombard anyone carelessly disturbing the ruins with a barrage of nagging. If you sense an eerie presence in a crumbling fortress, it might just be Cheeky Hatchi getting ready to unleash a verbal avalanche about respecting history.

Screechy Hatchi is fascinated by uniquely shaped rocks. It roams the rocky wastes and mountains, obsessively crafting stunning landscapes with its hooves and horns. Though the clangs and crashes of rolling and smashing rocks echo for miles in its wake, it's all accidental—Screechy Hatchi has no interest in violence.

Humming Hazly is a gentle creature who finds joy in the lush, green forest. Hazly is often found lounging in the grass and humming idle tunes—unless a fallen nestling or creature in distress needs help. Wherever Hazly's melodies drift, the forest feels more peaceful than ever.

Sleepy Hazly loves the quiet of the swamp. It's often found dozing in the cool waters, but if someone pollutes the swamp or bothers its friends, it rises from the depths, revealing its pitch-black body. Still half-asleep, it says little, but its looming presence is more than enough to strike fear. It's remarkably effective at breaking bad habits that harm nature.

Fiery King Hazly has the most captivating voice in all of Solisium. When a theater packed with fans erupts in cheers for the Fiery King, Hazly appears—cool, calm, collected. With a triumphant cheer, Hazly's performance begins, its voice so powerful and enchanting that time and space seem to fade away. When the final note echoes through the hall, the crowd is left breathless, begging for an encore. For Fiery King Hazly, these are the moments that shine brighter than the rarest jewels.

Mystic Truestrike Nick never misses. Rumor has it that if it lets loose at random, the target will seek out the arrow itself. Yet it remains unsatisfied with its skill. Until the day it pierces a hundred targets with a single arrow, Nick's relentless training continues.

An old-school Figment that delights in true style and romance. It often enjoys time alone while listening to music, but if it finds a friend on the same wavelength, it would gladly groove together until dawn.

Flowing Scorchie loves frigid ocean waters so much that it wears a shell of volcanic rock, like a misguided hermit crab. When it dives into the waves, scalding sparks erupt in its wake. Be careful not to mistake it for a harmless seashell or you might end up with a nasty burn!

Half-baked Forkling stands before the blazing fire, ready to serve up splendid dishes. Its thick oven mitts allow it to safely cook in intense heat. Though the job is hot and demanding, nothing is more rewarding for Half-baked Forkling than seeing the castle's residents enjoy a warm, hearty meal.

Silver Forkling used to manage the banquet tables of a royal castle. Believing that the tablecloth set the tone for the entire dining hall, it showcased countless arrangements using fabrics of every kind. Originally, it left the castle in search of a new tablecloth, but splendid new ones kept appearing, and it continues its journey to this day.
Divine Beast of the Wind Tiqmi
Divine Beast of the Wind Tiqmi Desc

Hocky is a forest ranger who guards a small mountain. While on duty, it sometimes finds a sunny spot where it can meditate in peace. Using the green leaves of the tall trees and the lush green of the bushes as its protective colors, Hocky often goes unnoticed, even by the most observant adventurers.

The cute and charming Nerzatum Hocky. Born from a block of ice made by the First Snow, this little Hocky loves to playfully toss small ice fragments with its snout and crack ice under its cute feet. An adventurer, watching it, gave it a blue ribbon as a present and invited it on their journey. Ever curious and quite clever, this Hocky quickly adapted to the road. Cheerful and dependable, it's now the adventurer's perfect companion.

Lucien Skelti, dressed in a magnificent white cloak. It was born from shooting stars from the night sky. It has a sacred scythe that purifies sinners, but since it lacks enough power and experience, it is continuously training by the adventurer's side so that it can wield its weapon properly.

Rice Cake Artisan Yeddy, who makes the world's finest rice cakes with secrets taught by the Moon Rabbit. Its creations are so delicious that even it can't help but take a bite, leaving little to sell. And so it pounds rice cakes through the night to replenish its stock. Thus, Yeddy loves autumn nights when cool winds blow and the full moon shines upon the world like daytime.

Percy is a weird artisan who only makes yellow hats. It used to be a famous artisan who crafted hats for nobles, but ever since it became friends with a child, it has been doing its best to ensure the safety of children by making yellow hats, which are spotted easily even when it's rainy or dark at night. It has lost all its fame from its bygone days, but it says it's happier with itself being called "Maintenance Percy" now.

It's Percy the ice sculptor, creating beautiful works of art from hard chunks of ice. Its two hands are always cold as they work away with its tools, but it claims its passion for sculpting burns hotter than anyone else's.

Blessed by the moonlight, Moonlight Torbit carries the magic of silver light within its amethyst thorns. Even in the blackest dark, they shine gently with a soothing warmth, gifting weary friends with dreams full of peace.

Checkered Forkling always appears wherever there's tasty desserts. One lick of a fork and it can even correctly guess last night's dessert. It's the best companion a dessert-loving adventurer can have!

There is no trouble that Barbarian Koble can't fix with its beaming smiles. Despite its formidable strength, it prefers conversations over fights when dealing with problems. However, rumor does say that it keeps following people with a smile until it gets the answer it wants.

In the darkest hours of a moonless night, Glynt drifts from shadow to shadow, waltzing alone in silent halls. Those who glimpse its dancing are said to vanish, swept into a mystery only the night knows. Yet brave adventurers still seek Glynt out, chasing whispers of the tale in hopes of uncovering the truth.

On the Night of Nightmares, Hallow Jolt seeks out wrongdoers and scolds them until dawn. It slips from the shadows, pricking and poking with its sharp little horns, chasing them in a game of tag until sunrise. To the wronged and weary, Jolt is a breath of relief—and among the many spirits of the Haunted Harvest, it is the most welcome guest of all.

The Basilisk Amitoi, champion of the desert. Where no path exists, it forges one with unstoppable force. None can withstand its sand-breath. Yet to its friends, it is always gentle and yielding—the Magma Basili. It says traveling with an adventurer is always a joy.

Thunky Koble offers bespoke solutions to Amitoi struggling with their looks. With a flair for effortless style—graceful yet natural, like the soft pink hat always perched upon its head—Koble knows how to bring out the best in anyone. No matter their worries, Koble always find the perfect answer, and by the end of each session, every Amitoi leaves loving themselves a little more.

When the darkest Night of Nightmares arrives, Candlestick Jolt wanders gloomy manors, setting candles alight. It insists it only helps the frightened, yet when it bursts out from beneath a tablecloth, it’s clear its true joy lies in playful mischief.

Vampio, the Crimson Rose, forever dreams of a rosy tomorrow. With its enchanted left eye, crafted by delicate magic, it can glimpse into the future. Adventuring with Vampio means you’ll always find the best path—but winning its favor is no easy feat, for its charm draws too many. Perhaps a beautiful rose, offered for its hat, might at last earn its heart.

Starry-Eyed Quillo has a heart as big as a Startree's. It leads the way in the dark with its beautiful, twinkling eyes, making sure its friends don't get lost. Its most treasured possession is the red muffler it received from an adventurer in return for its kindness.

The ever-cheerful Frost Drax is always upbeat, as if it holds all the world's joy. Though sometimes misunderstood due to its grumpy expression, you'll soon be giggling along with it after spending a few minute with it! It's a must-have Amitoi for any glum adventurer.

Strong in body and spirit, Cheering Tiqmi possesses passion and vigor that burn like a furnace, inspiring those nearby. Being with Cheering Tiqmi is said to instantly restore vitality and motivation, even to the sick and weak.

When winter comes, Nick, the winter hunter, busily patrols the snow-covered mountains. Its prey are the poachers who recklessly set traps along animal paths or threaten its friends who are hibernating. It's said that anyone struck by Nick's stinging arrows never returns to the forest.

Snuggly Shaiki is enjoying an exciting winter vacation. When the snow falls heavily, it's prepared with a warm fur hat, fur scarf, and fur gloves to build a magnificent snowman. The goal is to make the world's biggest snowman, but what truly takes shape is the image of a beloved friend who remains deep in its heart.

This Izzy developed crystal icicles when part of the snowy field briefly melted and then froze again. After standing in the snow for so long, the icicle above its head has hardened completely. From time to time, Izzy breaks off pieces of the icicle and crunches on them as snacks.

Cinderspike Scorchie never feels the cold. Although it looks like it could cause burns, it actually emits just the right amount of heat to warm you up. When you're in the water together, Scorchie keeps the water at a comfortable temperature. It's the perfect companion for a relaxing bath.

Snowflake Izzy wears a fluffy snow hat. The cold wind has swept the snowflakes upward into an elegant shape. When asked if it's cold, it says it's warm and happy, but its expression barely changes, making it hard to tell if it's telling the truth.

Shroudstar Anise suffers from severe anxiety when asked questions. Whenever asked a question, it always responds with a "no". This makes it seem opinionated, but it's actually just so nervous that it blurts out the first thing that comes to mind. Its anxiety has turned its entire body purple, so it covers itself with a cloak.
Drowsy Drax falls asleep the moment it lies down. Even now, it's sleeping while forcibly keeping one eye open. The other is said to be dreaming sweet dreams.
Serpentine Drax enjoys eating food. It eats so well that even picky eaters immediately get an appetite from just watching it eat. It brushes its teeth diligently as well, sporting clean, white teeth.

The ever-impatient Shrublet Quillix. It loves fruit so much that the moment anything bears fruit, it gobbles up the unripe ones right away. At first, the astringent taste of unripe fruit made its fur stand on end, but by now, it's gotten quite used to it. Its expression, however, tells a different story.

A golden fish Ossic that always repays any kindness shown to it. If its benefactor has a wish, it will grant any request, from replacing an old wooden tub with a new one to building a lavish palace. Some even say that if someone grows too greedy, the priceless thing they receive in return may be the conscience they never had.

Whispering Anise tells the things it truly wants to say into its hat. At some point, it learned that speaking every thought in its heart would only leave itself hurt. So, it began whispering its truest feelings into its hat, and those words piled up until the hat grew bigger and bigger. Since there's no telling what might burst out the moment it takes the hat off, it never removes it, not even when it sleeps.

A loyal werewolf Amitoi. If its master gives an order, it has the grit to see it through no matter what. Its wild instincts sometimes flare up and leave it conflicted, but in the end, its master's command always comes first.

Ruffled Glynt dressed in an adorable dress. Small and nimble, it scurries through every corner of the mansion, uncovering hidden secrets one by one. During the day, it's a diligent worker, but at night, it becomes an informant with remarkable observational skills. It never fails to track down anyone who breaks a plate and tries to hide it!

Creates an out-of-focus blurring effect.
Increases immersion and realness, but it may cause dizziness for some users.

Chromatic Aberration

Simulates visual refraction caused when light enters a camera lens.
Increases immersion, but may cause objects to appear blurry.

Not applicable when the post-processing option is Low.

Lens Flare

Simulates the scattering of light within the lens, adding a glow or colorful speckles to the screen.

Not applicable when the post-processing option is Low.

Ambient Occlusion

Adds a localized shading effect based on the exposure of the space to create a sense of depth.
Shading effect improves with higher quality settings.

Screen Space Reflections

Represents mutual reflections between pixels drawn on the screen.
Reflection quality improves with higher settings.

Anisotropic Filtering

Prevents texture sharpness from degrading when viewing the surface at an angle.
The higher the setting, the sharper the texture when viewing the surface at an angle.

Volumetric Fog

Simulates the light response of particles to increase the sense of space and perspective.
